Overview

“Can you feel it? That fire? His fire. It's rekindled inside us, the hope, the heart, to take the next step forward. He did not fail. And neither will I.”
— Kai to Daidan, "False Light"

Kai is the current Elemental Master and ninja of Fire, Nya's older brother, Ray and Maya's son, Skylor's boyfriend and Wyldfyre's mentor.

He and his younger sister worked as blacksmiths in their father's blacksmith shop, forging weapons until they one day met Master Wu. Motivated to save his sister after an attack from the Skulkin army, Kai was trained by Wu to learn Spinjitzu and master his Elemental Power and many other skills alongside his other teammates: Cole, Jay, Zane, and Lloyd. With his team, he embarked on many adventures, battling the likes of the Serpentine, the Stone Army, the Nindroid Army, and more.

When the Time Twins returned to Ninjago, Krux tried to convince Kai that his parents were traitors. Kai and Nya discovered that their parents were alive and reunited with them in the Vermillion Swamps, where they were held captive. After Krux and Acronix successfully opened a rift through time to alter a historic battle, Kai, Nya, and Wu followed the Iron Doom and successfully prevented the Time Twins from changing the future, but at the cost of losing Wu to time.

Kai helped battle a notorious gang that resurrected Lord Garmadon and was ultimately stranded in the First Land with the other original ninja and Wu. After Wu became old enough to regain his memories, he managed to find the armor and become the Golden Dragon Master, with the Firstbourne and some dragons' help, they returned home to Ninjago to help the Resistance battle the Sons of Garmadon.

When the Ninja accidently freed Aspheera from her tomb, she steals Kai's fire to create her army. He later regains it during the Ninja's stay at the Never-realm, using it to destroy Boreal, a dragon that belonged to the Ice Emperor.

When the Overlord returns as the Crystal King, Kai and his teammates and allies would band together to fulfill the final prophecy of Quanish the Elder and stop him once more, temporarily losing his powers in the process.

When the Merge occurred, where all realms formed into one, Kai woke up on an unfamiliar island, plagued with many terrifying monsters and spent weeks trying to find his way out. As he overcame his struggles of despair, Kai eventually managed to find the Destiny's Bounty and used it to finish his journey back to Ninjago and to the monastery, reuniting with Lloyd. Now back with his team, Kai continues to embark on new journeys across the Merged Lands, mentoring the Heat ninja Wyldfyre in the process.

Kai becomes the first of the Ninja to learn Rising Dragon, using it to help stop Ras from freeing the Forbidden Five. Despite his efforts, he was used by Ras as a sacrifice to free Nokt from the Nether-Space, ending up there for weeks along with Bonzle before Nya and Riyu managed to free him. Later on, he helped Nya in her quest to find Jay.

After the Battle of the Spectral Lands, Nya, along with Jay and Kai, were left stranded in the Land of Madness by Ras, where they eventually found the gi Jay wore during the Merge. After Jay reconnected some more with the ninja team, they infiltrated the Administration to uncover the truth behind Jay's amnesiac state; as Nya used a machine from the Department of Vacation Simulation to unblock Jay's suppressed memories. They headed to Imperium after learning of the Loyalists and partook in the Loyalist assault, where he received his Draconus Form from Lloyd and helped defeat Beatrix and the Elemental Monsters.

Appearance

Appearance[]

  • Kai's current appearance
  • Kai's Season 8-10 appearance
  • Avatar Kai
  • Child Kai (Dragons Rising)
  • Kai (Monstrosity)
1/5

Typically preferring red attire, Kai has tall, thick, and spiky brown hair, shaped like a flame, similar to his hair in The LEGO Ninjago Movie, but slightly shortened. He is often seen with a focused expression on his face, with a scar visible on his right eyebrow and a bandage above his left, which has been there for a long time, possibly because he thinks it looks cool.[5]

Before Season 8, his hair was a slightly darker shade of brown, his eyebrows were black, his bangs parted to the right and instead of a scar, and he had a notch on his left eyebrow. However, he has a scar below his eye in the LEGO sets released prior to Season 8, which is now reflected in the sets and in the show after Season 8 onwards. From Season 11 onward, his hair is more textured with color.

Flashbacks from Season 7 show that Kai used to have freckles when he was young, while wearing short tan pants and a red shirt with his lion symbol. In a flashback from "Fugitives From Madness," Kai used his physical set hairpiece (most likely due to WildBrain not having access to the original hair model), and had brown eyebrows, and the shirt was slightly redesigned, now using his legacy lion symbol.

In "Way of the Ninja" and "Endings," Kai wore a white shirt and red pants as well as an orange apron. Since "The Royal Blacksmiths," Kai's civilian attire consists of a red half-zipped up sweater over a maroon shirt with his symbol on the chest and brown pants. Throughout Season 6, he wore a red cap over his hair to conceal his identity. In the pilot episodes and "The New Masters of Spinjitzu," it can be observed that Kai has chest hair while wearing pajamas, but in later appearances where his chest is visible, including the appearance of his past self while time traveling to the events of the pilot, the hair is now removed, retconning his original torso.

  • Kai's Season 7 appearance
  • Child Kai (WILFilm)
1/2

In an anime inspired scene of "The Absolute Worst," Kai's eyes are shown to be brown.

In Prime Empire, Kai's avatar gave him a different look. His hair was blond, and he had red paint over his eyes, similar to Harumi. He also had a red square print that is half-hidden on his chest and wore a sleeveless red gi with gold bolt-like patterns and dark red diamond-shaped marks on the chest.

For more images on Kai's appearance in his different ninja suits, click here.

Age

Age[]

The ninja's ages are not specified.[6]

Ninjago: Like the majority of his fellow ninja, Kai was a teenager at the start of the original series.[7] He is 2 years older than Nya.[8] However, the ninja don't officially have specific ages,[9] as they were meant to be perpetually in their teenage years for the duration of the original series.[10] As of Hunted, he, and the other three original ninja were stated to be "grown-up teenagers" by Jay.[11] Misako later referred to Kai as a grown man, implying he was a legal adult as of Seabound.[12]

Dragons Rising: The Merge occurs sometime after Crystalized, and the main events of the series take place an unknown amount of years later. Children before the merge grew into teenagers, which may imply that he and the other original five ninja, excluding Zane, are now young adults in their 20s instead of teens. However, as mentioned above, the creators don't specify ages. In "Gangs of the Sea" when Wyldfyre said Kai should sit behind her on Heatwave's back to go find the Purple Dragon Core, Kai says he's the one who should be in the front since he's older and right after states that he's "not that old."

The following are possible estimations using creator statements on the ninja's ages. Their specific ages are not canonically set in stone, and some older statements may be obsolete.


Potential Estimations: During the events of the pilot episodes and Season 1, Kai may have been at least 15 or 16 years of age.[13][14]

Personality

Personality[]

Fittingly for his elemental affinity, Kai is very hot-headed, prone to taking action before he thinks things through. He is capable of making careful observations when the need arises, but his emotions often override his caution. His single-mindedness made interaction with his teammates difficult at first (especially due to his worry about Nya), but he eventually learned to work with the other ninja. He can be very cocky at times, especially earlier in his career as a ninja, sometimes even to the point of selfishness, insisting that he is better than others, gloating about his victory, or yelling about his failures. He seems to have a large ego as he wanted to be the Green Ninja and lead the team. He eventually grew out of this for the most part, though he occasionally lapses back into a similar mindset. But those emotions are also when his strength is greatest, especially when protecting those he cares about. Kai's personality represents caution, growth, safety, and warmth. He may not say it much, but he deeply cares about his loved ones and will do anything to protect them, even if he must sacrifice himself, which is why he's so overconfident.

Later, following the ninja's fame, Kai would end up getting something of a larger head and bigger ego, constantly flirting with girls and enjoying the merchandise styled after him. He indulged in his fame the most out of all of the ninja.[16] Usually, because he often feels insecure, Kai feels like he's useless or insignificant at times or not as good as the other ninja.

Kai also has something of an overconfident stubborn side, believing that he is in the right until overwhelming evidence to the contrary is presented. This is especially pronounced during Lord Garmadon's stay on the Destiny's Bounty; Kai repeatedly accused the four-armed villain of treachery or plotting despite Garmadon's insistence that saving Lloyd was his primary concern at the time.[17] On the other hand, Kai's stubborn streak lends him incredible determination that allows him to bolster the team's spirit in the face of impossible odds.

Despite having no powers at the time, Kai showed intense loyalty through his determination to protect Lloyd when the latter was possessed by Morro.[18] As time passed, Kai mentally connected his power with his self-worth to a greater degree, at one point hesitating to give up his power to save Lloyd and, at another point, losing hope when his power was taken by Aspheera.[19][20][21] However, his desire to protect his friends was able to overcome all this insecurities and allow Kai to see his self-value besides his power, allowing him to become an even better person and ninja.

Overall, Kai is a tough, brave, confident, passionate and also protective ninja. The most prevalent facet of Kai's personality is his good heart and dedication to the people he cares about—if someone can earn his friendship, he will stop at nothing to protect them. Much of his stubbornness and recklessness is due to his desire to help his loved ones, either directly or by becoming strong enough to defeat anyone who might threaten them with their plans. In turn, his friends and family work to balance out Kai's more extreme traits, causing him to become a level-headed mentor for Lloyd by the time he and his comrades begin training the Green Ninja. According to Zane, Kai's desire to protect his friends is just as powerful as his temper.

Unlike his sister, Kai likes to spend time with his parents and doesn't mind when his mother tends to baby him, which he likes. He also formed a better relationship with Ray while playing video games at the monastery with Cole.[12]

After the Merge and finding himself in the Land of Monsters, alone, Kai struggled to keep himself hopeful as he navigated for weeks fighting for survival and trying not to lose his humanity in the process. However, despite all the adversities he faced, Kai remained firm on his convictions, even inspiring a fire dragon driven by vengeance against a monster that killed her child to not kill its own unhatched egg and giving a sentient Fire Mech called Rusty, whose master had turned into a monster, a new purpose. However, as he grew tired, Kai eventually reached his limit, as he almost drowns due to a Sea Monster after it lured him with visions of his friends, sister, and master. But after Rusty sacrificed himself to save him, Kai was able to regain his hope and continue his journey to return to Ninjago. Even after years since escaping the Land of Monsters, Kai is showed to still struggling with what he experienced there, not even disclosing the details with the other Ninja, with the exception of Wyldfyre and only because she accidently found out about it and he knew she wouldn't stop pestering him until he told her all about it.

A few years after the Merge, he is showed to have matured quite a lot, finding the perfect balance to his cocky and impulsive personality. While still vain and loving to brag about his skills, Kai has showed a lot more modesty than he used to. Also, despite still being hot-headed and rush into battle, he is now able to focus on the mission and to sort out priorities. This is especially showed when Nokt attacks Imperium to take the souls of the inhabitants, where Kai remained focused in finding a way to better fight the ghosts, even advising Cole, who was engulfed in anger and grief due to Nokt taking the souls of Bonzle, Fritz and Spitz, to not let his emotions cloud his judgment. One factor that contributed to this was becoming Wyldfyre's mentor, which not only gave him someone with whom he could relate, but it also gave him someone he could guide. Through Wyldfyre, Kai's teaching skills that he had developed while teaching Lloyd were able to fully blossom, as not only he was able to teach her how to properly use her elemental power, but also taught her how to calm down her own temper.

Weapons and abilities

Weapons and abilities[]

Abilities[]

  • Fire: Being the Elemental Master of Fire, Kai can manipulate, generate, negate, and control fire. He can create Fire with his own hands and either throw it, use it as boxing gloves, or unleash a burst of flames towards his opponents. He also can withstand high temperatures and walk through fire unharmed. He also has the ability to move fire at will.
    • Smoke emission: Kai can create small blasts of smoke with his hands, as shown in Back in Action! (possibly non-canon).
    • Spinjitzu: Kai knows and can perform Spinjitzu, with his version channeling Fire.
      • Rising Dragon: Kai is capable of performing Rising Dragon through his Spinjitzu.
      • Dragon Spinjitzu: Kai's Spinjitzu can change while being in the First Land after the Merge, having a swirling dragon avatar appear around his tornado.
    • Airjitzu: Kai is capable of performing Airjitzu.
    • Elemental Dragon: Kai unlocked his Fire Dragon after conquering his inner fears and doubts. The dragon allows him to travel quickly through the air and shoot large blasts of Fire that deal devastating damage.
  • Elemental Powers (briefly): When Kai had the Staff of Elements, he obtain the powers of every Elemental Master that participated in the Tournament of Elements.
  • Expert Combatant: Even before his ninja training, Kai is a competent fighter, wielding a sword against the Skulkin when they attacked the blacksmith shop. Kai is also capable of performing hand-to-hand combat against Serpentine, Stone Warriors, and Nindroids. Kai managed to fight Karlof and Ash in the Tournament of Elements. Although Kai lost twice against Karlof, he still managed to put up a fight and had the upper hand in the first half of both fights. In his fight with Ash, Kai mostly fought using his ninja training skills. Once Kai started to use his powers, he managed to defeat Ash. Kai also managed to take on Morro while he was in Lloyd's body. Kai also managed to go toe-to-toe with both Time Twins Krux and Acronix alongside his sister. Kai also managed to fight Kalmaar in a moving truck. He also managed to have the upper hand against his fight with Aspheera, before Pythor intervened to restrain him. Years later after the Merge, Kai skills improved to the point where he managed to fight the wolf warriors and the new Master of Smoke, Cinder, and even predict his attacks. Once Kai learned the Rising Dragon technique, he managed to outmatch Cinder again. After escaping the Nether-Space, Kai made a remarkable fight performance, managing to hold Nokt (who had all the stolen powers from the Tournament of the Sources at the time) and temporarily bring him down in the first half of their fight.
    • Sword Mastery: As Kai's primary weapon is often swords, he is an expert swordsman, easily handling various types of blades. This is best exhibited when he adroitly and swiftly defeated a bunch of Spectral Dragonians alongside Frak with their newly-acquired Reveal Blades.
    • Art of the Silent Fist: Under Master Garmadon, Kai learned the Art of the Silent Fist.
    • Teaching: Kai is shown to be a great teacher, something that is soon demonstrated when he, along with the other original Ninja, trained Lloyd and helped him hone his skills. After Nya sacrificed herself to defeat Kaalmar and Wojira, Kai opened a school to teach martial arts to kids and, despite teaching them to be aggressive and show no mercy, he managed to teach them how to fight. When he becomes Wyldfyre's mentor, his teaching skills were able to blossom, as despite a rough start (due to their similar hot-tempered personalities), he is able to help her to improve her use of her elemental power, while also passing to her tools to help her control her temper and become a better person. Under his tutelage, Wyldfyre would become quite a formidable fighter in her own right. Additionally, he later taught Frak alongside Cole and gave the former some crucial fighting tips.
  • Stealth: Being a ninja, Kai is able to sneak into places without being noticed.
  • Skilled Leadership and Strategy: Before Lloyd became leader, Kai was known to lead the original ninjas to successful battles. And while Kai is often hot-headed or impulsive he is known for his strategic planning, quick thinking and leadership skills, Kai is often second or third in command, taking charge when the leader is unavailable or delegates their role. Kai's leadership skills and strategic planning often save and/or prepare his team for difficult situations as they battle against evil forces. Even without strategy, Kai is capable of quick thinking in times of need. This is seen how he was able to think of a way to battle the Great Devourer by weaponizing the song of the Sacred Flute and being able to find its weak point.
  • Blacksmith: Kai can work as a blacksmith when needed. As seen in "Endings," he was able to melt down the Golden Armor, and reforge it into the weapons it was previously made from. Although, Nya used to tell him he was a terrible blacksmith, as of "Way of the Ninja." Somehow, he was able to gain these skills with hardly any practice at all. By the time the Merge happened, Kai is showed to have improved his blacksmith even more, as in "Fallen Master" he managed to reforge Rusty's body to what it once was.
  • Psychic link: As seen in "Inside the Maze," due to some of Riyu's scales being on Kai, Kai can communicate with Riyu. As seen in "The Sword Shatters," due to their sibling bond, Nya managed to hear Kai who was trapped in the Nether-Space, through a Dragon Ivory stone. With Riyu giving her some of his dragon power, Nya can communicate with Kai. She was eventually able to free him due to her connection with the Dragon Ivory from the Crowns of Horns.
  • Video games: Kai wasn’t very good at playing video games at first, being the first ninja to be cubed in Prime Empire alongside Cole, but he has improved since then. As of "The Spectral Lands", he is proficient in playing video games to the extent where he was able to beat Jay’s Galamorph X-Post high score, although his high score was beaten by Jay soon after.

Weapons[]

  • Swords & katanas: Kai favors swords and katanas in combat.
    • Sword of Fire: He used the Sword of Fire as his primary weapon until it was lost, and then switched to wielding regular katanas.
    • Elemental Blade: He eventually gained an Elemental Blade that allowed him to harness his fire abilities to an even greater degree.
    • Twin katanas: In Season 8: Sons of Garmadon and Season 10: March of the Oni, Kai used two katanas as his main weapons.
    • Golden katana: As of Season 11: Secrets of the Forbidden Spinjitzu, Kai uses his golden katana as his main weapon.
    • Prime Blade: Kai's personal weapon used in Prime Empire. This helped him fight to get the purple Key-Tana.
    • Machete: In Season 13: Master of the Mountain, Kai briefly used a machete as his weapon.
    • Prismatic Blade/Reveal Blade (formerly): In the second half of Dragons Rising Season 3 , Kai wielded a Prismatic Blade against Spectral Dragonians and later had it upgraded to a Reveal Blade, using her to fend off the enemy and free some of the captured souls.
  • Techno Blade: Months after Lloyd defeated the Overlord, Kai, along with the other three ninja (Cole, Jay, and Zane), receive Techno Blades, a weapon which allows the ninja to hack into any electronics.
  • Staff of Elements (briefly): Kai briefly used the Staff of Elements, which contained all the Elemental Powers from all the Elemental Masters in the Tournament of Elements. Granting him the elements of Energy, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Smoke, Amber, Metal, Gravity, Speed, Nature, Light, Shadow, Poison, Form, Mind and Sound.
  • Aeroblade: He also has an Aeroblade (along with Cole, Jay and Zane) that can destroy ghosts.
  • Dragon Blade: In Season 7, Kai used a double-bladed dagger created by his father Ray that is use for combat or to create the Fusion Dragon. It can also be used as the key to unlocking the Ancient Library of Hono Mizu, only when the current Masters of Fire and Water are holding it.
In the Tournament app

In the Tournament app[]

Kai is a playable character in the Tournament app. His teacher version can be purchased for 50,000 studs, his jungle version can be purchase for 250,000 studs, and his special move is Spinjitzu, much like Jay, Cole, Zane, Master Wu, and Sensei Garmadon.

Official descriptions

Official descriptions[]

Original

Ninja of Fire

Weapon of choice: Sword

Elemental color: Red

Strength: Attack

Having proven himself as an equal member of the team, Kai is ready to take on new challenges. He has a strong sense of justice and will fight anything, bend any rule and burn any bridge on his path.

Kai learned the value of team work the hard way but change is hard when you’re used to doing things YOUR way. Once in disbelief of his purpose, Kai now feels destined for greatness and will do anything to find and fulfill his destiny. Sometimes without thinking things through or telling his team mates first. Will he learn how to control the fire that burns inside him?[22]

Rebooted

Kai is the ninja of Fire, and though he is a hero now, he came from humble beginnings.

His father was a trusted ally of Sensei Wu and the two adventured together for many years.

Wu would later hide the map showing the locations of the Four Weapons of Spinjitzu in his friend’s blacksmith shop.

Kai was the last member recruited for the team by Sensei Wu and the last to achieve his full potential (which happened when he saved Lloyd from the belly of an active volcano!) He can be hot-headed and impatient, but is trying to control that.

  • For the first two months of his life his parents called him Ash.
  • Kai once by accident forged a weapon called a 'Swingana' … Part yo-yo, part sword. It was not a big success.
  • When Kai uses his elemental power in a vehicle, it gets powered up and engulfed in flames … which is why flying a hang glider is a bad idea.
  • Once Kai singed off his eyebrows with the sword of fire, but no one noticed because he painted it back on with a black marker.
  • When Kai's sister, Nya, was a baby, he used to juggle hammers to entertain her. When he dropped one on his foot, she laughed the hardest.[23]

Pilot (Museum)

Kai’s impulsive personality, fierce temper and immense drive mirror the fire within him. His strong sense of justice makes him stubborn and he’ll stop at nothing if he has put his mind to it … but this is also the source of his bravery. As older brother to Nya, he is overprotective of her. While Kai’s self-confidence can be overwhelming to some people, this makes him one of the leaders and big personalities in the group.

Kai is the last young ninja to join Master Wu’s ninja training. His impatience with training is significant, as Lord Garmadon has kidnapped his sister. However, while he quickly becomes a skillful warrior and is the first to tame his dragon, he discovers that impatience is the enemy of a great ninja…[24]

Season 1 (Museum)

When the prophecy of the Green Ninja is revealed, Kai is absolutely convinced that he will be the Chosen One and defeat Lord Garmadon in the final battle. In the end, Kai has to put his ego to one side. He discovers that life has a different plan for him and there are more important things than being the best. [25]

Season 2 (Museum)

Once the self-centered rogue, Kai becomes the ultimate team player. He humbly and proudly accepts his role as Lloyd’s mentor, helping the Green Ninja find his true potential. Finally he becomes the hero he’s always wanted to be, willing to give up his own life for the team.[26]

Season 3 (Museum)

Kai feels a little like the world has passed him by. While everyone else is going high-tech, he can’t even use a toaster without setting off fire alarms. He feels like machinery is out to get him, but as time goes on during this adventure, he learns to find a balance between the past and the future.[27]

Season 4 (Museum)

Kai is competitive by nature and Master Chen plans to use that against him. Kai’s always been second to the Green Ninja, but maybe this tournament is his chance to prove how good he really is. Is Kai willing to leave his team behind, only to get ahead? What could compel him to follow his ego...a potential love interest, perhaps?[28]

Season 5 (Museum)

After the loss of Garmadon, Kai made a solemn promise to look after Lloyd, just as Nya cared for him when their parents passed away. So when Lloyd is possessed, Kai takes it very personally! He feels he has to save him single-handedly, but really he needs the whole team. They all have weaknesses, but their individual strengths come together to win the day.[29]

Season 6 (Museum)

Kai loves being a celebrity. He loves being an action figure, he loves the screams of the fans, and all this crazy ninja stuff is kind of getting in the way. He’s not ready for the threat of Nadakhan or to confront his own past, which endangers the team. Like the other ninja he is given three wishes by the Djinn which don’t go to plan. He ends up trapping himself in Nadakhan’s Djinn Blade and only escapes in time to crash Nya’s wedding.[30]

Season 7 (Museum)

Kai has long wondered what happened to his parents, who disappeared when he was a child. All he knew is that they were Elemental Masters, which is why he is devastated when Krux tells him his parents helped the Hands of Time betray Wu and the Elemental Alliance. Always a fighter for justice, Kai now fears he is destined to follow in his mother and father’s traitorous footsteps, and his quest for the truth ultimately leads to an angry confrontation with his father, Ray. Fortunately, Kai learns that Krux had lied, and Kai (and Nya) save Ray from the effects of a Time Punch.[31]

Season 8

Kai’s impulsive personality, fierce temper and immense drive mirror the fire within him. His strong sense of justice makes him stubborn and he’ll stop at nothing if he has put his mind to it … but this is also the source of his bravery. As older brother to Nya, he is overprotective of her. While Kai’s self-confidence can be overwhelming to some people, this makes him one of the leaders and big personalities in the group.[32]

2019 (The Legacy of Kai)

Did you know Kai is the Fire Ninja through and through. He can be impulsive, has a fierce temper, and his strong sense of justice can make him stubborn at times. But his fire is also the source of his bravery and strong loyalty. He will stop at nothing if he has put his mind to a cause or mission. He can be very overprotective with his younger sister, Nya. Kai’s self-confidence can seem a little overwhelming to some people, but his friends know he has the skills to back it up. They trust him with their lives and will follow him everywhere he goes. Favorite NINJAGO® Legacy weapon The Sword of Fire – one of the four Golden Weapons and Kai’s trusty battle companion through thick and thin. Quote “Crime doesn’t pay muchacho. You can take that to the bank.”

2019

Kai - the fiercely determined Fire Ninja!

Self confident, impulisive, determined and brave - Kai is a strong character among the LEGO® NINJAGO® Ninja heroes. If he puts his mind to something he will not stop until he has achieved his aim. That stubborn streak might get Kai in trouble sometimes, but his strong sense of justice is always to be admired.

Kai and his younger sister Nya worked in their father’s blacksmith shop until Master Wu took them under his wing and trained them up to be part of an awesome ninja team. With Wu’s guidance, Kai learned the art of Spinjitzu and how to harness the fire burning inside him to become an Elemental Master of Fire, following in the footsteps of his father who, unbeknown to Kai, had been the previous Elemental Master of Fire (Nya inherited their mother’s elemental mastery of water).

A massive personality in the ninja team, Kai is a hugely popular character with NINJAGO fans who love to role-play with his red-outfitted minifigure, found in many LEGO NINJAGO construction sets.

2020

Clad in red armor with his trusty sword, Kai is the ninja of fire and one of the leaders of NINJAGO’s team of fighting comrades. He expertly guides them with his sense of justice and inherent bravery.

Season 13

Kai finds himself in a peculiar position when he is "elected" leader of a race of subterranean creatures called the Geckles. And the Geckles are even more hotheaded than Kai! They are embroiled in a war with another subterranean race called the Munce, whom they believe have stolen their most precious cultural relic – a mystical sword called the Ivory Blade of Deliverance. Kai finds himself caught in the middle, forced to be the voice of reason when he must broker a peace between them and unite both sides against their true enemy – the Skull Sorcerer.[33]

2021

BE BRAVE, WITH KAI

To have Courage is to be confident you can win any battle. Even when it looks like you could lose, Kai knows a true Master never allows fear to stop them from achieving their potential.

Kai is the Fire Ninja. His strong sence of justice and unparalleled bravery makes him one of the leaders of the group.[34]

Spinjitzu Brothers

Kai is the Fire Ninja. With his fierce temper, bravery, and strong sense of justice, he'll stop at nothing if he has put his mind to it.

2023

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Kai, an original ninja, joins the quest to unravel The Merge. With a fiery temper and unwavering sense of justice, he stands out as one of the group’s prominent personalities.[35]

Etymology

Etymology[]

The name, Kai, means "strong," "victorious," and "recovery," in three Asian cultures, all of which fit his hotshot attitude in the ninja's battles. His name may also be derived from the Japanese word Akai, meaning "red." In Scots, Kai's name means "fire"; matching his elemental power. In Japanese, Kai's name also means "ocean," which annotates his mother's and sister's water abilities. In Hawaiian, Kai's name also means "sea," a further link to his mother's and sister's water abilities.

Names Kai originally had were Dante and Ash,[36] with Ash being the name The Hageman Brothers originally suggested.[37] The name was not used because it was already the name of the protagonist of the Pokémon franchise.[38] Ash was later said on LEGO.com to have been a nickname for Kai when he was young.[23] As Tommy Andreasen was the one who wrote this description in 2012,[39][40] it can be considered canon.[41] Another character similar to Kai ended up using the name Ash, a previous Master of Smoke.

Behind the scenes

Behind the scenes[]

  • Kai and Nya's surname is unknown, though it was considered to be "Smith" behind the scenes, but this is not necessarily canon to the show.[42][43] They were also called this in the 2012 blooper reel.
  • Kai kept his original one-sided head-piece for the longest out of all the six ninja lasting until Season 8: Sons of Garmadon. Except for his Stone Armor variant, which was released as an exclusive small set, his Golden Ninja variant, which was released in a Bricktober pack, and his fusion armor variant in 70627 Dragon's Forge, all of his minifigures have featured him with the same scarred face. However, the Stone Armor minifigure includes Kai's show-accurate head without the scar, and in the Dragon's Forge set, Kai has two brand new face prints, one has a confident smirk and the other has an angry facial expression with orange glowing eyes, representing him using one of the Time Blades. In addition, his Golden Ninja variant had a big, toothy smile on it.
    • Tommy Andreasen explained that Kai's scar was removed for the show because "he looked way too battle-hardened for the story," specifically "for his humble beginnings."[44][45] He also could not receive the scar later because of a broadcasting rule that characters can't receive lasting wounds.[46]
    • Kai's original mouth design was later used on a two recurring faces in the LEGO City theme (and another in reverse).
  • To mirror his movie self's appearance, he now has his scar on the right side of his face as of Season 8.
  • Kai's elemental symbol is the Chinese character "平," meaning "flat" or "peaceful."
  • According to Vincent Tong in the "Ten Years of Spinjitzu" documentary, Kai was originally supposed to have red hair and freckles.[47]
  • Kai's physical minifigure prior to Season 8: Sons of Garmadon had a rubber hairpiece. It was not completely show-accurate, as in the show his hair is thinner and slightly longer in the back.
    • Simon Lucas explained in an interview with Brent Miller that this is because WilFilm basically made a custom hairpiece for Kai.[48]
    • In Shadow of Ronin, Kai's hair looks exactly the same as the rubber hairpiece he dons in the sets. It is in a lighter shade of brown.
  • Like the other ninja, Kai uses his movie counterpart's hairpiece from Season 8 onward, though it was shortened because Tommy Andreasen did not like the size of his hair from the movie,[49] and it is also now a shade of reddish-brown instead of dark brown.
    • Tommy Andreasen responded to a question about Kai's hair change with "All it takes to change a head of hair is a brisk breeze,"[50] though this does not completely explain it as the texture of his hair also changed.
    • His hair-headband combo in The Island is the same height as the set version because it is based on a new, slightly different piece.
  • The rest of Kai's scar below his eye is missing in Season 11. Tommy Andreasen pointed out that they did not notice it until it was too late.[51] He said it would appear again in future seasons.[52]
    • The rest of the scar is also missing for the first 4 episodes of Season 12, up until "I am Okino". This is because Kai's model for Season 11 was still used for those episodes. The model was updated in "Shintaro".
  • According to Tommy Andreasen, Kai's greatest fear was not being liked or included.[53]
  • Kai was originally going to appear as a cameo in the Monkie Kid episode, "Benched", but it was scrapped.[54]
Trivia

Trivia[]

  • Kai is the first character to speak in the franchise.
  • Kai appears to be based off the red ninja from Lego System's Ninja Series.
  • Before Lloyd, Kai was the original main character of Ninjago. The turning point for this was "The Green Ninja," when Kai realized his destiny was not to become the Green Ninja, but to protect him.
    • This is lampshaded when the policeman character in "Winds of Change" asks whether Kai is the "main one."
    • Kai has been the mascot for a lot of the Ninjago set waves; Pilot Episodes, Tournament Of Elements, The Hands Of Time, Legacy, Secrets Of The Forbidden Spinjitzu, and Dragons Rising Season 2.
  • In the original series, Kai is the only ninja and protagonist who has never defeated a main and/or final antagonist alone. Lloyd defeated the Overlord in "Rise of the Spinjitzu Master" and Emperor Garmadon in Green Destiny, Zane defeated the Overlord once again in "The Titanium Ninja," Nya destroyed the Preeminent in "Curseworld, Part II" and defeated Wojira by merging with the sea in "The Turn of the Tide," Jay used his final wish to defeat Nadakhan in "The Way Back," Cole defeated the Skull Sorcerer by using the Spinjitzu Burst in "The Son of Lilly," and Wu prevented the Time Twins from continuing their villainy by losing them in the Time Vortex in "Lost in Time."
    • When asked about this, Tommy Andreasen stated, "We don't work with these check-the-box charts. Not everyone need to blast out of an erupting volcano to save the future green ninja or melt an ice dragon either."[55]
    • It's unclear if him defeating Aspheera in "Dragon Form" would count as him defeating a main antagonist alone as while the latter was the main antagonist in the first half of Secrets of Forbidden Spinjitzu, she is demoted to a general in Crystalized.
  • Kai is the fourth ninja to join the team, the last of the original four to claim his Golden Weapon, the fourth ninja to unlock his True Potential, and the third to last to have a love interest. On the other hand, he was the first ninja introduced in the franchise, the first to tame his respective dragon, and the first ninja to perform Airjitzu.
    • Furthermore, he is the first ninja to perform Rising Dragon and he is the first ninja to appear in the seasons 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6, along with Day of the Departed, opening sequences.
  • He apparently appears to have a fear of Christmas-related subjects, as shown in "Can of Worms," when the Venomari's venom causes him to see things like Santa Claus, gingerbread men, and elves.
  • Kai is mentioned to be thalassophobic during "Stiix and Stones" and to have an extreme fear of large bodies of water. It is ironic, then, that his sister turned out to be the Elemental Master of Water. However, this is a direct contradiction to "Rise of the Spinjitzu Master," in which he stated he would swim the whole ocean to reach Ninjago City from the Dark Island.
    • Ironically, in Hawaiian, Kai's name means "ocean" or "ocean water."
    • Despite his apparent thalassophobia, Kai showed no signs of his fear during the course of Seabound.
      • However, it is possible Kai has overcome his thalassophobia at some point between Possession and Seabound.
      • Nevertheless he dived into the boiling sea and also can swim in Season 7, when he and his sister wanted to get to Hono Mizu.
      • In the sixth episode of Decoded it is mentioned that he wouldn't be able to swim, which does not make sense, since he could swim in Season 7.
      • According to Chris "Doc" Wyatt, when asked about Kai's aquaphobia, he stated that Kai "got over it."[56]
  • He considers Lloyd to be like a younger brother. As of Season 5. This bond between the Red and Green Ninja can be traced to that of the same colors in Chinese mythology and culture.
  • Kai appears to holster the Sword of Fire as if he was left-handed, but uses all other weaponry and tools in his right hand; this might mean Kai is ambidextrous.
    • This may have been confirmed by Season 8 because Kai uses two katanas in this season.
  • The website states that he is often one of the leaders of the group.[57] Though he was never officially considered the leader in the show, he did often take charge in the earlier seasons before Lloyd took the mantle.
  • He had freckles when he was younger, as seen in "A Time of Traitors" and "Pause and Effect." However, they were not present when he was temporarily turned into a child along with the other ninja in "Child's Play."
  • Tommy Andreasen said he did not think Kai uses hair gel to maintain his appearance.[58] This makes sense considering Kai and Nya came from a small, poor village that most likely did not have hair gel and his hairstyle was already spiky before he became a ninja.
    • However, Tommy Andreasen later answered a question saying the brand of hair gel Kai uses is a real-life brand, "Dapper Dan."[59]
      • Ian Hanlin, voice actor for the NEXO Knights character Lance Richmond as well as characters in Ninjago, has said that Lance also uses the same hair gel.[60]
  • He and Zane are currently the only ninja to have their Golden Techno Robe variant as a physical minifigure.
    • The Golden Techno Robe Kai figure is in the Ninjago Toys "R" Us Bricktober pack for 2017.
  • Kai once forged a weapon known as a Swingana, which was a half yo-yo, half sword. It was not a big success.[23]
  • Kai singed his eyebrows off with the Sword of Fire once, but nobody noticed because he drew them back on with black marker.[23]
  • Kai is the second ninja to solely lose their powers due to someone absorbing them, the first being Lloyd.
    • He recovers them in "Fire Maker," albeit in a weak state, and overuse of it can weaken Kai.
    • He fully recovers them in "Awakenings," and kills Boreal with them.
  • Kai is the only character to appear in all Ninjago: Legacy Wave 3 and 5 sets.
  • Kai is the only one out of the ninja who has an avatar in Season 12: Prime Empire that does not have triangle markings on his avatar body.
  • Kai is tied with Cole as the ninja who have worn the most suits in the franchise, with the exceptions of the Scuba gear Zane, Lloyd, Nya, and Jay wore in Seabound and the Tournament of Sources suits that the Ninja wore during the second part of Dragons Rising Season 2. Nya and Lloyd did not wear various earlier suits, having joined the ninja team later; Zane did not wear the Tournament or Digi robes & did not have an Avatar variant, Cole did not have an Avatar variant and a scuba suit in the show, and Jay did not wear his Merge suit in Dragons Rising Season 1 as well as not wearing the Mech pilot or Climber suits in Dragons Rising Season 2 and not wearing the Storm or Ghost Hunter suits in Season 3.
  • In the "Journey to Mastery" video series on LEGO.com, Kai's journey to mastery is primarily courage.[61]
    • Besides the clip from "Superstar Rockin' Jay," all the clips used are from before Season 8.
  • Kai is portrayed as the focus character of the sets for Firstbourne, the Destiny's Wing, the Stone Mech, and Heatwave, despite not being specifically connected to any of them in the show.
  • According to Tommy Andreasen, it is possible that when Ray and Maya disappeared, Kai and Nya were cared for by their friendly neighbors, whom Wu asked for.[62]
  • Kai was the last ninja to have stayed human for the duration of the original series, with him briefly turning into a crystal zombie in "Roots"; Zane is a Nindroid, Jay temporarily changed into a Fangpyre in "Once Bitten, Twice Shy," Cole was transformed into a ghost from "The Temple on Haunted Hill" through "Day of the Departed," Lloyd is part Oni and dragon, and Nya merged with the Endless Sea in "Nyad."
    • He is the only member of the original four ninja to not be corrupted by Dark Matter during Rise of the Spinjitzu Master.
  • He appeared as a Minecraft skin in the set 21160 The Illager Raid from LEGO's Minecraft theme.
    • This is possibly because Season 12: Prime Empire is focused on a video game, and Minecraft respectively is a video game.
    • The suit Kai wears in this set resembles his Sons of Garmadon gi.
  • He is similar to Zuko from Avatar: The Last Airbender, because they are both teenagers with dark brown hair and a scar over their eye, they can control and create fire, at least one of their parents (Maya and Ray for Kai, and Ursa for Zuko) was lost in their childhood and later found, both have a younger sister (Nya and Azula), and both learn to control their anger over the course of the series and realize their original goal is the wrong path. He also worked at a tea shop, lost his powers and regained them through a dragon somehow, wields twin blades, and is friends with a prophesied legendary hero who has the ability to wield multiple elements (Lloyd and Aang).
  • According to Tommy Andreasen in 2017, Kai is probably the ninja with the least development throughout the series, though he did have significant development in Rise of the Snakes, Tournament of Elements and The Hands of Time.[63]
  • According to Tommy Andreasen, if Kai was a YouTuber, his videos would be bad dating tips.[64]
  • According to Bragi Schut, if Kai had a secret hobby, it would be practicing one-liners in the mirror.[65] Jay was previously seen doing this before his date with Nya in "Once Bitten, Twice Shy" as well.
  • The reason Kai did not react to Nya's sacrifice like Jay is, according to Tommy Andreasen, because "People respond in unexpected ways to grief and shock. You'll learn [through] life."[66]
  • During his time in the Land of Madness, Kai gained a fondness for Cragling mud.
  • In "Chaos Unchained," Kai states that he isn't good at math.
  • Chris "Doc" Wyatt thinks Kai would have won the most recent Tournament of the Sources had he not been trapped in Nether-Space.[67]

History

Early life

Early life[]

Kai was born in Ignacia, the first child of blackmiths Maya and Ray who owned the Four Weapons shop. In the first two months of his life, his parents called him "Ash".[1][2] He and his younger sister, Nya, were raised in their father's craft. Unknown to either of them, their parents were the Elemental Masters of Fire and Water. Kai inherited his father's element of Fire, while Nya inherited their mother's ability of Water though they were unaware of this fact at first.

When Kai and Nya were young, Ray would tell them stories of the dragons, mystical creatures that belonged to both the world of the living and of the dead.[3] He would often teach them proverbs such as "No matter how much fire you have, experience isn't something you learn overnight"[4] and "The world works in mysterious ways.[5] At one point, young Kai and Nya met Wu, a friend of their parents.[6]

At some point in their childhood, Kai and Nya invented a game in the Four Weapons Blacksmith they called Counter Shot, using a variety of obstacles and tools such as tables and horseshoes.[7] During a game of Counter Shot, Kai and Nya met a boy who was visiting the shop with his mother. Nya invited the boy over to play Counter Shot with them while Wu and their parents talked.[8]

When his parents disappeared, Kai took it upon himself to keep the family business going, vowing to surpass his father's blacksmith skills.[4] Kai took care of his sister while they wondered all their lives what became of their parents.[9] At one point, the two had a babysitter named Grumbmiller, who they disliked and would trip her when she made them go to bed early.[10] Because Grumbmiller's cooking was subpar, Nya would often volunteer to make dinner.[11]

At school, Kai went on a number of field trips to the Ninjago Museum of History.[12][13]

Pilot episodes

Pilot episodes[]

Way of the Ninja[]

One day while working, Kai explained to Nya how to properly make a sword, but became too impatient and thus produced a disfigured weapon. He was reminded by his sister to be more patient, but were interrupted when an old man entered the shop. The potential customer voiced complaints concerning the lack of tools for ninja and Kai quickly shooed him away.

Shortly thereafter, Ignacia fell under attack by Samukai and his Skeleton army. Kai attempted to defend them with samurai armor, though it proved to be slow and clunky. While he managed to defeat several skeleton foot soldiers, he was quickly subdued by Samukai. Pinned down by his armor, Kai would have fallen victim to the Skulkin General had the old man—Master Wu—not returned and saved him. However, while they were preoccupied, the skeletons kidnapped Nya and escaped to the Underworld. The young blacksmith intended to go after them, but was stopped by Wu. He explained to Kai the story of the First Spinjitzu Master and his two sons who fought over the four Golden Weapons, explaining that an honest man—Kai's father—had been entrusted with the map to their resting places. Kai was advised by Wu to become a ninja to save his sister, and Kai reluctantly agreed.

Kai was taken to the Monastery of Spinjitzu in order to be trained as a ninja and learn Spinjitzu. During his training, Kai had to learn patience and how to harness the "fire" inside of him. This training consisted of running a course before Master Wu finishes his tea. Kai accomplished this after several days and did so by knocking the teacup out of his Master's hands when he was about halfway through the course. He was then told by Wu that he had one final test the next day, and should get some sleep.

The Golden Weapon[]

Later that night, while Kai was pondering Master Wu's training while brushing his teeth, he was set upon by three black-suited ninja. Their fight took them out to the courtyard where Kai activated the training course to even the odds. They were quickly stopped by Wu, who revealed that the three ninja were his students as well. Wu then used Creation to give each of the ninja a suit that matched their elemental properties and pronounced Kai as the red Master of Fire. After Wu explained their purpose, he announced that they would now leave to claim the first Golden Weapon.

On the way there, Kai and the others explained where and how Master Wu found them. Kai revealed that he is journeying to the Underworld to save his sister, to which Jay replied "We're saving a girl? Is she hot?"

Once they arrived at the Caves of Despair, Kai ran ahead of the other ninja while Cole was still formulating a plan. The others caught up to him at Samukai's watchtower, and after Zane stole the map of Golden Weapons, Kai raced ahead again. The other ninja followed him into one of the caves and found him attempting to remove a large boulder from blocking a hidden room. They did so, and Cole reminded him that they were a team as they moved it together. Inside they found the Scythe of Quakes, and removed it from its resting place. On their way out, Jay accidentally revealed their position to the skeleton army, and they were soon in a battle. After Jay discovered the key to unlocking his Spinjitzu, Kai and the others were quick to follow. They used it to drive off the skeleton army, after which they discovered that they had a bigger problem in the form of the weapon's guardian, the Earth Dragon. Kai happened to be holding the Scythe at the time and decided that the only way out was to use it, contrary to Master Wu's instructions. After escaping, Kai was strictly reprimanded by Master Wu, and they went onward toward the next weapon, the Shurikens of Ice.

King of Shadows[]

While on their way to the Frozen Wasteland, the location of the Shurikens of Ice, Wu told the ninja about the most powerful technique in Spinjitzu, the Tornado of Creation. Kai began to attempt it but was stopped by Master Wu, who explained that it could lead to disastrous consequences if done incorrectly.

After they succeeded in finding the Shurikens, the ninja ascended to the Floating Ruins for the Nunchucks of Lightning. After retrieving it, they used Jay's gliders to descend into the Forest of Tranquility, where they made camp. Kai was later awoken in the middle of the night and lured to the Fire Temple by Garmadon, who was pretending to be his sister. Kai was forced to remove the Sword of Fire from its pedestal to cut a chain and save his sister from falling. He was then attacked and defeated by his own shadow under Garmadon's manipulation, but Master Wu arrived before the dark lord could claim the sword. Realizing it had just been a trap to lure them away from the other ninja, the three attempted to escape but were stopped by the Fire Dragon. As a last resort, Wu sacrificed himself and ventured into the Underworld with the Sword of Fire. While his act kept the four Golden Weapons apart, Kai and Nya were still left in the hands of the Fire Dragon.

Weapons of Destiny[]

Luckily the Fire Dragon soon realized that they were simply trying to protect the weapons, and by the time the other ninja arrived, Kai and Nya had befriended the Dragon. They assembled the other guardian dragons and mounted them cross over into the Underworld.

Once there, the ninja attempted to use the stalactites to sneak past the guards of the Skulkin fortress but accidentally grabbed onto the legs of a Spykor. Out of fear, Kai and the others fell to the ground outside the fortress where they were quickly surrounded by Skulkin and Spykors alike. With their options limited Jay suggested they perform the Tornado of Creation and the ninja successfully performed the technique, turning the fortress into a Ferris Wheel prison. The ninja descended into the throne room where Master Wu was dueling Samukai for the Golden Weapons. Kai forbade the other ninja to interfere as it was their master's fight. Wu was quickly defeated, but when Samukai took the Sword of Fire, a portal between dimensions was formed, and Samukai was destroyed. This allowed Garmadon to escape from the Underworld.

Knowing that he would one day return, Kai took the Sword of Fire and vowed to protect it, as did the others with their respective weapons.

Kai and the other ninja returned to Four Weapons where they were reunited with Nya and assured the villagers they would be ready when Garmadon returned.

Mini-movies

Mini-movies[]

Flight of the Dragon Ninja[]

The ninja were told to train by Master Wu but instead opted to spend their time racing their dragons. Jay won the race and began bragging about his skills. Kai and the others challenged him to another race over the forest and back, with the winner becoming "Dragon Master" for a month. Zane objected, feeling that the ninja should be training, to which Kai replied that riding their dragons was a form of training.

The race begins, and Kai and Zane flew their dragons over the clouds, where they briefly dueled each other with their dragons' elemental breaths. On the home stretch, they were all neck-and-neck, but Cole won when he "activated the turbo"—a roasted chicken dangled in front of his dragon's nose. Once the others landed, Kai congratulated Cole on the win but said that they would get him the next day. Cole reminds the others that the winner was supposed to be "Dragon Master" for a month, and Kai and the others denied ever agreeing to the bet.

The New Masters of Spinjitzu[]

One night, Nuckal and Kruncha infiltrated the Monastery of Spinjitzu to steal the Golden Weapons from the ninja while they slept. Although the theft went off without a hitch, Kai was awoken when the Skulkin Generals lost control of the weapons and accidentally activated the training course. Half-asleep, Kai went outside to shut the course off, irritably reminding Jay that he had to repair whatever flaw was causing it to turn itself on. With that, Kai went back to sleep, completely unaware of Kruncha and Nuckal's presence in the monastery. They quickly returned the Weapons to the ninja with haste and returned to the Underworld.

Return to the Fire Temple[]

While taking a ride on the Fire Dragon, Kai and Nya were suddenly taken to the Fire Temple. After dismounting the Dragon, Flame led Kai to a passage connecting Ninjago to the Underworld. Kai started planning what to do when the ground falls out from beneath him. He found out that the Skulkin were assembling to reenter Ninjago, and got caught in a fight. He fought back, but they picked him up, disarming him. Nya and Flame then shot a blast of fire, which scared the Skulkin away and seals the passage to the Underworld.

Rise of the Snakes

Rise of the Snakes[]

Rise of the Snakes[]

With peace throughout Ninjago, Kai and the other ninja fell out of training and instead spent their time playing video games. After a three hour marathon, they were interrupted by Wu who unplugged the TV. He encouraged them not to put off tomorrow what could be done today, and to start training again to

prepare for his brother's return to Ninjago. Kai reminded his Master that if Garmadon is to show up, they have the Tornado of Creation. Wu sighed and told him and the others that they had barely scratched the surface of unlocking their True Potentials. Cole turned the TV back on, and the ninja continued playing.

At that moment, Nya rushed in, bringing word that Garmadon was spotted in Jamanakai Village. The out-of-shape ninja rushed out the door and down to the dragon pen where Kai mounted the Fire Dragon with the Nya's help.

Eager to get back into the fight, the ninja raced each other to Jamanakai Village. Upon arrival, Kai argued with Jay about who had arrived first. They were interrupted by the sound of evil laughter from the village, and they drew their weapons. They approached the village but were surprised to find that it was, in fact, Lloyd Garmadon, the dark lord's son, who was causing trouble. Lloyd threatened to release the serpentine, an ancient race of snakes that once ruled Ninjago unless they give him candy. The ninja tied him to the top of a sign and embarrassed him in front of the villagers as they mocked him by eating candy.

As they prepared to return to the monastery, Kai discovered a scroll in Wu's bag which he had taken by mistake. They read it and learned of the Prophecy of the Green Ninja. It was said that one ninja will rise above the others and become the Green Ninja. The scroll was also inscribed with drawings that are identical to the four ninja, with a fifth ninja in the middle. Kai believed himself to be the Green Ninja, as did the others, so when they returned to the monastery, the four Spinjitzu masters challenged themselves to a tournament for the title. Kai faced off against Jay in the first round and won, thus moving on to the final round against Cole. However, the tournament ended when Kai lost control of the Sword of Fire and the ninja were scolded by Master Wu.

Determined to be the Green Ninja, Kai and the others devoted themselves to training. They were soon ordered back to Jamanakai Village and find that Lloyd had unleashed the Hypnobrai tribe of Serpentine. Kai once again mounted the Fire Dragon and upon arriving at the village, met up with Nya. The ninja found that the Hyprobrai had the ability to hypnotize their victims into doing their bidding, and were doing so to the villagers. After discovering they would need the anti-venom from the Snake General's staff to save the village, the ninja split up and after a fight with the snakes, sent them retreating. After the villagers had been cured of their hypnotism, Kai presented Wu with the staff and apologized for their lazy behavior earlier. With a new threat now upon them, Kai and the others returned to the monastery determined to unlock the secrets of their Golden Weapons and to reach their True Potential.

Home[]

In the days that followed, Kai devoted himself to training at the monastery. While he was practicing Spinjitzu, Zane iced the course over, causing Kai to slip. He complained about Zane's strange behavior to Jay and Cole, only to be approached by Master Wu who noted that brothers are often different. Kai remembered one night when he went into the kitchen for a midnight snack, only to find that Zane had consumed everything but the cheese. The ninja's conversation was interrupted by the arrival of the Mailman who had a fan letter for Kai, and other mail for Cole and Jay. They made note that nothing has come for Zane, and Zane revealed that he has been an orphan all his life.

That night, Kai and the others gathered in the dining room and were surprised to see Zane emerge from the kitchen wearing a pink apron. The ninja laughed, and Zane failed to find it amusing. Cole dumped a plate of food on Kai's head and shortly after a food fight breaks out.

The next day, Zane told the others that last night he followed a mysterious bird to Lloyd's treehouse fortress. Together, they headed into the Forest of Tranquility and found it exactly where Zane said it would be.

Determined to destroy it before it becomes operational, Kai and the other ninja snuck into it and destroyed its supports. They reached the last support, but Cole, who was hypnotized by a serpentine earlier, turns on them. Before long, Master Wu came riding in on Flame playing an ancient flute, which canceled the Serpentine's powers. The group returned to the Monastery on Flame and discovered the Serpentine had set fire to it in order to steal back their staff.

Zane asked Shard to put the fire out but, the Monastery was beyond repair. Kai and the others verbally attacked Zane but Master Wu caught them reminding them that Zane was their teammate and had them apologize. Before they could, Zane flew off on Shard. Kai and the others assume that he was so hurt by their words that he ran away. Later on, the ninja ate around a fire on a cliff, homeless, until Nya noticed Zane entering the camp. He revealed to them that he was not hurt by their words, but saw the falcon again, and followed it to an abandoned ship. He told them that was their new home, and that he made them dinner.

Kai and the others joyfully ran towards their new home, ready to eat Zane's home-cooked food.

Snakebit[]

After arriving on Destiny's Bounty they found that it is in disrepair. Master Wu made the ninja clean up their new home while he ran an errand with Nya, which they were reluctant to do.

They proceeded in cleaning it up, dusting the sail, cleaning the cabins, and reworking the electronics. When finished, they put all the trash and junk in the bin outside.

Later on, while the ninja were relaxing, Jay's parents, Ed and Edna, arrive. They were given the tour of the Bounty by Jay, but he insisted that they leave due to the threat of the Serpentine. While there, they revealed that Jay was born in a junkyard, a fact which Jay is embarrassed about. Eventually, his parents were reluctant to go but leave before dark. Before going they implored that Jay visits them sometime soon. Jay agreed, and they headed out.

The next day as they were doing work on the bridge, the other ninja tried to convince Jay to visit his parents. Although he was reluctant at first, he agrees to go. He went to mount Wisp but found that he had no interest in going anywhere. Master Wu told the ninja that their dragons were molting, and were to return to the Spirit Coves in order to reach maturity. The ninja were disheartened, and Jay asked Nya to accompany him on the long walk. Kai and the others thought he wanted them all to go, and so the whole team accompanied him.

When the ninja arrive, they found Jay's parents nowhere to be found, until they found them locked in an old refrigerator. They learned that another tribe of serpentine, the Fangpyre, had bitten Jay's parents and infected them with venom, slowly turning them into serpentine.

Kai and the other ninja were ambushed by the Fangpyre, who, lead by Lloyd, had turned the whole junkyard into a snake infected area. Kai and the others defeated the snakes and attempted to escape. Master Wu told them that they could get out of there faster by turning their Golden Weapons into vehicles. Kai turned his sword into a bike and drove away as the others did the same. They escaped with Jay's parents after stealing the Snake General's staff, returned to the Bounty, and cured Ed and Edna with the anti-venom. The Bounty was rocked to the side by one of the Fangpyre helicopters, and they dropped the staff, returning it to the serpentine and Lloyd.

Never Trust a Snake[]

Zane was woken up with a start one morning and recalled that he had a dream. Kai and the others asked him what it was about, and he told them that he saw the green ninja. The ninja implored him to elaborate, but Master Wu interrupted and reminded them that it is time for training.

On the deck, Wu teached them different poses, all the while they were ignoring him to learn more about the dream. Wu caught them slacking off, and told them that as punishment they must train all day and come up with the answer to a riddle, "What is the best way to defeat an enemy?" Kai failed to interpret the riddle along with the other ninja, so Master Wu left them to train.

Zane finished telling them about the dream, and Kai assumed himself to be the green ninja, due to his fists being aflame. The ninja argued over who was the real green ninja and got back to training.

Later on, they found out that a boarding school had been attacked by Lloyd and an unknown Serpentine member, (who was later revealed to be Pythor.)

The Destiny's Bounty took them there, where they dropped through the roof of the building on an anchor. Kai and the others chased the panicking Lloyd through the building until they reached the roof. There, Pythor stole Lloyd's map of the Serpentine Tombs and disappeared. The ninja took Lloyd back to the Bounty and found that Master Wu was reading him a bedtime story.

They were confused as to why he was read a bedtime story after causing so much trouble, and Master Wu revealed the answer to the riddle- the best way to defeat your enemy, is to make him your friend.

Can of Worms[]

Kai discovered one day that all of his high scores had been replaced by Lloyd who at the time blamed it on Cole.

Lloyd screwed with the other ninja's hobbies as well, ruining Jay's robot, Cole's chili, and turning Zane's gi pink, but he was eventually caught, and reprimanded by the ninja. They tried to snitch on him to Wu, but he revealed that he put Lloyd up to it to teach the ninja "the destructive power of rumors."

After this turn of events, Nya revealed that she had located the Constrictai and Venomari serpentine tombs. Kai and Jay took the Venomari tomb while Zane and Cole took the Constrictai tomb.

They arrived in the Toxic Bogs and found that the tomb had already been opened. They soon found that they were being ambushed. Kai was intoxicated with Venomari venom and began to see elves and gingerbread men attacking him. Jay attempted to protect him while Kai is trembling from the visions. Cole and Zane arrived but were followed by Pythor and the Constrictai. As the two tribes surrounded them, the ninja believed they will not survive the next attack.

Kai hallucinated that a rope was in front of him, only for an actual rope to appear moments later. Suddenly, a mysterious Samurai in a massive robotic mech appeared and scared away the Serpentine. The Samurai saved the ninja but knocked them unconscious. They were soon saved by Wu in the Bounty.

Back on the ship, the ninja were eating dinner (while Kai was still intoxicated,) while telling Lloyd and the others about the mysterious samurai. Kai insisted that he had weapons coming out from every part of him, but the ninja reminded the others that he was sprayed with the Venomari venom.

They got an alert later on that the Serpentine had been spotted in Ninjago City, and the ninja quickly ascended there, expecting to find a massive serpentine gathering in the streets (at this point Kai's intoxication wears off.) They found that the Serpentine had gathered underneath the city, and ventured below.

They found Pythor giving a speech to the serpentine tribes, attempting to unite them. The ninja knew this was a bad sign, so they used the destructive power of rumors to try and ruin his assembly. They were eventually caught and were chased throughout the sewers. Kai, Cole, and Jay were quickly captured, and Zane was left trying to escape from them.

After using his pink gi to distract the snakes, he broke out Kai and the others and they escaped, having ruined Pythor's plans.

Later on, back on the Bounty, Lloyd apologized for messing with the ninja's things and revealed that he had cleaned Zane's gi.

The Snake King[]

The ninja were eating breakfast talking about the Samurai when Kai offered the other ninja a bet: whoever found out the identity of Samurai X, they will be the best and the green ninja.

The ninja agreed to the terms but were interrupted by the arrival of the mailman, who had brought them their new ninja suits. As they were checking the new merchandise, they got an alert that some snakes had been spotted at Mega Monster Amusement Park. They put on their new suits, and arrived at the park to find that the serpentine had already been apprehended by the Samurai.

The ninja made it their mission to catch this samurai, and they split up separately to do so. Kai attempted to capture him when he found him in the Wildwood Forest but he quickly captured Kai in a net.

Later, when it was his turn to look after Lloyd, he dropped him off at an arcade, then left, hoping to find the Samurai. After finding Lloyd missing, the ninja went looking for him at the Lost City of Ouroboros.

The ninja got trapped in a cage that Pythor set up knowing they would come, and stole their golden weapons. He forced them to battle the Samurai X to entertain the other Serpentine, and they found out that they were no match for him.

In a strange turn of events, the Samurai helped them escape while stealing back their Golden Weapons.

The ninja and Samurai X crash landed somewhere nearby and were left scattered. Kai regrouped himself and found that he landed near the Samurai. He walked up to him and found that their secret identity was none other than his sister the whole time! Nya implored him that he doesn't tell the others her secret, to which he told her about the bet he made with them.

He sees what this meant to her, and agreed to keep quiet. Nya gave him back the Golden Weapons, and he and the ninja returned home separately than Nya.

Back at the Bounty, the others interrogated Kai about the encounter he had with the Samurai. Stumbling over her pronouns, he told them that she- he, just handed him the Golden Weapons and left, which was a lie. The ninja had a hard time believing this but carried on their meal.

Tick Tock[]

As the ninja continued to train, they became capable of impressive feats; Kai was able to run across a long path of red-hot coals with no ill effects. Later, he timed Zane as he sat underwater, expressing bewilderment as his white-clad ally remained beneath the waves for over ten minutes. After Zane finally returned to the ship, Kai and the others began speculating whether they had reached their full potential, and decided to ask Master Wu before they jumped to conclusions.

When Kai and the others found Master Wu, he was packing his things, seemingly in preparation for a journey. Kai presented the ninja's question, but Wu quickly shut down the notion. He told them that when they find the key, they will know.

They changed the topic, and asked their Master about the katana he is holding, and he told them the story.

When Wu and Garmadon were young they were the best of friends. One day while they were playing sword fighting in the monastery, Wu's blade was knocked over the fence. Fearing that their father would be mad, Wu refused to go and retrieve it. His brother reminded him not to put off until tomorrow what can be done today, and went after it himself.

Garmadon hopped the wall, and reached for the blade, only to be bitten by a snake. He fell ill, and Wu reminded the others that that snake was the Great Devourer, the same snake that Pythor wanted to resurrect. . . Its venom turned his brother into the Dark Lord.

After his story, he said that he was leaving to find someone who could be of aid in finding Lloyd.

Later, Kai and the others put posters up to find the Fangblades, which Pythor needed to resurrect the Devourer. Zane stopped putting up the flyers and noticed the Falcon. The others remarked that whenever they follow it, it brought them good fortune, so they chased after it. They followed it through Ninjago, hoping it will lead them to a Fangblade.

After chasing it for miles, Kai and the others began succumbing to exhaustion, telling Zane to continue following the Falcon into a snowy woodland.

The ninja eventually picked themselves up and found Zane to be horrified by something he had uncovered in an old workshop; Zane was an android. Kai and the others still accepted him and didn't seem bothered by the revelation, they even thought it's pretty cool (with Jay referring to Zane as a "Nindroid.")

The other ninja left Zane to think and immersed back outside. Creatures referred to as Treehorns attacked them, and they were quickly defeated by them. Zane returned and found his friends in trouble, and helped fight back.

The queen treehorn emerged, but using his newfound powers, Zane freezed the Queen as the other Treehorns retreated. While the other ninja were happy for Zane for being the first to unlock his True Potential, Zane proclaimed with confidence that they were going to find Pythor.

Once Bitten, Twice Shy[]

While watching Nya explain the venom process of a Fangpyre, Jay tried to impress her with men's cologne but found out that Kai and the others had pranked him by giving Jay perfume, which Nya was allergic to.

Later on, the ninja found that a Fangblade was at Mega Monster Amusement Park, and prepared to go there to acquire it. Jay attempted to go on a date with Nya at the park but Kai warned him not to, telling him "to get his priorities straight."

The ninja discovered a ride that had Serpentine activity near it. The ninja discovered the Serpentine excavating the Fangblade and Kai declared a fight. Kai gained the upper hand in the fight along with the others but a mistake on Zane's part caused them to get frozen from one of his attacks. Kai and the others escaped their confinement and Jay was revealed to have gained his True Potential while Nya was discovered by all the other ninja to be Samurai X.

Kai bragged that he was the first to have found out and therefore should be the green ninja, but the other ninja claimed to not remember ever discussing that.

The Royal Blacksmiths[]

The ninja, upset at losing the Fangblade, brainstormed for where the next Fangblade would be. Cole brought up that he knew about a trophy called the Blade Cup that seemed to be a Fangblade that his father once won at a talent show.

The ninja went to Cole's father and disguised themselves as dancers as to not cause suspicion around Cole's dad, who was unaware of Cole being a ninja.

They discovered the Blade Cup was located at a talent show and entered it as a cover to steal it. Lou trained Kai and the others to dance, however, the Serpentine had also discovered the Fangblade's location and disguised themselves as people in the audience, judges, and performers.

The ninja were preparing inside the backstage of Concert Hall. However, Jay and Kai began arguing when they continuously messed up the routine. Cole interrupted by saying that they will be leaving soon after their theft, Jay replying that they should try to win it. Having overheard the conversation, Lou confronted them about it. Cole took the opportunity to explain to him the situation of having lied to his father for many years, revealing that he is a ninja. He informed Lou that if they do not steal it themselves, the Serpentine will instead. Regardless, Lou was unaccepting of his son for wanting to steal the prize, storming out of the room. While the ninja comforted Cole, a group of disguised Serpentine called the Treble Makers appeared backstage. Kai heard Pythor's voice from the crowd, peering out from behind the curtains to see the General among the judges.

The other judges said that Pythor looks nothing like how he did in the photo, Pythor coming up with an excuse before the voice of the former judge alerted the others of his situation from Pythor's stomach. The other judges gazed in disbelief, Pythor quickly persuading the noisy judge to quiet down.

Kai told the ninja of the Serpentine, and when Jay finally agreed to steal the Blade Cup, Cole instead decided that they will win it.

The Treble Makers singed on stage, the crowd booing as Pythor gave the performance a perfect ten. The other judges each gave it a six, but Pythor intimidated them into flipping their scorecards.

The ninja were called up on stage, though as they linger backstage, Zane confessed to having butterflies in his stomach. They then shared a few encouraging words among themselves, going on stage by the name of Spin Harmony. As they danced in perfect sync, Skales ordered the Hypnobrai to attack. However, the attack only intensified their performance, the ninja incorporating defending themselves in their routine. When the Fangpyre joined the ambush, Cole then used the opportunity to perform the Triple Tiger Sashay with success.

The ninja won the talent show and Cole's father was proud that they won the trophy without cheating as the Serpentine tried to do. Pythor then attacked and nearly killed Cole's father, but Cole protected him and gained his True Potential while the Serpentine managed to steal the Fangblade, making Kai the only ninja left to find his True Potential.

The Green Ninja[]

Master Wu finally returned and surprises them by bringing Lord Garmadon, who had now grown four arms.

Kai attacked Garmadon, assuming the worst, but Master Wu revealed that he was helping them search for Lloyd and ordered the ninja to respect him during their temporary alliance.

Kai got more skeptical about Lord Garmadon and at one point overheard a conversation about the green ninja between Nya and Master Wu. Lord Garmadon discovered Kai eavesdropping and the two fought, only to be broken up by Nya and Master Wu.

Later on, Kai searched for the Golden Weapons and discovered Garmadon was holding them. Thinking he was stealing them, Kai battled Garmadon and "won." He expected to have unlocked his true potential, however, Garmadon revealed that he allowed himself to be defeated, as he was only fetching the weapons for the ninja since they were heading over to their destination; this was confirmed when Master Wu told Kai that he was the one who told Garmadon to fetch them. Realizing this, the other ninja scolded Kai for his foolishness, leaving him humiliated. Despite the situation taken care of, Kai still retained his suspicion towards Garmadon.

After discovering the next Fangblade was located at the Fire Temple, the Destiny's Bounty arrived there and the group traveled inside. They watched as the Serpentine dug for the Fangblade, Jay quickly pointing out Lloyd's location in a cage. Rattla uncovered the Fangpyre Fangblade, much to Pythor's pleasure. While Pythor gleefully gazed at the Fangblade, he noticed the ninja in the reflection and ordered the tribes to attack.

The ninja quickly fended them off, though as Pythor left the Temple, he commanded Bytar and Chokun to drill holes in the walls to allow the rising lava to quicken. Jay announced that they must leave as the Temple was becoming unstable, but Lord Garmadon ran after the Serpentine in an attempt to retrieve his son. Seeing that Lloyd was causing the trouble, Pythor ordered the Serpentine to get rid of the caged boy by dropping him to the landing below. Lord Garmadon continued to fight the Serpentine to get the cage, finally reaching it and pulling up his son before his cage could fully melt in the lava.

Kai then rushed up the steps in order to obtain the Fangblade, flinging the Sword of Fire at the Fangblade impaling it in the wall. A furious Pythor attempted to pull it out, but Skales alerted him that they must leave at once, Pythor complying as the lava shot up at them. Everyone except for Kai met up at the exit and Lloyd called out to his missing teammate as Kai made his way to the Fangblade.
