Believing they needed answers before risking anyone else entering the game, Kai accompanied the ninja to the police station to interrogate the Mechanic. He slammed a file bearing the strange symbol onto the table and demanded to know what the symbol meant. As the questioning continued, Kai listened while the Mechanic reacted to the name "Unagami" and boasted that the mysterious figure would soon control everything. When the Commissioner reported that arcade machines across Ninjago City had transformed into Prime Empire overnight, Kai connected the phenomenon to the strange energy pulse that had been released when Jay restarted the game, suggesting that the two events were related.

Learning that Milton Dyer had created Prime Empire before going into hiding, Kai traveled with the ninja aboard the Destiny's Bounty to Dyer Island in search of answers. Upon arriving, Kai joked that the island's neglected condition showed that Dyer's gardener must have disappeared decades ago as well. After the ninja reached the Dyer Mansion, Kai humorously remarked that the property needed a hedge trimmer before activating the front-door knocker, which launched the entire team back across the island with a hidden catapult. On their second attempt to reach the mansion, Kai helped the ninja survive the elaborate security system protecting the estate. After dodging deadly lasers, moving hedge walls, robot dogs, and numerous traps, Kai warned that Dyer had prepared the entire garden with booby traps. When Zane determined they could not outrun the robot dogs, Kai immediately changed tactics, calling for everyone to fight instead. He used Spinjitzu to destroy one robot dog and later hurled another directly into the statues' laser beams, draining its power and helping disable the robotic attackers. Kai also warned his teammates about the continuous laser fire as they worked together to escape the collapsing maze.

Once Bob the Intern turned off the traps, he took the ninja inside the mansion as he explained about Milton Dyer, who was absent. While Bob prepared an old videotape, Kai examined Dyer's collection of abandoned game concepts, commenting on several projects before watching Dyer's recorded message about Prime Empire. After seeing the recording interrupted by the same mysterious flash of light that had appeared when Jay entered the game, Kai listened as Bob explained that Dyer had secretly made unauthorized changes to the project before being fired by the company. As Bob revealed that Dyer had vowed to make everyone regret dismissing him, Kai realized the pieces of the mystery fit together. While the others considered the clues, Kai voiced the conclusion first, prompting everyone to hastily assume that Milton Dyer and Unagami were the same person. Understanding the danger, Kai declared that they had to stop him before anyone else was taken into Prime Empire.

Level Thirteen[]

Kai accompanied the ninja to Borg Tower, where they met with Cyrus Borg to learn more about Prime Empire. When Borg praised Milton Dyer's brilliance as a designer, Kai remarked that Dyer had also created an impressive security system on Dyer Island, complete with robot dogs. As Borg analyzed the arcade cabinet, he revealed that Prime Empire was a massive virtual world divided into three zones and that over 800 players had become trapped inside it. Kai immediately realized that these victims were the same people who had reached Level 13 and disappeared into the arcade cabinets. He also learned that the game's virtual world was controlled by Unagami, whom the ninja believed to be Milton Dyer’s avatar in Prime Empire. After Borg explained that they were only two ways to stop Unagami, Kai agreed with Lloyd's plan to split up, allowing Zane and P.I.X.A.L. to search for Milton Dyer in Ninjago while the others prepared to enter the game and stop Unagami. As Cole played the game to reach Level 13, however, the Mechanic, Ultra Violet, Captain Soto, and a large group of escaped prisoners raided Borg Tower in an attempt to steal the original Prime Empire cabinet on Unigami's behalf.

As the inmates advanced through the building, Kai wanted to intercept them immediately and urged the ninja to fight them. Cyrus Borg refused, warning that the tower's automated defenses would attack the ninja as well, and instructed them instead to focus on reaching Level 13 before the criminals reached the top floor. The ninja turned their attention to Cole, only to discover that Cole had not even started playing because he was still customizing his avatar. Shocked, Kai exclaimed in disbelief that Cole had not begun the game. When the escaped prisoners finally reached the top floor, Kai joined the battle alongside the other ninja. As Captain Soto charged forward, Kai and Zane used their elemental powers in an attempt to stop him, but Soto laughed off the attack, as it only created a puddle. Kai continued fighting the inmates, knocking one of them to the ground. Once Cole finally completed the level, the Prime Empire cabinet activated and invited the ninja to enter the game. Kai immediately broke away from the battle with Captain Soto and rushed toward the arcade cabinet alongside the others.

Superstar Rockin' Jay[]

Kai and the rest of the ninja embarked on their search for Jay within Prime Empire, encountering the Red Visors along the way. The Red Visors revealed their laser blasters and declared their intention to eliminate the ninja. Kai's expression turned grim, confirming the severity of the situation. Despite their efforts to use Spinjitzu and their Elemental Powers, the ninja discovered that they were ineffective. Seeking shelter, the ninja regrouped. Kai, frustrated, expressed his dismay, questioning why he couldn't go a moment without losing his Elemental Powers. They continued to fight the Red Visors, with Kai landing a punch but hurting his hand in the process. Soon, Kai was taken aback as he saw "Jay" fighting against a Red Visor. He immediately informed his friends, who appeared to be witnessing similar encounters involving different versions of Jay. Perplexed by the existence of multiple Jays, Beta Jay 137 disclosed that he and his team were part of an organization known as the League of Jay. Kai's disbelief was evident as he questioned whether they were referring to the Lightning Ninja.

In the midst of a drone attack, the ninja and League of Jays found themselves surrounded. While the League of Jays easily defeated the drones, Kai and the ninja struggled to take down even one. In a daring move, Kai jumped onto the face of a drone, but was quickly blasted off by its laser. The force sent him flying off the building, resulting in his death. However, to his surprise, Kai found himself alive again, realizing that they were in a video game and he had respawned. He chuckled at the realization that none of it was real. The ninja suddenly came across three Red Visors up ahead. Lloyd, Nya, and Cole found hiding spots, but Kai stood out in the open without fear. Concerned for his safety, Nya urged Kai to hide, but he dismissed her worries, since they were in a video game. Determined to create a diversion, Kai approached the Red Visors and began taunting them by insulting Unagami. Enraged, the Red Visors retaliated by firing their weapons at Kai, chasing him down the alley and shooting him. Kai respawned beside the ninja. Kai declared that "respawn" was his new favorite word. However, Cole expressed his doubts about the wisdom of Kai's actions, particularly in the context of gaming. Kai dismissed Cole's concerns, shrugging him off and suggesting that Cole was simply upset because he, as the team's gaming expert, did not come up with the discovery himself. With a sense of pride, Kai confidently marched away. As the ninja reached their destination, a desolate parking lot, they found themselves perplexed by the unexpected circumstances. Kai, expressing his earlier concerns, voiced his opinion about the League of Jays, deeming them as eccentric individuals. He firmly believed that anyone who possessed such an intense admiration for Jay couldn't possibly be considered rational.

Kai and the rest of the ninja found themselves face-to-face with the ally Beta Jay 137 had mentioned. Nya swiftly shared the password with the ally, who then introduced himself as Scott. With a sense of trust established, Scott invited the ninja and Kai into his garage. Kai stumbled upon a device, unaware of its potential danger. Scott urgently warned him not to touch it, but Kai's curiosity got the better of him. He pressed the button, triggering a fatal explosion. Kai found himself instantly revived next to Scott. He marveled at the concept of infinite lives, only to be corrected by Scott. In Prime Empire, they were only granted four lives, and Kai had already used up three. Feeling betrayed, Kai lashed out at the other ninja for not telling him, despite ignoring Cole earlier. Kai asked Scott about the consequences of losing all four lives. Scott warned him that the outcome was dreadful. Scott guided Kai and the ninja toward a concealed chamber nestled within his garage. As they cautiously made their way through the mysterious area, they were astounded to encounter the League of Jays. Kai was momentarily stunned, questioning whether they have stumbled into a nightmare. However, his confusion was swiftly dispelled as the ninja reunite the real Jay.

I am Okino[]

As the ninja set foot in Terra Karana, Kai remained perplexed by how Jay had managed to gather a group of devoted followers, whom he had referred to as "nutjobs." Jay, however, swiftly corrected him, asserting that the League of Jays were not "nutjobs" but rather passionate fans. Nya reminded the team to stay focused on their mission of acquiring one of the three Key-Tanas needed to enter the Temple of Madness. Kai struggled to recall the name of the Key-Tanas, prompting Okino to intervene and enlighten them. Okino introduced himself as a failed guide who had once led adventurers through Terra Karana. Expressing their gratitude, Nya thanked Okino for his assistance, while Kai admitted their complete cluelessness about their current endeavor.

The Glitch[]

Kai and the rest of the ninja headed out with Okino into the Forest of Discontent. Their first obstacles were bushes which contained the Thorns of Discontent. Kai decided to lay back and not attack which earned him a look from the rest of the ninja and Okino. Kai then explained that he only had one life and could not take any hits.

Okino and the ninja eventually reach a point where the former thought the upcoming obstacle could be Strangler Vines. Lloyd found out that is was not, but they were ambushed by the Whack Rats. The ninja defeated the Whack Rats and tied up Ritchie, holding him captive. They interrogated him and Ritchie revealed that Unagami ordered them to ambush the ninja. Lloyd then commented about Unagami preventing the ninja from winning the game which confused Okino. The ninja then explained that Prime Empire was not a real-world and that Unagami was the creator of the world. However, Okino didn't believe it causing Jay thinks he was not programmed to understand the truth.

Realizing Unagami was playing dirty, the ninja were about to leave, but Ritchie urged the ninja to cut him down because he has an itch. Ritchie then told the ninja that there was a glitch in the game that could allow the ninja to bypass the Forest of Discontent. The ninja ended up letting Ritchie down and he began scratching his body.

Ritchie guided the ninja to the glitch to which he jumped in, and Okino was confused and bewildered at the sight of it. The rest of the ninja entered as well where they were teleported to a purple cubed room. They walked forward and all of a sudden, Red Visors appeared and began shooting the ninja. The ninja pulled out their prime controllers to defend themselves as Ritchie looked on before leaving the room. The ninja began to lose numerous lives until Okino entered and fought the Red Visors giving the ninja a chance to escape. Everyone managed to escape except Lloyd, who was waiting for Okino to come along. Okino decided to go with Lloyd as he pushed him through the portal.

The ninja and Okino landed outside the Forest of Discontent. Lloyd thanked Okino, but he was sitting down sadly realizing the world he was living in was not real. Okino thought he's a pawn, but Lloyd downplayed the idea as he told Okino that he was the one who made his own decision, not Unagami, thus not making a pawn. Lloyd then told Okino to trust in himself and in the ninja as friends and as an ally to help them get past Terra Karana.

The Cliffs of Hysteria[]

As the ninja continued their journey toward the Cliffs of Hysteria, Kai noticed that Okino was still struggling after learning that his entire world was only a simulation. Wanting to lift the samurai's spirits, Lloyd instructed everyone to avoid talking about Prime Empire. Unsure what to discuss instead, Kai tried cheering Okino up with a joke. However, the joke failed. Cole berated Kai for the poor joke, prompting Kai to challenge him to come up with a better one. When the group reached the Cliffs of Hysteria, Kai was astonished by their enormous size. At the foot of the cliffs, the ninja met Shifty, who was selling grappling hooks and two varieties of rope. Kai immediately chose the Rope of Supreme Durability, believing it to be the obvious choice, but was shocked to learn it cost six hundred credits. Realizing they could not afford it, the ninja reluctantly considered purchasing the Rope of Questionable Integrity instead.

Kai listened as Shifty revealed information about Unagami's drones collecting energy cubes from players who had been cubed. Shifty also explained that a friend of his told him that Unagami was building a machine, although he did not know its purpose. Moments later, one of Unagami's drones identified the ninja, causing a squad of Red Visors to appear and chase after. Kai grabbed his rope and followed the others as they raced toward the cliffs. Once the ninja began climbing, Kai confidently believed they had escaped, calling down to the Red Visors that they were too late. His confidence quickly disappeared when the Red Visors activated boosters and flew up after them. Surprised, Kai hurried to climb faster as the enemies opened fire. While defending themselves on the ropes, Kai fought alongside the other ninja as they battled the flying attackers.

During the climb, Kai noticed one of Unagami's drones targeting Cole and preparing to shoot his rope. Without hesitation, Kai leapt off his own rope and landed directly on the drone. Driving his sword into its machinery, he seized control of it before it could destroy Cole's lifeline. Although the damaged drone flew wildly, Kai successfully redirected its blaster toward the pursuing Red Visors, eliminating several of them. He continued steering the malfunctioning drone and even shot down a Red Visor near Lloyd, allowing Lloyd to capture him for later examination. After the battle, Kai pulled his sword free from the drone, destroying it, and safely landed on top of the cliffs with the rest of the team.

At the summit, Kai examined the captured Red Visor while Nya restored his communications. He listened as Lloyd questioned the Red Visor about the energy cubes and Unagami's machine. Before the damaged robot shut down completely, he revealed that the energy cubes were being used to construct a portal to Ninjago. When the Red Visor disappeared before providing further details, Kai was frustrated that they could not learn anything more. Before continuing their journey, the ninja encouraged Okino, who feared he might eventually betray them because Unagami had created him. Kai stood beside his teammates as they reassured Okino that he had the freedom to make his own choices. Inspired by their faith in him, Okino chose to continue the quest alongside the ninja.

The Maze of the Red Dragon[]

The ninja and Okino began dashing through traps and just before Cole asked Okino where to go, Unagami paused the game to speak with Okino. When the game was unpaused, the ninja asked again, and Okino once again guided them.

They made it to where the Red Dragon and the Purple Key-Tana were located. Jay attempted to steal it when the dragon was sleeping, but the ninja accidentally awakened it when they attempted to save Jay. Kai and the ninja struggled to attack the Red Dragon until Okino struck the dragon on its weak spot, breaking his programming. The ninja began striking that same point until Jay grabbed the Key-Tana and took out the remaining lives.

One Step Forward, Two Steps Back[]

Jay introduced Terra Technica to the ninja and they decided to sign up for the Speedway Five-Billion. Unfortunately, they didn't have enough credits to enter the race due to Kai spending his credits on a new avatar, and to make matters worse, they were shortly surrounded by Red Visors. Jay fought one of them but was forced to have a weapon upgrade, which caused them to need more credits once they were done fighting. They then saw an advertisement for a dance competition and decided to enter to obtain more credits.

Jay and Nya began dancing and rank up points rapidly. This impressed the rest of the ninja as they didn't know Jay was an excellent dancer. 

Meanwhile, the Red Visors began to show up, so the ninja began fighting them in the background. Eventually, Jay and Nya managed to win the contest, and fans began rushing on the stage to congratulate them. One Red Visor tried to crawl his way towards Jay and Nya, but Kai poked his back and punched his head.

After winning the competition, Jay and Nya cashed out their earnings to enter the race. The ninja then realized that they needed cars, but Jay claimed he knew someone who could lend them cars, so they headed out to Scott. 

Racer Seven[]

Scott showed the ninja all of the vehicles he had and commented that he wasn't going to be racing due to him having only one life left. Jay replied by saying that some things are worth fighting for, but Scott didn't want to be a hero. Jay then explained that Scott has been in the game for way too long, explaining his behaviour.

While Lloyd headed out to check out the track, the rest of the ninja began making repairs to their vehicles. While Nya was working on a car, the engine exploded and Jay checked to see if she was okay. Nya then got upset that the vehicle is now destroyed, but Lloyd came back telling the team that he thought Racer Seven could race with them. However, Scott revealed that Racer Seven was programmed to lose which got affection from Jay and Nya. Lloyd then went out to find her.

After a grueling day, the ninja rebuilt four vehicles but still needed another one. That was when Racer Seven arrived, so the ninja and Scott came out to greet her. Lloyd then asked if she will participate or not.

The Speedway Five-Billion[]

While the ninja were talking to Racer Seven, the alarm sounded as Red Visors began shooting the base. Lloyd said he would hold them off, but the ninja didn't let him, so Scott decided to hold off the Red Visors. The ninja manage to escape, but Jay cries out when Scott was cubed.

The ninja entered the race and as the race went on, more and more racers got eliminated. Jay pulled upfront, and he got side to side with Richie. They both recognized each other and Richie threw a bomb at him. Luckily, Jay ducked down in time for it to go over his jet and hit another competitor, sending it flying back and hitting other vehicles as well.

Knowing that their friends stood a better chance of winning than them, the Kai and Cole exchanged knowing nods. Kai's mech jumped on a Red Visors' car and Cole threw his wrecking ball at two other Red Visors' cars, one being the one he hit with the wrecking ball with and the other he snagged while dragging the other car back. As all the vehicles were about to collide, Kai and Cole wished their friends good luck. A giant explosion occurs and everyone was shocked when two energy cubes fall to the track. Jay and Nya screamed for their friends while Lloyd hung his head down in despair while Unagami's drones picked up the cubes.

Game Over[]

Kai and the other ninja were freed from Prime Empire and returned to Ninjago, where he was reunited with Jay, Wu, Zane, and P.I.X.A.L. Kai wondered if they got the key-tana, to which Jay stated that he will fill them up on the events they had missed later. While the ninja were wondering what happened to Unagami, Jay reassured them that, like everyone else trapped in Prime Empire, he was at his home.

Master of the Mountain

Master of the Mountain[]

Shintaro[]

Kai and the rest of the ninja got excited when they received an invitation to the Kingdom of Shintaro. Later, Kai and the rest of the ninja headed to the Ivory City via the Destiny's Bounty. However, they encountered some Dire Bats. Kai spotted a couple trying to tear the sail, so he got on top of the mast and shot fireballs at the bats. However, the Bounty still descended after one of the Dire Bats ran into the mast containing the sail. Although all hope seemed lost, the Army of Shintaro arrived in time to lift the ship while Hailmar greeted the ninja and showed them the Kingdom of Shintaro in the horizon.

Into the Dark[]

Kai and the ninja were escorted inside the Throne Room of the Kingdom of Shintaro where they met King Vangelis and Princess Vania.

During the middle of the night, Kai was alarmed by Cole who described a purple monster in his room. However, Kai and the ninja thought he was dreaming and told him to go back to sleep.

The Worst Rescue Ever[]

Kai and the other ninja were strolling through the magnificent gardens, while they realized that Cole is missing.

Suddenly, Princess Vania appeared from out of a tunnel in a frenzy, telling the ninja that she went into the Dungeons with Cole and found something terrible. There was an underground mine filled with little creatures forced to mine by black skeletons. Cole stayed behind to rescue them, and told her to get help.

The seven of them went to tell King Vengelis, but he is angry at his daughter for disobeying his orders; thus endangering their guests. He said that he would send his guards down at once to find Cole, but he also would not allow the ninja to go. Kai attempted to argue, but Wu silenced him. The ninja realized that the creature that Cole saw in his bedroom was real all along.

The ninja left the throne room, and made secret plans to enter the dungeons behind the King's orders. Vania agreed to show them the way into the dungeons, and she led the way back to the garden.

Wu agreed to stay behind with Vania, feeling that he would slow the rest of them down. The ninja entered the cave and found that Vania was telling the truth. Zane detected simple weapons and crude fortifications from the skeletons, and Kai suggested that they bust up the bags of bones, and rescue Cole nice and quickly.

They all agreed, stole the keys to Cole's cage, and freed him at last. In order to delay their possible capture, Zane dropped a cage on some approaching skeletons with his shuriken. Cole told them to keep the volume down, as there was a winged masked man who lives in the temple in the center who did they didn't want to meet.

The two tribes of creatures that lived in the dungeons, the Geckles and Munce, began to quarrel with each other, causing a ruckus. This alerted the Awakened Warriors, who began to attack the ninja. Lloyd ordered Jay and Nya to take out the warriors, while the rest of them ran away. Kai and the others were in shock, watching the Geckles and Munce call each other "blade stealers". Meanwhile, the ninja found that the Awakened Warriors went down without much trouble.

While trying to defend themselves, Zane realized that his Elemental Powers were no use in the dungeons.

All the commotion caused the masked man to exit his temple. The man revealed himself as the Skull Sorcerer, a masked man in a black gown with wings, wielding a glowing green skull. The Skull Sorcerer used the green skull in his hands to awaken the black skeletons around him, overwhelming the ninja, leading to their defeat and eventual capture.

The Two Blades[]

Kai and the other ninja were put to work by the Awakened Warriors, forced to mine heaping amounts of Vengestone, which explained their inability to use their powers.

After causing a ruckus, they were locked up in a cage with several Geckles. When Gliff picked a fight with Murt, the ninja inquired them on how their feud started.

The Geckle explained that long ago, a hero named "Gilly" (who the Munce argues was named "Milly"), entered the mountain with two blades to defend the Geckles and Munce from a terrible dragon known as Grief-Bringer (who the Munce argues was called "Mief-Bringer"). After defeating the dragon, "Gilly" left behind her blades as gifts to the Geckles and Munce— leaving the Ivory Blade of Deliverance to the Geckles, and the Shadow Blade of Deliverance to the Munce.

The two tribe's feud started when the Munce apparently stole their blade, however the Munce argues that the Geckles were the ones that stole the blade. The ninja came to the conclusion that it wasn't either tribe who stole the blades, rather the Skull Sorcerer, in order to get control over both tribes. While the tribes were fighting over themselves, they couldn't fight the Skull Sorcerer.

Lloyd put together a plan to get the two tribes to make a truce so they can all break out. Word was passed around through Geckles and Munce about a secret meeting after lunch, and when the time came, they discussed retrieving both Blades by defeating the Skull Sorcerer.

Later, the ninja broke out of their cages by getting a Mino to eat through their chains. The ninja split up, and while Cole and Lloyd attempted to find the two blades, the others go about releasing the remaining Geckles and Munce. A few minutes later, chaos ensued, while Cole and Lloyd were chased away by the Skull Sorcerer.

In the commotion, the ninja were split up so that Jay, Nya, and Lloyd go one path, while Zane and Kai go down another. Kai noticed Cole dodging many attacks from the Skull Sorcerer and encouraged him to follow him and Zane. Before he could, the Skull Sorcerer blocked off the front of their tunnel with an small avalanche, much to Kai's dismay as Cole was further separated from the group as he was chased by the Skull Sorcerer.

Trial By Mino[]

Kai and Zane were walking through a cave when they heard Geckles singing while collecting moss-milk. The two hid, but were caught when Groko fell off his ladder and the Moss Milk landed on Kai. The Geckles thought the ninja worked for the Skull Sorcerer and took them to Chancellor Gulch.

After tough views from both sides, Gluch decided to place the ninja in a "Trial by Mino" so they fell into a pit. Suddenly, a Mino came out and charged at the ninja. While being chased, Zane recognized that the Mino had Vengestone armor and was able to remove it. The Mino then calmed down and even licked the two ninja.

The ninja said they are Elemental Masters, so the Geckles believed they might know "Gilly." Meanwhile, Zane noticed Gleck's necklace, and realized that it was the one Cole claimed to have seen. The two told them that they do not know "Gilly", but Zane stated that they are looking for their friends, who were also Elemental Masters. Gulch agreed to help them in light of the dishonor they brought upon themselves by suspecting the ninja. He then promptly resigned as chancellor and gave the position to Kai, which all the Geckles agreed to by throwing rocks at him. He accepted the position reluctantly but told them not to throw things at him anymore, but the Geckles threw more rocks at him in support of his proposal. He then asked for information on the Skull Sorcerer at Zane's suggestion.

Gulch took them to the story cave and told them of their people's origin. During their dark ages, a great hero named "Gilly" arrived to save them from Grief-Bringer and gifted them with the Blades of Deliverance, but it was stolen by the Munce. Kai quickly cut him off, as they already knew that part of the story, and asked about the Skull Sorcerer. Gulch says that three adventurers had ventured deep into the tunnels where all Geckles were forbidden to enter, and awoke an ancient evil - the Skull Sorcerer and the Awakened Warriors. He captured many Geckles and Munce to mine for him, and where they once lived openly, they now had to hide and pray that the Skull Sorcerer doesn't find them.

Kai decided that to defeat the Skull Sorcerer, he must unite the Geckles and Munce, so he proposed teaming up with the Munce, only for the suggestion to be perceived as a joke. He stated that they need a different approach, to which Zane expressed his agreement by throwing a rock at his head.

Grief-Bringer[]

Kai informed the Geckles they'll be attending the truce meeting with the Munce, but the Geckles believed it was be a trap. To decide the matter, Gulch proposed a slug race.

During the race, Gleck pulled Kai and Zane aside and told them that he believes the Munce were not evil and they didn't steal the Blades of Deliverance. Kai recognized the necklace he's wearing and asked why he went into the palace earlier. After Gleck explained himself, Zane asked for the necklace and discovered the pictures of Cole's parents: Lou and Lilly. Correctly deducing that Lilly is Gilly, in the process. Gleck was exhilarated that the ninja knew Lilly, so he asked Kai and Zane to get her help, but Kai gave Gleck the unfortunate news that Lilly passed away a while ago.

Back at the race, the snail that they wanted to win wasn't winning, so Kai encouraged Zane to cheat. Zane questioned the move at first, but Kai assured him it will be beneficial in the long run. After Zane cheated and allowed the snail the ninja want to win, Kai was excited and they headed off to the meeting.

When they arrived, Kai realizes her sister Nya was the new Munce Queen. The siblings hugged each other, but tensions between the Geckles and Munce increased. When the ninja were able to calm everyone down, they heard the sound of Grief-Bringer and they all retreated.

During the retreat, Kai almost landed in the lava as he was crossing the lava field, but Nya was able to save him.

The Darkest Hour[]

While running away, Kai was informed by Gulch that the Geckle Strong-Cave was the only way to take cover. The former was about to shout it out to everyone else, but Gulch thought he was crazy and that they didn't want the Munce to hear as well. However, Kai believed they were united.

When Nya and the Munce were trying to close the gate, Kai and the rest of the ninja headed out to buy time for them to close it. The ninja performed Spinjitzu to defeat most of the Awakened Warriors, but they quickly rebuilt themselves. Murtessa was able to break the chains to the gate and the ninja retreated back in.

Kai thought they are safe from danger, but Gulch was upset at Kai for allowing the Munce to enter as well. Tensions once rose between the two tribes as they called each other different names.

Even though both sides disliked each other, they both were fearful when Grief-Bringer and the Awakened Warriors attempted to tear down the gate. Nya recognized a pile of rocks covering something and asked the Geckles and Munce to work together to remove the rocks. Kai marvelled at their teamwork, and when they were done, he entered first, only for him to discover there was no other way out.

Murtessa and Gulch apologized to each other and Kai and Nya officially established peace with the opposing tribes. At the same time, the Skull Sorcerer destroyed the gate and was about to fight until the ninja decided to surrender themselves and allow the Geckles and Munce to be free. The Skull Sorcerer agreed and the ninja were taken away.

The Upply Strike Back![]

Kai advised Nya, who was attempting to escape, to conserve her energy since the cage was made of Vengestone. Nya expressed regret for the ninja falling for the Skull Sorcerer's deceitful promises, while Kai mentioned his own disappointment in becoming the worst Geckle Chancellor due to it. The Skull Sorcerer unveiled his plan to eliminate the ninja with the help of Grief-Bringer, forcing the Geckles and Munce into submission. However, Hazza D'ur continuously echoed the Skull Sorcerer's words. In a jesting manner, Kai questioned whether he should focus on the Skull Sorcerer or Hazza Du'r to mock the two sorcerers. Lloyd believed that Cole was en route to warn King Vangelis about the Skull Sorcerer, but it was revealed that the Skull Sorcerer was actually Vangelis himself, much to Kai's dismay.

Subsequently, Vangelis prepared to release Grief-Bringer when Cole stepped in, engaging in a fight with Vangelis. The ninja supported Cole, while Kai encouraged him to defeat Vangelis. Plundar and Adam showed up to rescue Kai and the ninja from captivity, disclosing their allegiance to Cole, causing Kai to question Cole's recruitment of a team independently. Nevertheless, after being liberated, Kai and the ninja participated in the battle against the Re-Awakened.

The Son of Lilly[]

In the midst of the battle for Shintato Mountain, Kai found himself facing off against Grief-Bringer. Despite his best efforts to utilize his Spinjitzu against the dragon, Kai was quickly overpowered by the beast's sheer strength. Kai came up with a plan to evade Grief-Bringer by jumping onto the back of Zane's Mino. Together, Kai and Zane regrouped with the rest of the ninja as they continued to engage in combat against the Re-Awakened. As the battle raged on, Grief-Bringer once again appeared before them, ready to strike. Thankfully, Wu and Chompy arrived to assist the ninja in their fight against the undead dragon. Cole managed to unlock the Spinjitzu Burst, capturing the attention of Kai and everyone else present. Cole was able to destroy the Skull of Hazza D'ur, causing the downfall of the Re-Awakened and instilling a deep sense of triumph and relief in Kai, the other ninja, and the Shintarians.

Kai and the ninja partook in Vania's crowning, and they celebrated together. Once the ceremony was over, the ninja bid farewell to the Shintarians and boarded the Bounty. However, Wu wanted to go wherever the wind would take them. Zane, not understanding the expression, asked Kai for an explanation, and Kai revealed that they were about to embark on a new adventure.

The Island

The Island[]

Uncharted[]

Kai went with the ninja to Twitchy Tim's gas station in order to get the latter's help, which they succeeded in doing so after some discussion. They then traveled on the Destiny's Bounty to the uncharted island, but were halted from continuing due to the rise in electrostatic levels. Changing their course of action, they opted to continue on some water vessels. On the way, Kai's catamaran suffered a glitch which prevented the pontoons from joining together, forcing Zane, Jay, and Cole to tilt the catamaran on its side. Doing so, they lost the sail in the process. After arriving at the island, P.I.X.A.L. deployed motorbikes to the ninja, and they proceeded to drive down the shore to Misako and Wu's settlement, which they found abandoned. With no other choice, they continued deeper into the jungle.

The Keepers of the Amulet[]

The ninja - including Kai - traveled through the jungle on their jungle choppers. While driving, they noticed a movement in the vegetation. This eventually turned out to be a jungle dragon, whom Jay named "Zippy." They eventually continued on foot, until they approached a stone totem. The ninja fought the stone totems but began to lose, due to the ability of the stone totems to channel elemental powers. Kai and other ninja ran away from them - with Lloyd getting separated - and they reached a rope bridge. They then successfully crossed the bridge but were zapped by a group of islanders. When they woke up, they were led by the Keepers to their leader, who assumed that the ninja were there to steal a priceless artifact. The ninja attempted to convince him that they weren't there to steal it, but due to the fact that they had seen it, the leader declared the ninja will be their prisoners, forever.

The Gift of Jay[]

Mammatus, the leader of the Keepers, ordered for Kai and the ninja - except for Lloyd who was absent - to be taken away to a cell, other than Jay. After they were thrown into the cell, they discovered Misako and her expedition group, who were also imprisoned. After a while, Lloyd came to the rescue and freed them. They proceeded to search for Jay, but failed to locate him. Eventually, they were caught off-guard and were zapped by the Keepers, knocking them out. When they woke up, they were tied to poles, and were forced to watch the Keepers' sacrifice of Jay, which was placing him on a raft and sending out on the sea to "Wojira."

The Tooth of Wojira[]

As the ninja were forced to watch the Keepers' sacrifice of Jay to "Wojira," the Keepers had their backs to them. Taking advantage of this situation, Kai began to burn the ropes binding him to a pole. He eventually broke out and freed the other ninja too. By the time the Keepers realized what was happening, the ninja were already freed and began to fight the Keepers. They were able to pass them and go after Jay's raft. Unfortunately for them, they weren't able to stop the monster from taking Jay. However, Lloyd realized that the monster was a fake, due to him finding the wooden tooth.

The ninja returned to the island but encountered the Keepers once more. However, Lloyd informed them that the monster was a fake, and inquired about the reason of the sacrifices. After Mammatus explained everything to them, they asked him to draw a map of the coastline highlighting hiding places. The ninja then headed to the monster's hiding spot, where they located Jay and fought numerous henchmen. Ronin revealed himself to be the leader of the criminal gang and began to make an escape. However, Twitchy Tim came in time to stop him, and as he attempted to escape, Kai and Cole blocked his way. Later, Mammatus apologized to Kai and the ninja, who accepted it.

The Virtues of Spinjitzu

The Virtues of Spinjitzu[]

Curiosity[]

Kai and Jay engaged in a friendly competition to see who can break the most bricks, in which the winner would keep the last cookie. The two ninja stack and broke more bricks, with Jay initially breaking three and Kai breaking five. However, Kai ultimately won by smashing a tall pile of 101 bricks with his powers. Just as Kai reveled in his triumph, Wu arrived. He was taken aback by the chaotic state of the courtyard. In an attempt to cover up their actions, Kai and Jay hastily claimed that they were training and meditating on the Six Fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu. However, their deception was quickly exposed when Kai and the rest of the ninja had no recollection of the virtues. As a result, they were forced to meditate to reflect on and internalize the Spinjitzu Virtues.

While the ninja were deep in their meditation, Wu emphasized the importance of curiosity, balance, wisdom, honesty, generosity, and courage as the Virtues of Spinjitzu. Their reflection was abruptly interrupted by a loud knocking on the doors. Wu instructed them to reflect on his words and left to attend to the visitor. As the ninja contemplated their lessons, Nya, unable to contain her curiosity, opened the doors and was met with a green dragon attacking the ninja with Wu in its grasp. Kai and the other ninja did their best to fight the dragon, but the dragon was able to deflect their attacks and escape through a portal. The ninja then entered the portal hoping to save Wu.

Balance[]

The ninja exited through the portal and saw the green dragon. Kai saw Wu and was about to run to him, but Nya pulled him back and pointed out the lava separating them and Wu. While watching Jay and Lloyd attempting to cross the lava, the rest of the ninja were ambushed by Pyro Whippers. Kai attempted to use his Elemental Powers, but the Pyro Whippers spat it right back at Kai and Nya. Realizing their attacks were ineffective, Kai and Nya began crossing the lava, but had to deal with the Lava Monster. Fortunately, they were saved by the Thunder Dragon and entered the next portal.

Wisdom[]

Kai and the ninja raced in the Speedway Five-Billion attempting to reach the portal at the finish line. However, the Whack Rats were blocking their way and kept respawning every time they were defeated. Lloyd then realized they needed to be defeated in order to get across and after he "died", he respawned near the portal. The rest of the ninja followed suit and entered the next portal.

Honesty[]

Kai and Jay found themselves inside the Castle of Ice and encountered the Ice Emperor. The Ice Emperor had the rest of the ninja trapped in a cage and forced them to joust the Blizzard Warriors in order to move on. Kai suggested that they should opt for a different activity like juggling, and that Jay was a skilled ventriloquist. Jay denied his ventriloquism skills and points out that lying was not the right approach. Kai questioned Jay's sudden interest in truthfulness.

Kai successfully defeated the Blizzard Samurai and watched as Jay was jousting. After Jay was knocked off from his dragon, Kai insisted on lying, but Jay disagreed and told the Ice Emperor the truth. Kai, with a hint of sarcasm, remarked on the timing of Jay's newfound principles. However, the Ice Emperor revealed that the competition was actually a test of honesty, not jousting skill, and that Jay's honesty made him the true victor. The Ice Emperor freed the other ninja and created a portal for them to go through. As he went toward that portal, Kai joked about his earlier suggestion of using ventriloquism.

Generosity[]

Kai and the rest of the ninja fought the Awakened Warriors in the Mines of Shintaro. After saving the Geckles from the warriors, the ninja used the catapult to launch themselves to the next portal.

Courage[]

Kai and the ninja arrived at the Island of the Keepers, with Kai riding his dragon. He celebrated the return of their dragon allies. However, Jay reminded the team of the Legendary Dragon, who still held Wu captive. They approached a dome-shaped forcefield containing the Legendary Dragon, Wu, and three purple dragons. Realizing there was no escape route for the dragon, Kai felt relieved that the chase was over. Eager to act, he was informed by Cole that they needed to enter the forcefield without their vehicles or dragons due to the small entrance. Nya suggested they carefully assess their surroundings first. Yet, Kai's urgency took over as he feared losing Master Wu if they delayed. His insistence highlighted the emotional stakes, as he struggled with the possibility of failure. Jay voiced his concerns about facing the dragons, while Zane suggested that the dragons could be allies. Lloyd supported this idea, advocating for a strategic approach to win them over. Despite the differing opinions, Kai remained determined, believing they just need courage, and he charged through the small opening.

Kai charged at one of the purple dragons using Spinjitzu, and to his surprise, it was destroyed in an instant. This turn of events caused the force field to dissipate. Seizing the opportunity, the other ninja launched their attacks on the remaining purple dragons, swiftly defeating them as well. Meanwhile, the Legendary Dragon prepared to unleash its fiery breath at Wu, but Kai intervened, countering the attack with his own flames. At the same time, Lloyd sped through the Legendary Dragon in his Race Car, seemingly bringing it to its end. Once the battle concluded, Wu praised Kai for his bravery, gradually revealing that the entire sequence of events had been a test aimed at teaching Kai and the others the Six Fundamental Virtues of Spinjitzu. With a wave of his powers, Wu lifted the illusions, and the ninja found themselves back at the monastery. He elaborated on how each ninja's distinct qualities played a role in overcoming the challenges they faced, highlighting the significance of these virtues, particularly noting how Kai's courage enabled him to triumph in the final challenge.

Seabound

Seabound[]

A Big Splash[]

Kai and the ninja confronted a Vengestone smuggling operation by Miss Demeanor. They defeated her henchmen, but Nya lost control over a water cyclone she created. Thus, the ninja were forced to let Miss Demeanor escape as they evacuate farmers from the cyclone. Back at the Monastery, the ninja informed Wu about the operation before Nya spoke up and took full responsibility as she lost all control of her power. Shortly after, the emergency sprinkler activates short-circuiting all the electronics.

Later, Wu and the ninja - except Nya - studied a scroll in the library regarding the power of water. Wu then suggested that they should call Maya since she was the previous Master of Water and she would be able to help. Kai then nervously said that she and Nya weren't close, as the former was kidnapped when Nya was very young, but Wu insisted that Nya was reasonable. So Kai went to discuss with Nya about their parents coming to visit the Monastery, but Nya vehemently refused.

Later when Maya and Ray arrived at the Monastery, the former asked Kai where is Nya's room, which he pointed out to her. He also greeted Ray, his father. Realizing that her brother had gone against her wishes, Nya angrily confronted Kai, who shrugged as he said "What?."

The Call of the Deep[]

The next day, Kai was playing Lava Zombies with Ray when Nya walked into the room to talk to him. Too distracted, Kai continued playing the game, only stopping when Maya brought in sandwiches. Nya, frustrated at him for ignoring her, left the room.

Later, after a catastrophic energy wave caused the Monastery's water sources to go haywire, Kai helped the others clean up the mess.

Unsinkable[]

Kai, with the others, watched as P.I.X.A.L unveiled the Hydro Bounty.

Later, he was watching Ray play video games when Ray mentioned that nobody would be playing video games with him. Correcting him, Kai told him and the others that he and Cole would be staying behind to protect Ninjago. When he mentioned that he was better at Prime Empire than Cole was, Cole, who just entered the room, challenged him to see who was better at the game and began to play together.

Riddle of the Sphinx[]

Kai fought in a sparring match with his father, beating him, as part of an experiment by Wu to see how elemental powers would affect a former master. When asked by Wu to shoot a fireball at Ray, Ray quickly ran off. Cole then came up and told Kai and Wu that Clutch Powers stole the Storm Amulet and brought it to the Explorer’s Club, causing the group to spring into action to retake the artifact.

Upon arrival at the Explorer’s Club, Cecil Putnam told Kai and others that without a membership card, they could not enter. Due to it being the only way for non-members to enter, Misako invoked the Trial By Sphinx, a test where each person would have one chance to solve a riddle in order to enter the Club.

After Cole and Wu failed to correctly answer the Sphinx's riddle, Kai figured out that the answer was water, allowing the group to pass.

Entering the room where Clutch was showing off his artifact, Kai and the others demanded Clutch to return the artifact. However, before he could give it to them, Kalmaar, leading an army of Merlopian troops, burst into the room, also seeking the Storm Amulet. In the ensuing battle, Kai would take down several Merlopian troops and witness the other members of the Explorers' Club fight back.

Papergirl[]

After Kalmaar successfully took the Storm Amulet and burst out of the Explorer’s Club, Kai, from a rooftop launched a fireball at him while Wu and Cole attempted to retake the Amulet from him. Kalmaar successfully fended off all their attacks, leading Kai to lunge at him from a long range. That attack was quickly nullified as well, with Kalmaar using his trident to shoot an energy beam at him, knocking him back against a car.

However, the constant flurry of attacks caused the Storm Amulet to be knocked out of Kalmaar's hands, and Kai successfully delayed him enough to allow Nelson and Antonia to escape with it.

Kai later tracked down Nelson and Antonia, still with the Storm Amulet and being pursued by Kalmaar, and attacked Kalmaar, knocking the truck he was driving of course and allowing the other two to escape.

While fighting each other on the moving truck, neither Kai or Kalmaar focused on what was up ahead, resulting in the truck crashing into a canal, knocking Kai unconscious.

Antonia successfully rescued him and Nelson did CPR on him, reviving Kai. By then, Wu, Cole, and Ray caught up to where he was, and the group continued their pursuit of Kalmaar, leaving Antonia and Nelson behind.

Master of the Sea[]

Having pursued Kalmaar to the city docks, Kai engaged in battle against him and his forces as he and his allies attempted to stop Kalmaar from escaping with the Storm Amulet.

Following their seeming victory, Kai and his father played Prime Empire together, determined to finish the last level before the latter departed.

The Calm Before the Storm[]

Kai worked on the Submersible combat crafts alongside Cole and P.I.X.A.L. As he worked on his own craft however, something exploded and knocked Kai back several feet.

Assault on Ninjago City[]

Armed with a submersible, Kai joined Zane and Cole in patrolling the flooded streets of Ninjago City to fight off the invading Merlopians. The trio encountered Gripe and his platoon and engaged in a brief shootout with them, but later with Cole's urging, Kai and Zane broke off their engagement to seek out Wojira. After encountering the Storm Serpent, Kai released his submersible's torpedoes against her, only to discover to his dismay that the explosives inflicted minimal, if any, damage to her.

Nyad[]

Kai and the other ninja were ordered to retreat to the Ninjago News Center by Wu.

The Turn of the Tide[]

After Nya merged with the sea, Kai and the others grappled to the roof of the nearby police station and observed her battle with Kalmaar. When Gripe and a platoon of Maaray guards arrived to backup their leader, Kai and the others, minus Jay, fought them off. When Nya resurfaced in her water dragon form, Kai recognized the dragon's voice as that of his sister's.

After Wojira's disappearance, Kai approached his sister in her new watery form and chuckled nervously as he remarked that her new form would take some time to get used to, but insisted that all of them would work together to find a way to restore her to her human form. However, the puzzled expression Nya gave him back sent a shiver down Kai's spine and he was left nearly speechless and confused, only quietly asking his sister as to where she was going as he struggled to process the events unfolding before him.

Sometime later, Kai prepared for his sister's memorial at the Monastery and comforted his mother prior to the start of the ceremony. During the ceremony, Kai was the last one to pour his cup of water into the vase.

After Seabound

After Seabound[]

Kai took lessons from Master Wu to master his forms to calm down and cope with the loss of Nya after she merged with the Endless Sea.[16]

The Sea Beast! (non-canon)[]

One day after the Great Flood, Kai comforted Jay as the two looked out towards the shoreline. With a sign, Kai told Jay that it was time to accept that Nya was gone. However, Jay refused and instead accused Kai of being incapable of understanding the pain and grief he was going through. This in turn immediately angered Kai who shot back that Nya was his sister and that things were even harder for him; however, he conceded that Nya had made her choice in choosing to merge with the sea, and they had to accept that by now. When Jay changed the topic to how much he still missed Nya, Kai added that he had recently begun to enjoy visiting the coast, for it made him feel like his sister was still close by. Jay then pointed out that Nya was now the sea itself and suggested that if they followed the coastline, perhaps they could find Nya as well? Kai agreed with Jay's idea and shortly thereafter, the ninja banded together to begin searching the coastline for leads.

After two whole days of walking up and down the coast and inquiring with locals for any leads, the ninja returned to Ninjago City with nothing to show but tall tales. After returning to the harbor, Kai pointed to a large gathering before a man who claimed to be selling a sea monster. When Jay excitedly rushed ahead, believing the sea monster could be Nya, Kai stopped him and pointed out that Miss Demeanor and her henchmen were amongst the prospective buyers in the crowd! Knowing that Miss Demeanor could not be up to anything good, they sprang into action and defeated her, exposing the monster as a fake in the process. As the ninja began to walk away, Jay groaned that he was done with fake monsters, a comment that Kai poked fun at, asking Jay if he would prefer real ones instead. Upon hearing this, Lloyd let out a groan and asked both of them not to tempt fate for their next adventures.

Tentacles Below![]

A few days after the Great Flood, Kai and the other ninja responded to reports of a monster dwelling in the sewers of Ninjago City. After fending off one of the beast's tentacles, Kai and the others descended deeper into the sewers to investigate, discovering the identity of the creature as being a baby leviathan. After a failed attempt in attacking the leviathan with Spinjitzu under Lloyd's orders, Kai stayed back and listened as Cole proposed an alternative plan for moving it out from the sewers: Zane would freeze some of the sewer water and Kai would melt it to create a flow of water! Kai followed Cole's suggestion, and the plan worked like a charm, with the ninja eventually transporting the baby to around Lighthouse Island where it would be reunited with its parent. While Lloyd stayed behind on the beach in thought, Kai and the others ventured into the lighthouse in search of a radio to contact P.I.X.A.L. with.

Back to Merlopia![]

One day, following a visit to the Monastery by Glutinous, Kai and the other ninja learned of Gripe's return to Merlopia and his intentions of seizing the throne in Benthomaar's absence. After some preparations, the ninja set out to Merlopia to stop Gripe's attempted coup. After diving into the waters surrounding Merlopia with their APS suits, the ninja briefly fought against one of Gripe's patrols before making their way to the palace itself.

After sneaking into the palace through one of the supply hatches, Kai and the others encountered Gripe and his forces, and in the ensuing struggle, Gripe's forces were forced to retreat. Following Lloyd's orders, the ninja gave chase, attempting to intercept their foes by traveling through one of the lower tunnels. Unfortunately, Gripe had anticipated for the ninja to take such action and ordered for the lower tunnel to be flooded. With no way out and the exits shut off by Gripe's forces, the ninja surely would've drowned had it not been for the intervention of Glutinous. After recovering from this experience, Kai and the others hastily rushed towards the throne room to confront Gripe and his forces.

In response to seeing the ninja and their survival, Gripe and his followers simply responded by locking themselves inside the throne room, leaving the ninja without anyway inside. When Lloyd began to moan about their situation, Kai lost his temper and snapped that the ninja should have a better leader that took action instead of wasting time. Although Cole broke up the fight between him and Lloyd, Kai turned around and performed a powerful Spinjitzu tornado before repeatedly ramming against the sealed door to the throne room. Although the other ninja warned Kai about the potentially devastating consequences of his actions, Kai ignored them and continued until the sealed door melted apart from the heat of his flames. Kai then entered the throne room and single handedly defeated Gripe and his forces, burning then with his fire while the others watched on with horrified expressions. As Kai finished off the battle by tossing aside the melted and smoldering tridents wielded by the Maaray Soldiers, the rest of the ninja stepped into the throne room to see Kai lifting Gripe in the air by his neck and proclaiming victory over the would be usurpers. Although the other ninja admitted that they were impressed with Kai's single handed victory, Cole pointed out that Kai's reckless and brazen actions had also put the entire city of Merlopia at risk, a complaint that Kai snappily dismissed as being nothing more than hypotheticals.

With the immediate threat quelled, Kai handcuffed Gripe and handed him over to Glutinous before departing Merlopia with the other ninja.

Bad Water![]

After a particularly intense training session, Kai and Cole headed towards the Monastery's showers. As they entered the room, Kai was startled by Jay screaming from behind one of the curtains. When Kai asked him what was the matter, Jay complained that the water in the shower both smelled and tasted bad. After Kai confirmed this, he, Cole, and Jay suited up and sought out Master Wu to warn him; unfortunately, they were just a bit too late.

After Zane determined that the Monastery's water had been contaminated with heavy chemicals, the ninja went to Ninjago City to investigate, as the Monastery drew its water from the same supply as the city. A quick trip quickly revealed that all of the water in the city was contaminated as well, forcing the ninja to investigate further upstream. By following the contaminated river that served Ninjago City's water supply, the ninja discovered an illegal mining operation that was utilizing fracking techniques to mine out a vein of vengestone. Being familiar with fracking, Kai explained the mining technique to the others, emphasizing that fracking was illegal in Ninjago.

Following Lloyd's orders, Kai and the others launched an attack on the mining operation with Spinjitzu. Although this worked at first, after Miss Demeanor and her goons recovered from the initial attack, they retaliated by blasting the ninja with contaminated water. After retreating, Kai sarcastically complimented Lloyd on his idea and listened as Jay proposed a new plan. As part of Jay's plan, all four ninja climbed aboard the former's sub car and drove towards the mining operation to catch Miss Demeanor's attention. However, due to the sub car only having two seats, Kai and Cole were forced to ride on the roof, much to the Ninja of Fire's dismay. As the villains caught up to the sub car, Kai pretended to lament their situation, loudly proclaiming that Miss Demeanor and her goons could easily attack the ninja now. Unfortunately, the goons heeded his words and promptly threw their working tools at the sub car, with several striking Kai in the head.

As they neared the polluted river, Jay dove into it, converting his car to sub mode to traverse the contaminated waters. The goons on the other hand, were not so fortunate. Due to speeding on ahead in an effort to catch up with the ninja, the goons were unable to brake in time and crashed their mining vehicle into the river. With their vehicle disabled, Kai and the other ninja launched themselves to attack and swiftly rounded up the stranded goons. Miss Demeanor on the other hand, managed to escape once more. Although Lloyd tried to rally up the ninja to give chase, Cole dismissed the pursuit, explaining that the health of Ninjago City's citizens was more important and their priority right now was in notifying the Police Commissioner about their findings so that the river could be cleaned up.

Separate Ways[]

Responding to a call by the Police Commissioner, Kai, Cole, and Lloyd made their way to a nature preserve where they learned that several citizens had built treehouses to shelter in should another Great Flood strike. Kai then helped talk the citizens into sheltering elsewhere that wasn't a nature preserve and continued to oversee the relocating alongside Zane while Cole accompanied Jay on another mission.

Crystalized

Crystalized[]

Farewell the Sea[]

Kai was leading a training session at his dojo, where he encouraged his students to launch aggressive attacks on a cardboard cutout of Kalmaar, a strategy that surprised both Cole and Zane. As the session wrapped up, he reminded everyone that they would meet again the following week, signaling the end of class. Cole and Zane expressed their confusion about Kai's unconventional methods. In response, Kai explained that he was equipping the students for the tough challenges they might face in the real world, recalling how Nya had to merge with the Endless Sea to defeat Kalmaar. He tossed a piece of the Kalmaar cutout to Cole. Changing the subject, Kai mentioned his upcoming lesson with a kindergarten class, comparing the children to "a pack of ravenous wolves" and indicating that he needed to brace himself for the impending chaos. Zane informed Kai that they were working on reassembling the team to look into the Vengestone smuggling operation. Cole chimed in, suggesting that Kai's skills would be invaluable for the mission, unless Kai wanted to deal with the kindergarteners. Without a moment's pause, Kai packed his bag and left the dojo, encouraging them to go.

Kai, Cole, and Zane arrived in Ninjago City and found Lloyd busy washing windows at a building. They approached him with the hope of convincing him to come back to the team, but Lloyd firmly declined their offer. He explained that his focus was solely on washing windows now, as he wanted to avoid the burden of responsibility that came with being a ninja. Puzzled by Lloyd's decision, Kai turned to Cole for what to do know. Cole suggested that they should give Lloyd some space and suggested that they might have better success in persuading Jay to join them instead.

The three made their way to Lighthouse Island in search of Jay, only to find him sporting a beard. Kai asked about the change, prompting Jay to reflect somberly on how time affects everyone. As they stepped inside, they noticed several half-full glasses of water scattered about, which Kai pointed out. Jay, however, insisted they were half empty, explaining that they were meant to facilitate communication with Nya. The group gasped as Jay revealed that since Nya had merged with the ocean, she was a part of every drop of water, including that in the glasses. When Kai interrupted, Jay began addressing a glass, claiming Nya said hello. This prompted Cole to privately question Jay's condition, while Kai whispered that Jay had gone insane. Zane attempted to reason with Jay, noting that the cups contained only tap water, suggesting that his grief was clouding his judgment. Yet, Jay remained steadfast, asserting that while others had moved on from Nya's disappearance, he had not. He dismissed the notion of reason, and when Cole reminded him of their duty to protect Ninjago from the Vengestone buyer, Jay stood firm. Kai sarcastically congratulated Cole, while Jay expressed his frustration that it seemed no one cared about Nya anymore. Kai reassured him of her importance to him, and Zane urged Jay to join them, only to be met with a heartfelt refusal. As Cole and Zane prepared to leave, Kai, frustrated by Jay's obstinacy, followed. However, their attention was drawn to a multitude of small lanterns from a candlelight vigil drifting toward the island. Lloyd remarked on the beauty of the sight, and when Kai asked what had prompted Lloyd to join them, he explained that Nya would not have wanted them to give up. The group then joined hands in a circle, reaffirming their unity in Nya's honor.

The Shape of Nya[]

The reunited ninja group up at the hangar bay, discussing on who could be smuggling Vengestone. When Jay comments on how they won't be able to succeed as a team without Nya, Kai expresses his frustration for him continuously bringing up Nya. Lloyd then settles down the dispute.

The ninja then head to the abandoned N line, and find a shipment of Vengestone and a man asking for a signature. The ninja then run into Miss Demeanor and her henchmen, but the New ninja arrive and defeat them. After the crooks are arrested, the ninja are scolded by the New Ninja, before they leave.

As the ninja return to the hangar bay, the ninja express their frustrations over being replaced by the New ninja team. Then, when Kai expresses his frustration for still grieving over Nya, he accidentally knocks over a glass of water. Kai tries to apologizes, but is kicked down by Jay, and the two engage in a brief fight before setting the sprinklers off and causing Nya to return. She explains on how return her back to human by draining her elemental power, right before she is frozen by Zane. Realizing that Kai had is Fire powers stolen before, the ninja decide to free Aspheera to save Nya.

A Mayor Problem[]

Kai and the other ninja arrive at Mayor Ulysses Trustable's office to ask the mayor to free Aspheera in order to save Nya, though were unsuccessful. At one point, Kai gets annoyed at Jay for being unable to pick up on sarcasm. Back at the hangar bay, Lloyd decides to have him, Kai and Zane break into Kryptarium Prison to free Aspheera illegally, while he called in Skylor to keep Nya frozen until they return, to which Kai is surprised that Lloyd had her number (implying that he does not).

Meanwhile, Kai heads with Lloyd and Zane into Kryptarium Prison. To get through security, Zane freezes Kai and Lloyd and carries them in order for their heat to not be detected. After getting through, Kai uses his Fire to warm him and Lloyd up, right before Zane finds a secret hatch leading to Aspheera's cell. As they head there, Kai is the first one to confront her, and Lloyd tries to negotiate with Aspheera to steal Nya's powers, in return for her getting out of jail. The trio and Aspheera try to escape uphill, but the cell falls below, triggering the alarm. Kai and the others then run into prison guards on the way, and try to escape.

Public Enemies 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5![]

Back at the Monastery, Kai and Lloyd show Aspheera around before showing her to Nya's frozen, aquatic state. When Wu tells Aspheera that she can steal her powers to save her, Kai expresses his frustration silently as Aspheera exclaims that she requires her staff to do that. P.I.X.A.L. then contacts Cyrus Borg to ask about the whereabouts of Aspheera's staff, contrary to Kai's sarcastic remark.

The five ninja then trail down the trucks for Aspheera's staff in their new vehicles. Kai breaks into one of the trucks with Jay, Lloyd, and Cole, only to run into and fight the New Ninja. During the fight, Kai accidentally says Zane's name out loud, giving away their identities to the New Ninja. However, the ninja manage to escape with Aspheera's staff, though they are now wanted by Ninjago Police.

A Painful Promise[]

The ninja return with Aspheera's staff, only for the Serpentine sorceress to start attacking them and exact her revenge on them. However, the alarms sound off, revealing the police, to which Zane reveals that Kai said his name out loud, exposing their identities. As Aspheera then proceeds to steal Nya's powers, the New ninja arrive at the hangar bay, with Kai noting that someone forgot to close the secret entrance, only for Jay to point out that Kai was the last one to enter. The ninja then proceed to battle the New ninja in order to buy Aspheera more time.

Eventually, Aspheera manages to drain Nya of her powers and the latter returns back to human, with Jay and Kai cradling her, overjoyed by her return. Kai and the other ninja are then taken to court by the New ninja and the police.

Ninjago City vs. Ninja[]

Following their trial in Ninjago City v. Ninja, Kai and the others were convicted and now awaited sentencing. As they waited, Kai blasted Dareth for his poor showing as their defense attorney, though Dareth protested that he only had three weeks of law classes (most of which focused on getting out of traffic tickets). When the conversation shifted over whether Judge William Toughbutt's last name or nickname was "Toughbutt", Kai dismissively stated his position that no one's last name could possibly be "Toughbutt," only to be proven wrong moments later when the Honorable Judge William Toughbutt took the stand. Judge Toughbutt then subsequently sentenced all five ninja to five years in Kryptarium Prison for breaking Aspheera out of prison and stealing her staff from its armored convoy.

When the ninja were escorted to their cell later that night, Kai grumbled sadly about their predicament, mumbling how after all they had done to protect Ninjago, they were now the ones being locked behind bars. After arriving at their cell, Zane pointed out how there were only four beds present despite there being five ninja sharing the same cell. Bewildered by Zane's comment, Kai expressed his feelings about how Zane's worry about their beds probably wasn't the most important thing at the moment. When Zane then suggested reactivating his emotions to provide an appropriate reaction to the ninja's current circumstances, Kai suggested that it could be a good idea - only to be instantly proven wrong again when Zane let out an ear-piercing scream, forcing Kai to cover his mouth in an effort to mute the screaming. Turning his attention now once more to his and his friends' imprisonment, Kai proposed breaking out of Kryptarium and ignited flames around his fists to emphasize his faith in the idea. Lloyd however, turned down Kai's suggestion, warning that escaping from prison would only create more problems for the ninja, and instead suggested that Dareth could find a way to have them released legally. Upon hearing this suggestion, Kai broke down into peals of laughter before recomposing himself when he realized that Lloyd wasn't telling a joke.

The next day, the ninja were let out into the prison's yard, where many of their former enemies waited and glared angrily in their direction. Aiming to break the tension, Kai rhetorically asked his friends if any of them had the feeling that the other inmates were staring at them, though Zane answered straight-forwardly by stating that all of the other inmates were in fact, staring at them. Seconds later, Jay sauntered back to the group and excitedy informed them that he had gotten them entrance into The Needles - supposedly the toughest gang in Kryptarium, prompting Kai to sarcastically compliment Jay for his efforts. When Ronin approached the ninja and expressed his desire for revenge moments later, Kai stood alongside his friends in a face-down against Ronin's group but said nothing. Just before tensions could boil over, the Main Guard broke up both sides' rising hostilities and escorted the ninja, save Lloyd, to their cells. As for Lloyd, he was taken to meet an apparent visitor.

When Lloyd returned to their cell later on and told them about his mysterious run in with a stranger in service to someone called "The Crystal King," Kai wondered aloud as to who or what was a "Crystal King."

Kryptarium Prison Blues[]

Alongside the other ninja, Kai was let out of his cell to attend a visitation session with Skylor and Dareth, the latter of whom claimed to have discovered a way to have the ninja released from prison. Unfortunately, Dareth's grand plan was to request a retrial on the grounds that they didn't like the judge's verdict, much to the frustration of Kai and the others. When the conversation pivoted to Vangelis' escape from prison and the Crystal King, Kai dismissed the threat as being nothing more than "villain jabber" from a "weirdo in a Kabuki mask." When the ninja were led back to their cell once visitation time ended, Kai began following the others but held off when he noticed that Jay (who was behind him), stayed behind to speak with Skylor. Kai overheard their conversation about Nya's current state and Kai offered Jay some words of encouragement, insisting that his sister always got back up whenever she was knocked down.

Around lunchtime, Kai sat with the other ninja in Kryptarium's courtyard, picking at bowls of green gloop. As they complained about the quality of the food, Pythor, whom the ninja had not seen in years, approached their table and made several dismissive comments about them and there situation, infuriating Kai who rose to his feet and prepared to attack but was restrained by Cole and Lloyd. Unfortunately, Kai's temper won out, and he struck Pythor across the face with his serving tray, provoking a food fight with Pythor and several other inmates. Immediately after being hit, Pythor retaliated against Kai by snatching one of the rock hard slices of cake off the tray of a nearby prisoner and hurled it Kai with enough force to knock the Ninja of Fire into the wall behind him. This altercation would soon be halted by the Main Guard who ordered for all the prisoners involved to return to their cells.

Later that night, as Kai and the others tried to sleep, Lloyd shouted for all of them to awake, having witnessed several Crystal Spiders crawling past towards Pythor's cell. Realizing that the crystal spiders meant there was truth behind the warning about the Crystal King, Kai leapt to his feet and shouted for the other ninja to stand back while he melted the bars of their cell. Unfortunately, in his rush to intercept the spiders, Kai summoned a fireball so large, that it continued to fly across the prison after melting the bars, finally dissipating after striking a guard tower in a massive explosion. Kai and the others then rushed off to intercept Pythor from escaping but were forced to stand back when the Crystal Spider that Jay took out activated its self destruct mechanism. Unsatisfied and determined to prevent Pythor from escaping, Kai quickly rose to his feet and impulsively hurled two fireballs at Pythor, but missed and instead set one of Kryptarium's external watchtowers ablaze. Realizing the error of his actions, Kai could only stand nervously as he and the other ninja were surrounded by Kryptarium's guards.

Hounddog McBrag[]

Kai and the other ninja were awoken by the Main Guard to report for work. As he exited their cell, Kai remarked that he did not know prisoners were put to work, though Zane was quick to note that this was actually a very common practice. As he stepped onto the prison bus to be transported to his work site, Kai took a seat in the back of the bus and listened as the Main Guard explained how they would all be cleaning up litter from Route 22.

As the bus traveled alongside the Sea of Sand and briefly stopped for the guards to assist an elderly man with a broken engine, Kai and several other prisoners stepped forward to peer out the window in an attempt to see what was going on. Seconds later, Nya landed behind the prison bus in her new Samurai X Mech and tore open the backdoor, allowing for Kai and the other ninja to escape. The elderly man then drove his van over to where the ninja were hiding and gestured for them to board, taking off at high speed and leaving the guards behind!

After driving for some time, the man pulled off his hat and fake beard, revealing his identity as none other than Dareth, who explained that this was the "last resort" plan he had in mind. After shaking off a lone police cruiser, Dareth's engine actually gave out, and after Kai briefly examined the engine, he exclaimed that they had to quickly get off the road before the police arrived. After putting on their new uniforms provided by P.I.X.A.L., the ninja and Dareth began to traverse the desert on foot. After some time of walking through the sweltering sands, Kai mumbled aloud if anyone knew where they were, though none did. As night fell and the police began combing the area in search of the ninja, Lloyd proposed for the ninja to split into two groups: he would go alongside Jay, Cole, and Fugidove in one direction while Kai, Zane, and Dareth would go the other. Their objective was to find Twitchy Tim's gas station to ask their old ally for his assistance. With no complaints, Kai, Zane, and Dareth began walking off in the opposite direction in search of Twitchy Tim's gas station.

The Benefit of Grief[]

After roaming across the Sea of Sand from night till morning, Kai and his group were all but exhausted; or at least, everyone but Zane. As they neared an open highway, Kai spotted a van driving their way, and he began to run towards it, frantically waving his hands in the air while crying for help. Fortunately, the driver spotted Kai in the rearview mirror and pulled over on the side of the road, asking the group what they were doing in the Sea of Sand. Thinking quickly, Kai claimed that they were camping and got lost, though he was left at a loss for words when the driver asked why he and the others were dressed like the ninja. Fortunately, Dareth stepped in to add to Kai's lie, claiming that they had gone "costume camping," and that it was the latest trend! The driver was convinced by these assertations and kindly offered the three a lift in her van.

As they began driving off, Dareth asked the driver if she was sure that she didn't recognize Kai or Zane, causing Kai clear distress as he nervously chuckled and stated simply that Dareth was only cracking a joke. He then elbowed Dareth in the shoulder and silently glared at him with a brief headshake before changing the topic to the driver, having noticed on a guitar case that her name was Sally, asking if she was moving. Sally then affirmed Kai's assumption, explaining that she was heading to Ninjago City to pursue her dreams of becoming a famous singer, even revealing that the song being played on her radio was one that she had written. As Sally turned on the volume of her radio, Kai seemed to enjoy Sally's song and bopped his head as he listened to it. Unfortunately, Zane's seemingly innocent question about a photograph on the van's dashboard that depicted Sally and her parents led to the young woman suddenly breaking down with heavy sobbing, losing control over the van in the process! Alarmed by the situation, Kai frantically gasped for Zane to do something, which Zane obliged by pulling the van's emergency brake.

When the van came to a stop, Sally rushed out the door crying, and Kai and the others stepped out to comfort her, though Kai stopped short of doing so when he noticed how hard she was sobbing. The ninja and Dareth then learned that Sally had run away from home after her parents asked her to wait a few years until she was older before pursuing her dream of becoming a singer, leading for her to take her father's van without asking in an effort to pursue her dreams. But now however, the young woman could only feel a sense of regret and shame for abandoning her parents without another word and damaging the van during her journey to Ninjago City. At that moment, a Ninjago Police helicopter flew by, and after spotting the ninja, turned around to order for them to stand down. Sally misinterpreted this situation as her father calling the police on her and she immediately ran back into her van and sped off, even while Kai tried to explain that the police weren't after her. As she began driving off, Kai frantically shouted for his allies to run after her and climb onboard the fleeing van.

In the chase that followed, Kai gripped his seat tightly as Sally nearly ran into the police helicopter when it landed in the street in an attempt to end the chase.
