When Sally then drove off into the desert and barely stopped at the edge of a ravine, she realized that the police were not after her, but rather her guests, causing Kai to exasperatedly state that he had been trying to tell her this for the entirety of the chase. When Sally demanded to know why the ninja were being hunted by the police, Kai sheepishly restated Sally's own words, claiming that they had "borrowed something without asking," though Sally admonished him instead for stealing! At that moment, the ground beneath Sally's van gave way, taking it and its occupants into the rapid flowing river below.

As the van's occupants rode the rushing waters, Kai was shocked to discover that Hounddog McBrag drove his own SUV into off the ravine after them, incredulously asking who this insane man was. Eventually, the ninja were able to lose McBrag when Zane froze the entire river behind the van, trapping McBrag's SUV while they escaped. After driving a short while later, Sally stopped her van to begin sobbing again, though after some encouragement and reassurance from the ninja, she drove back to her family farm to return to her parents. Kai and his allies then watched with broad smiles as Sally and her parents were reunited before turning and walking off into the distance to continue their long journey home.

The Fifth Villain[]

After traveling through the desert for some time, Kai and his group found their way to Twitchy Tim's gas station far ahead of the other group. As the sun blazed on overhead, Kai, Zane, and Dareth now sat around Twitchy's cool, shaded porch where they refreshed themselves with bottles of crisp, delightful water. After some time, Kai downed yet another bottle as Zane called out the arrival of the other group of ninja, pointing towards Cole who was frantically rushing up to the porch. Mistakingly believing that Cole was rushing forward to see them, Kai extended one of his hands towards his friend while greeting him warmly, but Cole brushed Kai off to rush into the gas station while begging for water, leaving Kai alone to scratch his head in confusion.

Once all the ninja were settled in, they began to discuss their next moves regarding the Crystal King, learning from Fugi-Dove the existence of a Crystal Council. Deciding it would be most efficient to capture and replace the next villain who was likely to be recruited, the ninja began to brainstorm which of their remaining, non-deceased, foes could be invited next, with Kai suggesting the possibilities of either the Hands of Time or Garmadon being likely candidates. Kai's suggestions, however, would be shot down by Lloyd who pointed out that no one knew of the current whereabouts of Acronix, Krux, or even Garmadon, and thus it seemed unlikely they would be approached to join the Crystal King. Jay then suggested the possibility of the Mechanic being recruited to the council, and all of the ninja agreed that he seemed to be the most likely choice. Before they could make any further moves however, Hounddog McBrag and his squadron of officers arrived outside of the gas station and called for the ninja to surrender.

As the police entered the store to search for the ninja, Kai and the others dove behind the store's counter but were soon given up by Twitchy Tim. Before anyone could do anything else, Fugi-Dove revealed himself and attacked the officers, taking attention away from the ninja just long enough for them to escape outside. There, Kai destroyed one of the two police SUVs with a fireball, flipping the vehicle over while setting its chassis ablaze. Once they ensured that they could not be followed, Kai and the others stole the other SUV to begin driving to Ninjago City.

Night had fallen by the time the ninja returned to Ninjago City and investigated the lair of the Mechanic. Although the derelict arcade seemed devoid of any sign of the once small time crook, Kai pointed out that the presence of many robo arms suggested his lingering presence. At that moment, the Mechanic revealed himself, attacking the ninja with his lair's many mechanical arms. During the fight, Kai attempted to strike at the Mechanic with Spinjitzu, but was ripped out of his tornado by the Mechanic's extendable robo-arm and was hurled into Cole, knocking the Ninja of Earth out of his own Spinjitzu tornado as well. Nevertheless, the ninja managed to defeat the Mechanic by dropping an arcade cabinet for Prime Empire onto him and Kai laughed at Jay's joke that poked fun at the irony of the Mechanic's situation.

Once the Mechanic was tied up, Kai and the other ninja, save Lloyd, brought their prisoner onboard his own Noodle Truck of Crime, intending to use it to locate the Council of the Crystal King.

The Council of the Crystal King[]

With Lloyd's tracker on the move, Kai took the wheel of the Noodle Truck of Crime and began navigating across Ninjago City's streets with Zane's directions. As he drove, Kai briefly expressed disdain over Jay's question as to why Lloyd was going undercover instead of Zane, reminding the Ninja of Lightning that Zane could not go undercover because only he was able to access the tracker's location.

After some time, Lloyd's location suddenly sped off very quickly, forcing Kai to press on the truck's acceleration in an effort to catch up. Unfortunately, the Mechanic managed to untie himself at this moment and began fighting against Cole and Jay while also activating some of the truck's gadgets and causing it to flip over. Kai and the other ninja then pursued the Mechanic down into the subway tunnels where he would be knocked into the path of an oncoming train by the villain. Reacting to the imminent threat, Kai used his Spinjitzu to leap back onto the platform ledge and subsequently hurled a fireball at the Mechanic, though the villain was able to evade his attack.

During the fight that broke out, Kai caught Cole after the latter was thrown through the air by the Mechanic, but both would be knocked into the tracks once more by the Mechanic's extendable robo-arm. Before they could recover, Jay's misdirected bolts of electricity ran through the metal train tracks and shocked Kai and Cole into submission just as another train made its approach through the tunnels. Fortunately, both of them would be carried to safety by Zane, and Kai would once again attempt to retaliate with a fireball, but this attack too would be dodged. As the Mechanic escaped along the passing train, Kai informed the other ninja that they would have to warn Lloyd about their failure at keeping the Mechanic restrained before the real Mechanic could meet up with the rest of the Council.

The Spider's Design[]

Kai and the other three ninja made their way down towards the N line, having tracked Lloyd's last known location as being within its vicinity. As they came across a derelict subway car, Kai dismissed it as a "rusted piece of junk," and expressed confusion over Jay's admiration for it. As Jay began to gush over the car while identifying it as a BRTM-12, Kai sarcastically asked Jay if he collected toy trains as a kid, discovering to his surprise that he was half right about the claim. Nevertheless, Kai remained unimpressed by the subway car and impatiently asked for Jay to continue moving so that they could find Lloyd.

As the ninja neared the end of the N line, Zane informed the others that his sensors were picking up a peculiar tapping sound in the surrounding area. Unsure of the source, Kai ordered the others to spread out and search for the source of the sound. When the source was revealed to be the clattering of hundreds of Crystal Spiders armed to detonate, Kai and the others began running back down the tunnel from whence they came. As they ran, Kai tripped twice and was hastily helped back to his feet by Cole before finally leaping into the BRTM-12 just as the spiders detonated. Once the rubble settled, Kai ignited a flame to illuminate the darkened train car and watched on as his allies celebrated their survival. As he listened on to their conversation, Kai briefly shook his head in disappointment when Jay stated that he had no idea how the ninja were to escape from the now entombed train car.

The Fall of the Monastery[]

With the initial joy of survival having worn off, Kai and the other ninja began examining their circumstances more closely. Acknowledging that they were buried under a massive amount of rubble, Kai asked Cole if the latter could use his powers to safely clear a way out. Although Cole tried to do so, Kai and the others quickly realized that Cole would not be able to move any of the stones without causing the BRTM-12 ceiling to completely cave in. With no other options, Kai attempted to radio the Monastery for backup, only to discover that his signal could not penetrate the huge amount of debris. Kai then gave his communicator over to Zane who offered to attempt to amplify the signal.

Mere seconds after successfully reaching the team stationed at the Monastery, the train car's ceiling began to collapse from the weight of the debris, forcing Kai and the others to hastily evacuate through an emergency exit located on the car's floor. Kai would be the last ninja to exit the train, just narrowly managing to avoid being crushed.

Darkness Within[]

Although Kai and the other ninja managed to barely escape from certain doom, they still remained buried beneath the damaged BRTM-12 in the collapsed subway tunnels. The experience of leaping from the frying pan into the fire had so far done little to improve Kai's spirits, for he was just as standoffish and short with his allies as he had been before, snapping at Cole and Zane for their respective commentaries on their situation and rats respectively. Kai's tone would slightly improve however when Zane revealed that rats were experts at sneaking through narrow crevices, and by following the rat, the ninja were able to begin ascending to the surface.

Unfortunately, their ascension was cut short when Jay slipped and shifted the debris around them, forcing Kai to save the lightning ninja from being struck by a large piece of loose concrete. As they sat along in their 'cave', Kai tried to remain hopeful, noting that the rest of their team were now aware of their situation and would soon be arriving. To help pass the time, Jay offered to sing a folksong about cursed ramen, though neither Kai nor the others were familiar with the song. Unfortunately, Jay's song was accompanied by a small dance and that had the consequence of further disturbing the ninja's already unstable position. As a massive piece of asphalt fell atop the ninja, Kai and the others tried their best to hold up the large chunk of debris, but found their strength quickly slipping away. Just as they were about to accept their fate, the ninja felt the piece of debris grow lighter and turned upwards awe as they glimpsed sunlight for the first time in a while.

With some help from Nya and her new mech, Kai and the others finally stepped into the streets of Ninjago City, out from the subway tunnels. They then learned from her that the Council of the Crystal King had destroyed the Monastery of Spinjitzu and that Harumi had returned from her seeming death all those years ago. Without time to lose, the ninja climbed aboard the mech and flew off to the old Samurai X Cave in the Sea of Sand. As they neared the entrance to the hideout, Nya's mech gave out from its sustained damages, landing just outside of the base as Kai commented on the timing of the mech's failure. After entering the hideout, Kai and his sister received a warm hug from Skylor, much to Kai's obvious relief and delight at seeing her again. He then asked Wu and the others if Harumi had truly returned and what she could possibly want with the Golden Weapons. Although none knew the answer to the second question, Kai knew for sure that whatever her plan was, it could not have been good and she has had many years to plan.

The Coming of the King[]

Kai and Cole were working together on one of the drills for the ninja Ultra Combo Mech. Kai was confident that he had fixed it and encouraged Cole to test it. Unfortunately, as soon as Cole activated the drill, it unexpectedly burst into flames. In a state of panic, Kai urgently told Cole to turn it off, and Master Wu swiftly extinguished the fire. Soon, Nya revealed that Lloyd's tracker was now back online and located in Primeval's Eye. Wu firmly declared that they needed to retrieve the Bounty, even though it was impounded and locked away with the other vehicles. He acknowledged that the only solution was to steal them, but would mean breaking the law once again. Kai respectfully addressed Master Wu, expressing that he and the others had already made their decision.

Return to Primeval's Eye[]

Standing atop an adjacent rooftop, Kai and the other four ninja carefully planned their move on the Ninjago City Impound Lot. After infiltrating the impound lot, Kai retook his Golden Dragon Raider and deactivated its camouflage when they were discovered by the security guards, seeing no point in keeping it active anymore. With their vehicles recovered, the ninja sped off to Primeval's Eye where Kai established a perimeter around the jungle to patrol alongside Jay and Cole. As they patrolled, the three were contacted by Wu and Kai affirmed their current positioning before Wu ordered them all to retreat.

Crystastrophe[]

In their vehicles, Kai, Cole, and Jay were ordered to intercept something in the Farmers' village; Wu had neglected to give them specific details as to what they were to encounter, having only stated that they wouldn't miss it for their target was obvious. Not long after, the three stopped their vehicles in disbelief as they caught a glimpse of the Crystal Island floating in the skies above them.

As an army of Crystal Warriors rained down upon the village, Kai ordered his allies to begin making attack runs. During this process, the ninja learned that their foes were made entirely out of Vengestone and strange crystals, the latter of which Kai questioned regarding their functions. The answer would be revealed seconds later as the three watched to their horror as one of the villagers was grabbed by the crystal warriors and transformed into a Crystal zombie. Startled by what he had witnessed, Kai emphasized the importance of not touching the Warriors to the other ninja, following it up afterwards with a warning not to get blasted by one either after witnessing the results of the latter on an unfortunate villager. He and the other two continued fighting on the ground as Zane arrived to back them up. Kai then ordered Zane to take out the Crystal Island, though this endeavor would end in failure as the ninja continued to lose ground in the battle.

After several rounds of fighting, P.I.X.A.L. requested for the ninja to collect a piece of crystal for her to analyze, suggesting that after some study, she might be able to develop counter-measures for it. In the end, Jay was able to break off a piece from one of the spears wielded by the crystal warriors, knocking it towards Kai who caught it in a compartment of his Golden Dragon Raider. With the fragment secured, Kai and the others retreated to deliver their quarry to P.I.X.A.L.

A Lesson in Anger[]

After returning to the Samurai X Cave, Kai and the other ninja gathered around as Wu told them about his discovery of the Oni form and its potential ability to defeat the Crystal army. When Kai asked Wu how he learned about this Oni form, the answer to Kai's question soon revealed itself in the form of Garmadon. Unsurprisingly, the sight of the ninja's old foe alarmed Kai, who immediately ignited his hands and prepared to attack Garmadon. However, Garmadon insisted that he had changed since their last encounter years prior and now aspired to be a kind and patient teacher towards Lloyd so that the latter could achieve Oni form.

As Lloyd struggled to achieve Oni form, Kai and the others watched on with increasing discomfort as Garmadon began lambasting Lloyd for every perceived failure. This led Kai to suggest that Garmadon had no idea how to even achieve Oni form, let alone teach it, though Garmadon retorted in response that one would have to embrace anger and channel that rage through their face. Eventually, Lloyd snapped under Garmadon's comments and inadvertently accessed his dormant power over Destruction, which Kai hesitantly pointed out by informing Lloyd that the former's hands were purple. Not long after, P.I.X.A.L. informed the team that she had completed upgrades to the ninja's vehicles, enabling them to challenge the Crystal army head on. In response to this news, Kai and the other three original ninja rushed to their vehicles and sped off towards Ninjago City.

Brave But Foolish[]

Arriving in the streets of Ninjago City, Kai was quick to activate his Golden Dragon Raider's new upgrades and immediately testing them against a massive platoon of Crystal Warriors, shattering them instantly. Delighted by these results, Kai continued his onslaught, firing his raider's cannons or simply running over the warriors. Eventually, Kai's frequent usage of the Raider's energy shielding began overheating his engine and forced him to reluctantly deactivate it for the time being.

Kai then drove alongside Cole in the streets of the city in search of more enemies to fight, though both ninja's focus left them unprepared for a sneak attack from a Dragonide. As Kai's raider was lifted into the air, Cole gave his friend a cursory glance and remarked that he was unaware that flight was part of Kai's raider's capabilities. The confusion over Cole's comment led Kai to realize his situation, and after several fruitless attempts to shoot behind him, the Dragonide dropped Kai's raider atop of Cole's dragon cruiser. Surprised by the sudden collision, Cole lost control over his vehicle and ended up crashing both his and Kai's vehicles shortly thereafter.

Safe Haven[]

Awakening with a groan, Ka briefly examined his surroundings before recalling the crash. As he glanced downwards, Kai spotted Cole lying unconscious below and began to call out towards him, hoping to rouse him. When mere whispers failed, Kai exited his vehicle's damaged cockpit to retrieve Cole, hearing an all too familiar voice nearby. Kai then dragged Cole's semi-conscious body behind a dumpster as Pythor and his Crystal Warriors searched the surrounding area for the two ninja. When they were finally discovered by Pythor, Kai responded by knocking away the dumpster and hurling several fireballs at their old foe, though Pythor extinguished the flames with his Nunchucks of Destruction.

Fortunately, Skylor arrived just in time to back them up, copying Kai and Cole's powers and using them in conjunction to hold off Pythor and his warriors. As they searched for shelter, Kai and Cole learned from Skylor that the rest of the ninja were scattered across the city and that the Destiny's Bounty had crashed in separate areas of the sprawling metropolis. Kai then had an idea and led his allies to Benny's Arcade, declaring that if they had to hide somewhere, may as well hide somewhere awesome! Seconds later, Kai was startled by Jake, who had also hid in the arcade because it was awesome. Although Kai recognized Jake's face, he could not recall the young boy's name until he stated it.

After receiving Wu's broadcast, Kai realized that his usage of the paperboys' motto ("The news never sleeps!"), was a clue serving to lead other survivors to shelter. He then began to lead his allies to the Newspaper warehouse, scouting on ahead for any dangers that might come their way. Upon reaching the warehouse entrance, the group were surprised by the presence of a large group of Crystal Zombies, forcing Kai and Skylor to activate their fire powers in an effort to ward off the infected. Fortunately, the paperboys swooped in time to provide backup, hurling stacks of newspapers to knock out the zombies and clear the way forward. Upon entering the warehouse, Kai and Cole were given a warm hug by Wu, who was glad to see that they had survived. While Cole ran on ahead to see what he could do for the Resistance, Kai hung back momentarily with Skylor as they watched Jake reunite with his parents.

Compatible[]

In the newspaper warehouse, Kai stood before the citizens of Ninjago, empathizing with their fear and exhaustion caused by the crystal army's invasion. To lift their spirits, he and Skylor discovered bowls of noodles in the warehouse and distributed them among the crowd. As they gave the noodles out, Kai mustered the courage to ask Skylor to be his girlfriend. However, she was understandably annoyed by his prolonged absence and his desire to start a relationship amidst the chaos of the crystal infection. Kai then shared his journey after the Oni's invasion, and Skylor suggested they prioritize saving Ninjago before delving into their relationship.

Distress Calls[]

Alongside Skylor, Kai oversaw the training of the members of the Resistance.

An Issue of Trust[]

Kai reunited with the rest of the ninja outside the newspaper warehouse, where he shared a hug with P.I.X.A.L. He and the others were then ushered inside where Wu went over his discovery of Dragon Form. As Wu explained the concept of Dragon Form, Kai realized that the procedure required the ninja to "Jump up, kick back, whip around, and spin." He and the other ninja, save Nya, then attempted to perform the art though to no avail.

After several hours of failed attempts, Kai conceded to Wu his feeling that their attempts to achieve the technique were not working. At that moment, Cyrus Borg informed the Resistance that the Crystal King was moving his entire army towards the newspaper warehouse. Alarmed by this news, Kai urgently voiced that they had to move the civilians out from the warehouse, though Cole was quick to bring up counterpoints to Kai's insistence of haste. In response, Garmadon and Lloyd expressed an intention to take the fight to the Crystal King directly - a proposition Kai supported and offered to assist in. In spite of Kai's enthusiasm, Wu shot down his volunteering and emphasized that he and the other ninja were needed on the ground to keep the Crystal King's focus away from Lloyd and his father. Kai was then ordered to weld shut the newspaper warehouse's loading dock doors in preparation of the final battle to come.

Once all preparations were completed, Kai took position outside the newspaper warehouse and awaited for the approaching Crystal army. As their foes came to a grinding halt a few blocks away, Kai quietly asked his allies what the Crystal army was waiting for. After Cole's suggestion that they were waiting for someone to speak to them and Jay's subsequent speech, an unimpressed Kai flatly thanked Jay "for nothing" as the Crystal army began their assault. The final battle had begun.

Dragon Form[]

Kai fought hard against the approaching Crystal Warriors, but was disarmed of his golden sword as the warriors steadily pushed their way forward. Relieved of his weapon, Kai was forced to back away towards the newspaper warehouse with his allies, bracing themselves for the end. As he glared at his opponents, something shifted in the Crystal army's ranks as they were attacked from above by the Army of Shintaro! Kai then watched on, speechless, as more and more of the ninja's allies gathered together to provide aid, breaking up the ranks of the Crystal Warriors as they arrived. Nya suddenly realized that this was the moment mentioned in the scroll's riddle and reminded the ninja, leading Kai to exclaim aloud to the others that this was the moment prophesized by Quanish. With Wu's urging, he and the other three original members of the ninja once again attempted to unlock Dragon Form and successfully achieved the art.

With the pure powers of Fire at his command, Kai flew into several of the Crystal Warriors, shattering them immediately on impact, before shifting his attention towards Aspheera. As the Sorceress gulped and shielded her face upon spotting him, Kai accelerated forward and rammed into his target, knocking her from her Dragonide. Kai and Aspheera would then battle atop one of the city's rooftops in a battle where Kai began to slowly take the upper hand. As he charged towards Aspheera, however, Kai suddenly found himself stopping in midair and was thrown about to his confusion until Pythor revealed himself. Fortunately, Jay came to Kai's aid and attacked Pythor, challenging the Anacondrai for the control over the Nunchucks of Destruction. With Pythor restrained, Kai resumed his attack on Aspheera and wrenched away the Sword of Destruction from her hands. Kai then followed Jay's example and channeled his elemental power directly into the sword, purifying it back into the Sword of Fire!

With victory on the ground battle achieved, Kai regrouped with the other three ninja to celebrate their recovery of the Golden Weapons before flying down to celebrate, with Kai running to hug Skylor. After sharing a moment with the Master of Amber, Kai regrouped with Wu and the other ninja just as Aspheera slithered over to decry their victory. Before the Sorceress could proclaim again that she would have revenge, Zane blasted her with his cryogenic abilities, much to Kai's relief. Unfortunately, victory would be cut short moments later, for the Crystal Island above them now crackled with energy as it began moving towards the center of the city. Kai and the others were then informed by Wu about the Overlord's intention to corrupt the Elements of Creation. Although Kai asked about a possible solution to thwart the Overlord's plan, Wu responded that the battle had already been lost.

Roots[]

Upon realizing that the Golden Weapons needed to be united, Wu encountered opposition from Kai, who reminded him of the previous warning that the action would result in the weapons being destroyed. Wu clarified that uniting the weapons would allow their Elemental Powers to be casted out as they manifest in their original form, thereby preventing the Crystal King from obtaining the powers and destroying the Balance. Zane concurred with Wu's assessment, acknowledging that was the only solution to preserve the Balance, even though it entailed relinquishing Ninjago to the Overlord since there was no other way. Reluctantly, Kai and the other ninja agreed and proceeded to the rooftop of the newspaper warehouse. After Zane proclaimed how he could not have better friends to stand by with, Kai and the other ninja saluted the end. Following the successful union and destruction of the Golden Weapons, the ninja were corrupted by the Crystal King.

After Lloyd defeated the Crystal King, Kai and the other ninja, now purified of corruption, looked up at the Crystal Island. Wondering whether they won, Kai witnessed the island blow apart. He and the other ninja then ran to meet Lloyd. They looked at Harumi suspiciously until Lloyd reassured them that she was on their side. Looking at the Golden Ultra Dragon, Jay wondered whether it was what he thought it was, to which Kai responded that it was their Elemental Powers. The ninja petted the Golden Ultra Dragon, with Kai petting the Fire Dragon. After the dragon departed, Wu informed the ninja that their Elemental Powers were going back to where they came from. When Kai asked him whether they would ever get them back, Wu replied that power is never truly lost. As everyone else embraced their family or friends, Kai walked to Skylor.

A week later, after Kai and the other ninja put up the Monastery's gate, Zane told him that it would take over 12 years to rebuild the Monastery, to which Kai sarcastically responded that he always knew what to say. Dareth then arrived, telling the ninja he brought a lot of help to rebuild the Monastery. While everyone else was rebuilding the Monastery, Kai attempted to kiss Skylor before he was interrupted by Dareth.

After Crystalized

After Crystalized[]

After losing his Elemental Power, Kai left the monastery and moved to a small apartment, frequently visiting Skylor at Chen's Noodle House.

Quest for the Lost Powers

Quest for the Lost Powers[]

One day, while sitting morosely at Chen's Noodle House, Kai absentmindedly picked at a bowl of noodles while conversing with Skylor, the latter of whom expressed concern over Kai's wellbeing. In return, Kai brushed off his girlfriend's concerns, insisting that things were pointless now that he no longer had his elemental power of fire. When Skylor was called back to the kitchen, the restaurant was attacked by the Rotten Rabbits, one of the many amateur criminal gangs that had sprung up following the Final Prophecy of Quanish the Elder. Although the restaurant's patrons warned that they were under the protection of Kai, the thugs failed to recognize him and even mocked his disheveled appearance. Angered by their mockery, Kai sprang into action, preparing to unleash a burst of Spinjitzu against them, but was thwarted and dogpiled before he could. After being saved by Skylor, Kai bemoaned his loss as yet another example of why he was worthless without his powers. Before Skylor could respond, both Elemental Masters' attention was turned towards the restaurant's television, upon which Gayle Gossip reported on the Fire Fiends and the alleged reappearance of Fire Fang.

Upon hearing this report, Kai's eyes lit up. Fire Fang had been brought to life by Aspheera with his stolen elemental power of fire, so in theory, if Kai could defeat Fire Fang, surely he would get his powers back, right? Almost immediately, Kai rose from his seat and prepared to rush out the door, but Skylor stopped him and urged him to think things through before rushing off. Taking her advice, Kai returned to his apartment for the night and would be picked up by Skylor the next morning in her delivery tuk-tuk. The pair then drove off towards the village where Fire Fang was allegedly seen, conversing about a variety of subjects as they made their way to the village. After several hours of travel, the pair arrived in the village and learned more about the Fire Fiends from the locals - namely that the cult once largely kept to themselves by the Lake of Fire until Fire Fang reappeared and they began worshipping the fiery snake as a deity, even looting nearby villages to acquire offerings for their new deity. Not long afterwards, the village came under attack by the Fire Fiends.

Springing into action, Kai promptly ripped into a Spinjitzu tornado to combat the marauding cultists. Unfortunately, their incendiary weaponry proved to be too much for the former Master of Fire to handle, greatly slowing his efforts. With Skylor's help however in toppling a water tower to douse the cultists, Kai was able to swiftly mop up their opposition and force them to retreat. When Skylor complimented Kai afterwards, and although he was internally grateful, he hid his graciousness behind a veil of feigned anger, insisting that he didn't need Skylor's help to defeat the Fire Fiends. After she replied in annoyance that she was doing her best to tolerate Kai's difficult behavior, but her patience was beginning to wear thin, Kai apologized and admitted he was unsure if defeating Fire Fang would even restore his powers. The two then journeyed onward to the Lake of Fire in complete silence. Upon reaching the gas crater, Kai spotted a nearby cave and surmised it as potentially being Fire Fang's lair. He and Skylor then began making their way the cave entrance, upon which after reaching it, Kai lost his footing and nearly fell into the flames below if Skylor had not been there to rescue him.

Once again, Kai chose to lash out at Skylor, provoking a brief argument that ended when Kai told Skylor to her face that he didn't need her help. He immensely regretted his actions almost immediately after seeing his girlfriend's hurt expression, but nevertheless soldiered onward into the cavern to confront Fire Fang. During the subsequent encounter, Kai quickly realized that he had no idea how to retake his powers from the fiery serpent and at one point tried leaping onto the creature's hood and pressed his hands upon his scales while shouting, "Give me my fire back!" over and over. When Kai's efforts all but failed, Fire Fang threw him off and prepared to roast him alive with his fire breath. Fortunately, Skylor returned just in time to save Kai from the serpent's attack and both began hastily running towards the exit with the Fire Fiends in hot pursuit.

As they ran, Kai though back to the time he chose to save Lloyd over claiming the Fangblade inside the Fire Temple, noting how since that day he had vowed to use his powers in service of saving others. After today's experiences, he realized that in order to save others, he had to be willing to allow them to save him in return. This realization allowed Kai to regain his powers over fire, and with his powers restored, he and Skylor made swift work of the Fire Fiends and Fire Fang. Before they could finish off the giant serpent, the villagers from the earlier village arrived to provide assistance. Together, Kai, Skylor, and the villagers toppled the massive sculpture of Fire Fang into the Lake of Fire, burying the crater and smothering the burning gases within it. Turning their sights now back to Fire Fang, Kai and Skylor were shocked to discover that the defeated serpent had vanished. Although Skylor suggested the possibility that he had recovered and fled, Kai wondered instead if he had succumbed to his injuries and disintegrated like the Elemental Cobras he and the other Ninja had fought years prior. Noting they may never discover the truth, Kai and Skylor returned to Ninjago City to clean up the recent surge in crime.

Before Dragons Rising

Before Dragons Rising[]

When the Merge occured, Kai was on the front of the Bounty and used his element to get rid of the flying debris. When the Sixteen Realms were unified with Ninjago, Kai was separated from the other ninja and woke up in the Land of Monsters.

Monstrosity

Monstrosity[]

After becoming separated from the team, Kai found himself stranded and alone in the Land of Monsters, a realm full of vicious Monsters that inhabit the dangerous land. He spent days embarking on a solitary journey of survival and looking for a way to return home and to his friends.

To Become a Monster[]

While on his travel, Kai found himself caught in a battle between a green dragon and a massive giant who was protecting its eggs. Thinking that the dragon was after the eggs, he intervened and leaped onto the dragon and interrupting her attack, to which the dragon immediately protests Kai's accusations. Despite both Kai and the dragon bickering, the giant monster struck them both and flung them far away.

After crashing a distance away, Kai scrambled to his feet, ignited his sword with Fire, and demanded answers for what he had just experienced. The dragon revealed to him that the giant monster had devoured her own child a long time ago when it destroyed her homeworld, leaving her bitterly hopeless for the future and wanting revenge against the beast by destroying its own unborn young. In horror, Kai protested against the dragon's intended course of actions, though the dragon ignored him and set off on another attack run. He would successfully manage to convince her to stand down after urging her to reflect on herself if she carried out the task and called off her attack. The giant creature, however, spotted Kai and threatened the ninja only to be rescued by the intervention of the green dragon.

After the pair had settled down, Kai thanked the green dragon for saving his life. While she dismissed his words as a sign of weakness, Kai quietly stated that if the dragon felt sparing children was a sign of weakness, then she had no idea what true strength was. Seemingly accepting Kai's retort, the dragon admitted to him that good people usually did not survive for long in the Land of Monsters, adding that she had come to believe it was impossible even to survive here while retaining one's heroism. As she flew off, Kai whispered under his breath his hope that the dragon was wrong.

The Land of Monsters[]

This section is a stub. You can help expand this section by adding some information.


Fallen Master[]

Wandering through the Land of Monsters, Kai unwittingly entered the Cave of Change where he was savagely attacked by the Centipede monster and defeated in combat. Sometime later, Kai cut his way free from the cocoon the centipede monster had imprisoned him in and began to search for another way to escape the cave. Unfortunately, while Kai did discover another opening, it led to a precarious drop - one that he would likely not survive. Kai then turned to inspect one of the mechs that lay rusted in the cave; as he approached, the wind blew some of the flames from his torch into a vent on the mech's chest and before Kai's eyes, the rust was burned away as the mech came back online.

The Mech greeted Kai with surprise, initially mistaking him for his master, only to recall what had happened. Kai pleaded with the mech, stating he needed his strength to escape from the cave, though the Mech refused, citing that he no longer had a purpose or a reason to fight. Unwilling to accept 'no' as an answer, Kai restored the Mech's spear and slammed it down before the Mech, stating he would fight the monster with or without the Mech's help but if the Mech's master was truly as great as the Mech claimed, he would want the Mech to carry on.

Approaching the cave entrance, Kai unsheathed his flaming sword and called out to the Centipede monster, attracting its attention as it immediately lunged at Kai. At that moment, the Mech intercepted the monster's attack, stating to Kai that he had chosen to carry on. Kai then realized that the Centipede monster was the Mech's master albeit assimilated and transformed. He offered to slay the beast, but the Mech stopped him and performed the killing blow himself.

After escaping, Kai and the Mech gathered the fallen master's belongings and burned them on a funeral pyre, holding a funeral to honor the dead.

False Light[]

Traveling alongside Rusty, the mech, for an unknown period of time, Kai grew increasingly desperate and hopeless. Passing through the mist covered banks of lake, Kai's frustrations had reached its tipping point as he angrily threw his compass to the ground, cursing it. When Rusty spoke, Kai turned his anger onto the mech, demanding to know why he continued to follow him. Recognizing his own misplaced anger moments later, Kai broke down and apologized but confessed that he would do anything for his journey to end. As if on cue, Kai turned his head to the sound of whispers nearby and spotted what appeared to be Master Wu standing just in the distance.

Kai desperately ran after Wu, pleading all the while as Wu seemed to drift further and further away, eventually disappearing beneath the waters of the lake. Gazing into the water, Kai watched as a bright light shone through the surface and he saw the faces of the other ninja all smiling back at him, telling him that he made it and was safe now. Kai took a step forward but was halted by Rusty who cautioned him that things were not as they seemed. Unbeknownst to either at this moment, Kai had been enthralled by the Gimon-Ogu, the monstrous kraken that resided in the lake. Thinking of nothing more than returning home, Kai dismissed Rusty's warnings, arguing that in a place as weird as here, why not a portal in the middle of a lake and also that Rusty was lying to him because the mech still needed him. Kai was wading into the deeper slopes of the lake now and before he was submerged completely, his last words to Rusty were, "I don't need you; I need them."

Following Rusty's self-sacrifice, Kai was snapped back to his senses and discovered himself sinking toward the bottom of the lake. Fortunately, Daidan was there too and she helped to return Kai back to the surface. Leaping off her back, Kai unsheathed his sword and with one mighty strike, killed the Gimon-Ogu. As the sun rose above and the fog now dissipated, Kai and Daidan sat quietly on the banks of the shore, the dragon being the first to speak, acknowledging Kai's prior words to her and that she was wrong in believing it was impossible for good people to survive in the Land of Monsters. Discovering a piece of Rusty's cape, Kai slung it over his shoulder as he remarked on the mech's sacrifice and started walking off, vowing that Rusty's sacrifice would not be in vain.

Kai's Monstrous Journey

Kai's Monstrous Journey[]

The Forest of Teeth! (flashback)[]

Reuniting with Daidan, Kai traveled flew across the Land of Monsters atop her back, but were attacked by a horde of Jungle insects during a raging storm. Daidan was injured in the attack, causing her and Kai to plummet out of the skies to the ground below. When he regained consciousness, Kai rushed to Daidan's side to assess if she was alright, shortly hearing a voice crying out from the surrounding forest. As he turned in the direction of the cry, Kai spotted a small insect like monster fleeing from a long, wooden tendril. Rushing off to provide assistance, Kai discovered to his dismay that the forest was fireproof, forcing him to resort to fighting the old fashioned way with his sword.

After rescuing the small monster, it hopped onto Kai's back and connected its antennae into Kai's head, imbuing him with newfound power. With the power granted by the small monster (named Fuzz), Kai effortlessly cut his way through the Forest of Teeth, slicing his way back to Daidan. Fuzz then detached himself from Kai who mumbled that he wasn't feeling that good and saw that his right hand was now glowing. Fuzz insisted that this was an injury Kai had sustained when escaping the forest and that he would get better soon. In response, Kai only hoped that Fuzz was right before suggesting to his companions that they ought to seek shelter for the night, unaware that a hooded figure was watching from behind.

The Ruins! (flashback)[]

Kai and his allies continued to wander, eventually coming across a ruined village. Although Fuzz believed the monster that destroyed the village was long gone, they were shortly attacked by a Monster pig. With Daidan still too weak, Kai was left alone to defend himself and his allies but struggled against the pig, especially after discovering that not only was it fire-proof, but fire also empowered the beast. Kai then requested Fuzz for a powerup but even then still struggled. Before the pig could crush Kai beneath its hoof, the hooded figure from before intervened and together with Kai, the two slew the beast. The man introduced himself as Bolsen, a bounty hunter, and Kai started to ask if he knew a way out of the Land of Monsters but was interrupted by Daidan's roaring. Turning, Kai watched as Daidan was carried off by the jungle insects to a mountain in the distance.

Queen of Monsters! (flashback)[]

Kai and Bolsen raced to the mountain Daidan was taken to and began scaling its slopes to rescue her. In time, the two arrived at the Jungle Insects' lair, where they they found Daidan writhing in pain as her energy was drained by the Queen of Monsters. Before Kai could react, Fuzz greeted the Queen as "Mama," and that he found her a "tasty one," referring to Kai. Angered by the realization, Kai hurled Fuzz off his back and attempted to strike at the Queen. Unfortunately, Kai's blow would be stopped by Bolsen, who had revealed his own monstrous mutations. Fuzz then leaped onto Kai's back and shared his power with the Fire Ninja once more, declaring that Kai would serve as his puppet and not the Queen's, forcing him to clash with Bolsen.

In the ensuing battle, Kai steadily gained the upper hand and defeated Bolsen. This greatly impressed the Queen of Monsters who then agreed that Kai could serve as the new champion of the Jungle Insects, replacing Bolsen. At this moment, Kai snapped out of his enthrallment and hurled Fuzz away, turning his attention back towards the Queen. Bolsen revealed that the Queen's underbelly was her weak spot and worked with Kai to slay the Queen of Monsters. With the Queen's death, Kai was completely cleansed of his mutations. Kai then offered Bolsen a place to travel alongside him and Daidan in hopes of escaping from the Land of Monsters, but Bolsen declined, explaining that he had too many regrets from his actions in service to the Queen and needed to seek redemption for them. With a final handshake, he and Kai parted ways, leaving Kai and Daidan to continue searching for a way to escape from the Land of Monsters.

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

Eventually along the journey, Kai was able to find the lost Destiny's Bounty. With the use of the Bounty, he navigated through strange kingdoms when travelling back to the monastery. A few weeks later, when he arrived back home, he was attacked by Lloyd, who didn't recognise him at first, the two then happily reunited. However, the first MergeQuake occured shortly afterwards. Kai and Lloyd discovered that Elemental Powers were the key at halting the MergeQuakes.

Tales from the Merged Realms

Tales from the Merged Realms[]

Sealing the Cracks[]

Kai and Lloyd worked together to seal off resurgent MergeQuakes that continued to threaten the world. One day, after sealing their third MergeQuake that day, a fourth, stronger one emerged. Unlike the other MergeQuakes they had encountered so far, this one seemed to have the ability to suck things into it, forcing both Ninja to focus their attention firstly on protecting nearby citizens. As they worked on protecting the people, Winged monkeys emerged from the MergeQuake, surprising the pair. After their initial efforts at protecting the populace failed, Kai noticed that one of the Winged Monkeys was eating, and vomiting, stones, covering them in a sticky residue. Realizing these properties of the creature's vomit, Lloyd suggested using the covered stones to construct a massive wall to protect the citizens from being sucked in further. Once the people were safe, Kai and Lloyd used their elemental powers to close the MergeQuake. Afterwards, Kai went off to hunt down the remaining Winged Monkeys while Lloyd returned to the Monastery to continue researching the quakes.

In the Land of Monsters

In the Land of Monsters[]

The Fire Eater (non-canon)[]

Weeks after starting searching for the rest of his friends, while maping the Merged Realms for Lloyd, Kai ended up having to make an emergency landing on the Land of Monsters again. During the next weeks, while searching for any indication for the presence of any of his friends and fighting monsters crossing his path, he stumbled upon an abandoned town where he finds a fire-breathing monster, which he defeats using the water in a water tower, after remembering his sister.

Dragons Rising, Season 1

Dragons Rising, Season 1[]

Beyond Madness[]

At some point after beginning his search for the other ninja, Kai arrived in the Land of Madness, where he discovered a Cragling Village being attacked by a pair of Earth Dragons. After spending some time defending the village, Kai was reunited with his sister, Nya, who had also stumbled upon the village. Together, they fought hard against the Earth Dragons until Kai was flung far off during their combat with the dragons.

Some time later, Kai eventually found his way to the Cragling Village but accidentally awoke the pair of Earth Dragons, forcing him to scramble faster in complete terror as the dragons pursued him. As an impromptu battle began once more outside the Cragling Village, Kai was surprised to be united with Lloyd and his new students, Arin and Sora, sarcastically asking if Lloyd was babysitting now. Due to the fact that he, Nya, and Lloyd, have not worked together for quite some time, their efforts at coordination unfortunately proved to be sloppy at best and they failed to stop the rampaging Earth Dragons.

When Riyu began to supercharge the pair of Earth Dragons, Kai became alarmed and prepared to throw a fireball at Riyu in case he was siding with the Earth Dragons, but was stopped by Lloyd. Following their victory, Kai regrouped with Nya and Lloyd and complimented the latter for finding his new students and dragon.

Writers of Destiny[]

Departing the Land of Madness, Kai was shocked to learn that Arin had taught himself Spinjitzu. Shortly thereafter, the ninja were greeted by the sight of the floating islands and ivory towers of the Cloud Kingdom. As they edged closer, Kai asked if anyone else could feel a strange rumbling just as a nearby tower began to collapse with two monks trapped on top. Heeding their cries for help, Kai and Nya immediately sprung into action, using Spinjitzu to reach the monks, only for all four to be knocked off the side when the ground shook again. Fortunately, Arin was able to rescue them with his grapple gun, earning him Kai's praise. As they briefly recovered, one of the monks explained that the beast was destroying everything. When Nya inquired further about such a beast, for none of the ninja saw one upon entering Cloud Kingdom, Kai was immediately struck by one of the monster's tentacles and flung to the other side of the Bounty.

Springing into action, Kai and Nya helped to escort the two monks to safety before beginning to attack the monster with their powers, only for Kai to learn to his dismay that the beast was impervious to fire. Kai then followed his sister's suggestion and the siblings began to launch themselves with Spinjitzu into the beast's eye, knocking it back bit by bit until it was back into the MergeQuake it had emerged from. Lloyd then sealed the MergeQuake and banished the creature back to its home realm. After the siblings high-fived, Kai and Nya discussed the encounter with Lloyd who expressed concern that the MergeQuakes were not only becoming more frequent, but also were now appearing in places further than the original site of the Merge. Undeterred by Nya and Lloyd's concerns though, Kai decided to speak with a nearby group of Cloud Monks, believing that they were dying to honor the ninja as heroes.

After approaching the Cloud Monks, Kai and the others were greeted by Suetonius, the current Master Writer. When Suetonius stated that the ninja were "welcome," Kai at first took offense to the Master Writer's statement and sarcastically asked if it were "Backwards Day." He soon remembered thereafter that the Cloud Monks believed that anything they wrote immediately became destiny and disdainfully explained it to Sora and Arin. In spite of Kai's comments, Suetonius granted permission for the ninja to access the Cloud Kingdom archives to search for information pertaining to the Merge. Kai, Lloyd, and Nya then followed their appointed guide, Marcus, to the archives. Upon entering the vast archives, Kai commented quietly that any effort at research was going to take a while, prompting Marcus to explain the Scroll-Worms to his guests. Demonstrating by asking a worm to find information about "Lloyd Garmadon," Kai started snickering when the worm revealed that Lloyd picks his nose and eats it, prompting Kai to christen Lloyd as the "Master of Green Boogers." Shortly thereafter, the Scroll-Worm Nya had asked about MergeQuakes turned red when reciting information to them and attacked the ninja and Marcus, encasing the four in silk cocoons and suspending them from the ceiling of the archives.

Eventually, Kai was released from the cocoon by Arin and Lloyd, allowing him to join in on the fight taking place outside between Euphrasia, Sora, and three more Tentacled Beasts that had emerged out of a second MergeQuake. Notably, Kai and Nya used their Spinjitzu in conjunction with Euphrasia's winds to bounce the third beast back into the MergeQuake before joining the powers alongside those of Lloyd and Euphrasia to seal the MergeQuake. With the day saved, Kai and Nya discussed with Marcus about the Scroll-Worms, reacting with shock and horror when the latter suggested that someone may have placed a curse upon them to keep certain information hidden. Afterwards, Nya decided to stay in Cloud Kingdom to research the archives while Kai and the others left for the Monastery. Waving his sister off, Kai told her to find them at the Monastery when she found something they could use before turning to Lloyd and jokingly naming him "Boogers." Kai then laughed at to Lloyd's unamused reaction as the Bounty departed Cloud Kingdom.

Return to Imperium[]

Kai joined the ninja on a mission to save Jiro from the Claws of Imperium. While impressed with Arin's abilities, Kai suggested that he should improve his punching technique after Arin accidentally hit himself in the face while trying to strike an Imperium Drone. Their triumph over the Dragon Hunters was short-lived when Rapton employed a Photac. Initially thinking it was just a hologram, Kai soon discovered that the Photac Beast was actually composed of solid light when it sent him flying. Attempting to combat the Photac with his Fire, Kai realized that it was unaffected, leading him to conclude that the Photac was indestructible, which he deemed unfair. The ninja hid from the Photac and tried to come up with a plan to defeat it, but their efforts were futile as the Claws of Imperium managed to escape with Jiro. Feeling defeated, Kai asked what they should do next, to which Sora suggested that she must return to Imperium to destroy the Photac.

Kai accompanied Lloyd, who was concerned about Arin and Sora's mission to Imperium. Arin, however, remained confident and reminded Lloyd of their progress in training, as well as the wise words of Master Wu. Kai chimed in, humorously imitating Master Wu's advice. Arin emphasized the importance of teamwork, stating that they were stronger together. Despite his initial hesitation, Lloyd eventually agreed to join them. Kai, excitedly, suggested going as well, but Lloyd insisted he stay behind to protect Ninjago from any potential MergeQuakes.

I Will Be the Danger[]

Early in the morning, Kai closed a MergeQuake on his own. Exhausted, he later retreated back to the Monastery and booted up Lava Zombies, declaring that he deserved this time to relax after his efforts earlier in the day. Seconds later, the computer shut off much to Kai's frustration, followed by all the power in the Monastery. Hearing a familiar voice echoing around him, Kai followed the voice down to the hanger bay where a mysterious glowing orb manifested in front of a strange gate. Believing he had encountered a ghost, Kai pursued the orb into the gate where he then ran into Nya. Surprised to see her, Kai asked how she made it to the Monastery, to which Nya, equally confused, asked Kai how he made it to the Cloud Kingdom archives.

The Calm Inside[]

Inside the Monastery of Imperium, Kai and Nya discussed their current situation and how they were both led here by a strange spirit. Kai briefly defended his playing of video games when Nya sarcastically remarked it was shocking to hear he had been playing them just as the spirit materialized. Following the spirit, the siblings were led to a Techno-cocoon and given the vague instructions of, "It must rise." Kai seemed fixated on how the spirit whispered with Master Wu's voice while Nya cautioned that it could have been a trick. Nevertheless, both siblings decided that the only way to know for sure was to activate the capsule. Eventually, Nya finished up most of the necessary engineering fixes to the capsule while Kai began repeatedly kicking it. When Nya asked him why he thought kicking the capsule would help, Kai admitted that he wasn't an engineer like she was before welding several spots per her instruction. Nya then activated the capsule, but when nothing changed, Kai gave it several more kicks, finally triggering it and revealing that Zane was housed inside of it! After Zane interfaced with the Monastery of Imperium and activated it to rise in the streets of the city above, Kai, Nya, and Zane left the monastery and stumbled into a battle raging outside.

The Battle of the Second Monastery[]

Kai was perplexed by the abundance of Photacs, as they were intended to only be one. Lloyd proceeded to enlighten Kai, Nya, and Zane regarding the ongoing conflict and the presence of Wyldfyre. Witnessing Wyldfyre's fiery projections and lacking knowledge of Heat's existence, Kai hastily accused Wyldfyre to be an Elemental Master of Fire, something he deemed inconceivable and offensive. During the battle, Zane announced that their chances of winning the battle were slim. And Kai sarcastically responded. Zane suggested that their only option is to retreat to the Monastery of Imperium, which could temporarily keep the Claws out. However, when Wyldfyre refused to retreat, Kai agreed with her.

As the ninja made their way back to the Monastery of Imperium, Kai and Wyldfyre once again found themselves in agreement about not wanting to retreat. They celebrated their unity by exchanging a high five, using their Elemental Powers. Nya proposed using the portal gate they had initially arrived from to safely evacuate the dragons. However, Zane cautioned that the portal gate was only designed for smaller transports and would not be able to handle the transfer of so many dragons, unless there was an additional source of energy. Zane discovered a powerful energy source underneath Imperium and Kai urged Lloyd to act swiftly before the Claws broke through. While Lloyd and Zane set off to locate the energy source, Kai and the rest of the team were filled with apprehension as the Claws of Imperium continued to demolish the walls. Despite Kai's efforts to reassure Nya, he himself was uncertain if they were capable of handling the situation. Suddenly, Lloyd emerged from the ground, empowered by dragon energy, astonishing Kai and the others with his newfound ability. Lloyd utilized his power to activate the portal gate, allowing the dragons to escape. Shortly after, Rapton arrived, demanding to know the whereabouts of the dragons. Kai denied their presence, and Sora, Arin, and Riyu arrived to deactivate the Photacs. The ninja made their way to the portal gate, returning to Ninjago.

Days later, Kai, Nya, and Zane left from the dragon stables to rendezvous with Lloyd. Kai emphasized the importance of catching up, vividly describing Lloyd's impressive display of power when he had dragon power. Although Zane offered some understanding, Kai yearned for a firsthand account from Lloyd himself. In response, Lloyd candidly confessed that he was still struggling to come to terms with the situation, endeavoring to make sense of the predominantly negative visions he had saw. As Lloyd left to talked with Arin, Kai engaged in a conversation with the others.

The Temple of the Dragon Cores[]

One evening, Kai and the other ninja responded to a MergeQuake in the Crossroads. Riding atop an Earth Dragon, Kai tailed behind Wyldfyre and Zane, grumbling about Wyldfyre's comment that she was an upgrade from Kai. Following the successful closure of the MergeQuake, Lloyd asked for Kai to start training Wyldfyre. A few days later, Kai approached Wyldfyre to discuss starting her training; this suggestion earned Kai an immediate fireball from the girl and in annoyance, he sought out Lloyd to complain. Wyldfyre however had followed Kai into the monastery and continued to hurl fireballs at him, prompting a fight between the two that the other ninja had to break up. At that moment, a very annoyed Zane stepped in and demanded for everyone to follow him to the hanger bay, where he showed everyone the data he had been analyzing about the MergeQuakes.

The next day, following research conducted by Nya, the ninja set out in search for the Temple of the Dragon Cores, discovering it within the World Forest. Approaching the entrance to the temple, the ninja were greeted by a door with multiple runes carved against its sides and three levers. When Sora began suggesting an approach to the door puzzle, Kai stepped forward and interrupted her, declaring that he could handle it. Kai pulled down a single lever and two of the runes on the door lit up. With no idea of how to further proceed, Kai declared that he deserved a break for his hard work. Zane then began to analyze the levers and runes, running together every potential combination. After several hours, during which Kai passed the time by tossing a slice of pizza with Arin and napping, Zane declared that he could find no connection between them. Fortunately, the new generation of ninja realized that the levers simply had to all be pulled down at the same time, granting access to the temple.

Entering the temple, the ninja were confronted by a hostile Spirit of the Temple. In the fight that ensued, Kai and Zane were picked up by the Spirit and hurled to the side. Lloyd however realized that the Spirit's alter had been knocked down and he began to rebuild it, calling on Kai and Wyldfyre to light the candles. Kai hurled a fireball first, igniting the wick on the right candle while Wyldfyre's fireball struck and melted half of the left candle. Unimpressed, Kai told Wyldfyre that they would have to work on her precision before listening to the Spirit's tale of the Dragon Cores.

Gangs of the Sea[]

As the Ninja split up into three teams of two to search for the Dragon Cores, Kai was paired up with Wyldfyre, much to his discontent. Wyldfyre didn't seem to be thrilled either, telling the older ninja that while riding atop Heatwave, he would sit behind her in the back; after all, it was the perfect place for his necessary afternoon nap, being an older citizen and all! In response, Kai protested that he was not that old, but conceded naps were awesome.

Eventually, the two arrived at the Greenbone Warriors' forest, where they decided to spend the night to rest. When Kai awoke, he and Wyldfyre were inside a pit known as the Walls of Punishment, and realizing who was to blame, he immediately snapped at Wyldfyre that their predicament was all her fault.

Wyldly Inappropriate[]

Trapped within the Walls of Punishment, Kai began searching for a way to escape while Wyldfyre continued to test his patience with her commentary downplaying their situation. When the Bone King accused the pair of stealing the Greenbone Warriors' gems, Kai tried to defuse tensions, explaining that he and Wyldfyre were on an urgent mission and only stopped in the forest to rest and thus could not have stolen the gems. Unfortunately, Wyldfyre continued to throw a wrench into Kai's efforts by insulting the skeletons and their gems.

Turning his focus back on their more immediate situation, Kai spotted a pattern in the closing Walls of Punishment and pointed it out to Wyldfyre who snarkily retorted that she had figured it out some time ago already. As the two leapt their way out of the pit, Kai briefly paused for a moment to give Wyldfyre a boost when she lost her footing. Upon landing outside, Kai once again tried to explain to the Bone King that neither he nor Wyldfyre stole the Greenbone Warriors' gems, only for Wyldfyre to produce said gems, much to Kai's chagrin. Changing tactics, Kai downplayed the severity of Wyldfyre's actions and tried to appeal to the Bone King who sighed and agreed to let them go on the condition they never came back. Although Kai immediately agreed to the Bone King's proposal, Wyldfyre's continued antics threatened the fragile truce, forcing her and Kai to hurriedly escape atop of Heatwave.

Enroute to the Wyldness, Kai briefly tried to teach Wyldfyre about responsibility but changed course when it became clear she was unwilling to listen. Nevertheless, Kai seemed slightly more relieved about matters when Wyldfyre insisted she was familiar with the Lava-Tides and described them as being her "peeps." Unfortunately, Kai's optimism was very quickly dashed by the time they arrived at the Lava-Tide Village and learned that its residents all absolutely hated Wyldfyre for constantly pranking them and defacing their village. With the Lava-Tides unwilling to hand over the Purple Dragon Core, an increasingly exasperated Kai tried to negotiate with them, agreeing for himself and Wyldfyre to remedy the matters listed on the Lava-Tides' Scroll of Grievances to prove themselves worthy.

Eventually, Kai and Wyldfyre completed every task on the Scroll of Grievances, during which Kai tried once more to get Wyldfyre to change her ways. When the Lava-Tides brought out the Purple Dragon Core and the Lava-Tide Leader requested a handshake with Wyldfyre, Kai held his breath and whispered to himself, hoping that his student wouldn't perform her fire handshake. Fortunately, Wyldfyre did not, but the Lava-Tides nevertheless betrayed the ninja and tossed the Core back into the nearby Pit of No Return. When Kai screamed that they needed the Core to save the world, the Lava-Tide Leader, clearly uncaring, sneered that while Kai's claims were true, the Lava-Tides enjoyed the looks on the ninja's faces more.

As Kai analyzed the Pit, he briefly muttered to himself about how many pits seemed to be involved by hanging out with Wyldfyre. When the latter decided to give up and walk away, Kai appealed to her perceived sense of superiority to convince her in descending the Pit to recover the Core. Despite Kai's warnings to approach it carefully, he wound up being forced to slide in after Wyldfyre as she hopped in with reckless abandon. By swinging across the vines growing out from the pit, Kai and Wyldfyre then managed to acquire the Core and evade a swarm of Death Wasps, with Kai hurling a pair of fireballs to seal off the entrance to the pit. Unfortunately, more problems were in store for the two, for Dorama and his Stagehands were waiting outside to snatch the Core - an encounter that elicited another annoyed groan from Kai.

They Call It Doom[]

Facing Dorama and his Stagehands, Kai and Wyldfyres' first instinct were to hurl fireballs, only for the thespian to dispel them with a twirl of his staff. The Lava-Tides then snatched the dragon core from Dorama, initiating a three-way chase for the core. At one point, Kai managed to corner the Lava-Tide Leader but was driven off when the Leader called for flaming boulders to be rained down upon their enemies.

Kai's patience continued to be tested throughout the entirety of the chase for the Purple Dragon Core, with the Ninja of Fire occasionally breaking down to the point he started loudly complaining about Wyldfyre to himself - especially after Wyldfyre accidentally powered up the Lava-Tide Leader with her fireballs. Fortunately, Kai would not have to suffer much longer, as thanks to Heatwave's intervention, Kai and Wyldfyre were able to snatch the core and flee from the village. As a cruel twist of fate however, Heatwave soon collapsed from the injuries he sustained in battle.

Land of Lost Things[]

Kai led Wyldfyre to search for geodes in the Lava Wastes then showed her that by heating up the crystals, they could be melted into a paste capable of treating Heatwave's injuries. Wyldfyre started to warm up more to Kai as a result of his efforts and admitted that she was becoming more receptive to the idea of Kai serving as her teacher.

The Administration[]

Wyldfyre was frustrated about Heatwave's slow healing process and questioned if the geode was effective. Kai responded by stating that healing took time. However, Wyldfyre disagreed, emphasizing the urgency to heal Heatwave and return the Dragon Core to the other ninja. Kai then explained that impatience only worsen the situation, clouding judgment and leading to poor decisions. Drawing from his own experience, he advised Wyldfyre to learn from Master Wu's techniques, specifically focusing on moving through forms to enhance concentration. Wyldfyre initially dismissed the idea. However, Kai assured her that the practice was not a waste of time and encouraged her to give it a try. Despite attempting to imitate Kai's movements, Wyldfyre struggled to concentrate and became frustrated with her inability to stop worrying about Heatwave's condition. Kai reassured her that the exercise would be most beneficial when she was feeling worried. He reminded her that she was not defined by her emotions and encouraged her to focus on her form, allowing the emotions to pass through her. Kai admitted that he was not known for his patience and shared a personal anecdote about how he had to practice his forms when Nya merged with the Endless Sea. Although he was not as skilled as the other ninja, he persisted until it helped calm him down. Kai believed that if it worked for him, it could work for Wyldfyre too, as she reminded him of his own impulsive nature.

While Kai was training alongside Wyldfyre, Heatwave's injuries healed. However, Kai's attention was soon drawn to the Dragon Core, as it started to flicker. Suspecting foul play, he broke it, discovering that the Dragon Core was fake. The revelation left Kai puzzled and anxious to find the whereabouts of the genuine Core. Both Kai and Wyldfyre soon came to the realization that Dorama had swapped the real Core with a replica. Upon their arrival at the Monastery of Spinjitzu, Kai and Wyldfyre reconvened with Lloyd and Arin. They shared the news that their mission to retrieve the purple Dragon Core had been unsuccessful. Kai also responded that he was unsure that Nya and Sora had managed to find the yellow Dragon Core. Realizing that Beatrix also had an interest in the Dragon Cores, Kai and the rest of the ninja decided to use the Bounty to make their way back to Imperium. There, they witnessed a massive shockwave caused by the energy of the Dragon Cores. Kai voiced his concerns to Lloyd, fearing that infiltrating Imperium would prove to be much more challenging than last time.

Absolute Power[]

While the ninja contemplate their entry into the Kingdom of Imperium, Kai takes the opportunity to remind Wyldfyre of the teachings on inner peace and centering oneself that he had previously shared. However, he advises her to put those ideas aside for now and instead embrace her powers and let loose. Wyldfyre agrees and creates a diversion to attract the attention of the Imperium Guards. With their attention diverted, Kai and the ninja swiftly defeat the guards. After the battle, Kai notices Wyldfyre playing with a Claw Staff and reminds her to stay focused. The ninja seize the guards' hoverboards and use them to fly into the Kingdom of Imperium, gaining entry by using a guard's hand to open the gates.

The source of the explosion was being investigated by the ninja when they unexpectedly encountered more Imperium Guards. Luckily, the guards were swiftly subdued by the Imperium Teen Resistance Force using tasers. Wyldfyre, however, felt let down as she wanted to fight, but Kai recognized that the Imperium Teen Resistance Force had arrived to save them. Subsequently, the Imperium Teen Resistance Force escorted Kai and the others to a safe location away from the view of the Imperium Guards.

We Are All Dragons[]

Percival guided Kai and the ninja through the Kingdom of Imperium. As they make their way, a sudden interruption occurred when Wyldfyre, despite trying to remain stealthy, bursted into a loud song. Sensing the need for silence, Kai stepped in and suggested a more subdued approach to maintain their covert mission, singing in a softer tone. Understanding the importance of discretion, Wyldfyre quickly adjusted and they resume their swift pace through the kingdom. Percival revealed that to retrieve the purple and yellow Dragon Cores, they must go to the Advanced Systems Lab. However, before they can proceed, they must first reach their base undetected, evading any Imperium Guards. Percival hints at the proximity of the tunnel entrance, emphasizing the need for caution. However, their progress was abruptly halted by the arrival of Beatrix, who descends in her Empress Mech, accompanied by the Claw Hunters. Beatrix turned her attention to Kai and the ninja, questioning their audacity to invade the kingdom. Kai responded by remarking that Beatrix underestimates Lloyd's capacity for foolishness, albeit with no intention to offend his friend. Kai observed with fascination as Beatrix wielded her Imperium Sword, successfully blocking the Elemental Powers that were being unleashed. The arrival of Nya and Sora at the Kingdom of Imperium marked a turning point, as they managed to dismantle the energy barrier, triggering an intense battle. Sora, addressing Lloyd with a hint of surprise, remarked on the unexpected encounter, questioning whether Imperium had also stolen his Dragon Core. Lloyd clarified that it wasn't the pink Dragon Core that had been taken, but rather Kai and Wyldfyre's. In response, Kai interjected, emphasizing that the situation shouldn't be seen as a competition.

While Beatrix was occupied by the dragons, the Resistance took advantage of the distraction and made their escape. Percival took them towards a nearby dumpster and jumped inside. Reflecting on his past encounter with the Walls of Punishment and the Pit of No Return, Kai remained resolute and, along with the other members of the Resistance, proceeded to follow Percival's lead, advancing towards their base of operations. Percival made it clear that the Imperium Teen Resistance Force had witnessed the ninja freeing the dragons, which directly contradicted Beatrix's denial of the event. Percival also revealed that there were other Imperians who opposed Beatrix and faced consequences for their actions, resulting in their expulsion from the kingdom or imprisonment. Additionally, they possessed evidence of Beatrix admitting to her deceitful behavior. Percival disclosed that they had an insider who could provide them with access to the broadcast tower, allowing them to hack into the encryption and broadcast their message on every screen in the kingdom. Sora agreed to join their cause and assist with hacking through the encryption. One of the teens informed them that the lab was under lockdown because of the explosion. Kai suggested that to carry out their plan, they would need to create a diversion to divert the attention of the Imperium Guards, which would involve him and Wyldfyre cause a massive explosion by destroying the Armory.

Wyldfyre and Kai stood outside a building. Wyldfyre remarked that according to the map, the building across them was the Imperium Armory. Kai and Wyldfyre used their Elemental Powers to destroy the building, anticipating an explosion. However, to their surprise, there was no explosion. Kai shared Wyldfyre's sentiment about the lack of a dramatic explosion, doubtful about whether this was truly the Armory. Wyldfyre pointed to the map as evidence of their correct location. However, Kai took the map from her hands and discovered that it was upside-down. Despite the confusion, Kai reassured Wyldfyre that the building they had unintentionally targeted still held great importance. However, their conversation was abruptly interrupted by the arrival of an Imperium Guard, who lamented the destruction of the shoulder pad storage. Realizing their mistake, they quickly decided to leave the area. Kai and Wyldfyre continued their relentless search for the Armory. Suddenly, their attention was diverted as they noticed Beatrix's lies were exposed, and Sora, with her speech, had managed to captivate the attention of the Imperians. Soon, Kai and Wyldfyre finally reached the Armory. As they destroyed the Armory, Kai and Wyldfyre walked away from the exploding building. Kai couldn't help but be awed at the Armory's destruction, acknowledging that it lived up to its name.

The Power Within[]

Kai reunited with the rest of the ninja and pointed out that Beatrix had completely lost control. Concerned about their next move, he asks the team for their plan of action. Lloyd, filled with confidence, reminded Kai and the others that they would confront Beatrix head-on. Without wasting any time, the ninja swiftly engage in combat with Beatrix, utilizing their unique Elemental Powers. In an attempt to subdue Beatrix, Wyldfyre unleashes a blast of Heat. However, to the ninja's surprise, Wyldfyre gets sucked into a MergeQuake. Witnessing Wyldfyre's presumed demise, Kai's anger takes over and he launches an attack on Beatrix, only to find himself being pulled into another MergeQuake. Following the conclusion of the MergeQuake storm, Kai and everyone who were engulfed by it emerged unscathed, with Kai landing directly on top of Lloyd. Anticipating a warm embrace from Nya, Kai was taken by surprise when Wyldfyre enthusiastically tackled him into a tight hug.

Kai and Wyldfyre engaged in a fiery display of their powers, with Kai shooting fire at some cans. Kai acknowledged Wyldfyre's impressive display but shifted the conversation to the topic of precision. Wyldfyre, not fully understanding the concept, humorously suggested that precision means she was already perfect and has nothing left to learn. Kai clarified that precision referred to improving and becoming even more awesome with time and practice. He then noticed a difference between their powers - the cans he hit burned to ash, while Wyldfyre's cans melted, showing that they have different Elemental Powers. Arin decided to commemorate the victory by baking Snowberry Pies. Kai decided to sample one of the pies, only to accidentally drop it.

The Elemental Mechs

The Elemental Mechs[]

What the Mech?[]

Taking advantage of Lloyd's absence, Kai saw an opportunity to set up Kai's Super Awesome Slide Course. He was able to convince Arin and Sora to join him by claiming that sliding down the course using Wu's meditation carpet would provide a meditative experience. Although Arin and Sora had their reservations, they decided to give it a try. However, their exhilarating slide came to an abrupt halt when they accidentally crashed into Cole. Cole then revealed that dangerous items, including Chronosteel, had been shipped to Ninjago. This piqued the curiosity of Arin and Sora, prompting Kai to explain the significance of Chronosteel. He elaborated on how Chronosteel was used to forge the Time Blades. Concerned about the potential dangers posed by these items, Kai and the others felt compelled to take action. They decided to pay a visit to Kreel's Junkyard, as Kreel had been advertising these hazardous items for days.

Upon their arrival, Lobbo inadvertently absorbed a surge of energy from one of the items, resulting in a transformation that fueled his anger and led him to attack Kai and the ninja. Despite their efforts to stop Lobbo, Kai and the ninja found themselves overpowered. Sora swiftly constructed three mechs, assigning one of them to Kai. Initially unimpressed by the appearance of his assigned mech, Kai dismissed it as a mere frisbee. However, his skepticism quickly turned to awe as he activated the mech and witnessed its remarkable capabilities. Lobbo was held back by Kai and Cole, while Sora extracted the perilous energy from Lobbo, restoring him to his normal state. With caution, the ninja confiscated all the hazardous objects from Kreel. Kai proposed an idea to use these items to enhance his slide course, which earned disapproving looks from the rest of the ninja. In an attempt to diffuse the tension, Kai confessed that he was only joking, albeit partially.

The Mech Master[]

The ninja walked towards the Mech-Master 5000's stands, with Kai and Cole eagerly devouring one of Chef Grab-Barg's Creme de Imperium pies along the way. Just as the race was about to start, Kai gasped upon the sight of the ninja's old enemy, the Mechanic, leaping down and hijacking the lineup of race mechs.
