Using their new elemental mechs, Kai, Sora, and Cole confronted the Mechanic but immediately found their own mechs smashed apart by the commandeered racers. With Sora being sent to catch the Mechanic on her own, Kai and Cole hastily reattached the limbs of their mechs but each swapped for one mech arm for the other's in their rush. Nevertheless, both were able to destroy the hijacked racers and remarked on how cool it was to use the other's powers. Kai and Cole then backed up Sora in arresting the Mechanic before enjoying some more of Grab-Barg's pies.

A Pain in the Mech![]

Kai, Cole, Arin, Sora, and Riyu gathered at the Crossroads to witness the noodle cook-off. As they arrived, Kai conversed with Grab-Barg and was given a bowl of noodles. As the Ice Dragons launched an attack, the Lava-Tide chef sought his sous-chefs to defend his honor. Mistakenly assuming the chef was addressing him, Kai clarified their intention to protect everyone before being interrupted by the chef. While the ninja engaged in battle with the Ice Dragons, Kai swiftly finished his noodles and joined the fight. The ninja used their mechs to combat the Ice Dragons, but the Lava-Tides obstructed their efforts by attacking the ninja as well. To disrupt the Lava-Tides, Kai borrowed an arm from the Elemental Earth Mech, throwing them off balance. Subsequently, Kai exchanged his mech's arms with Sora's mech's arms, employing an arm from the Elemental Tech Mech. With it, Kai successfully restrained the second Ice Dragon using Technology. With both dragons tied up, Kai voiced his criticism towards Lloyd's doubts regarding the ninja's teamwork.

Following the exposure of the Lava-Tide chef's theft of the Ice Dragons' eggs, Riyu pushed him agaisnt his oven, causing his noodles to scatter in all directions. Kai and the others then promptly returned the eggs to the Ice Dragons and made their way back to the Monastery of Spinjitzu. Lloyd eagerly awaited an explanation, but Kai responded by acknowledging that there was indeed an explanation, albeit a peculiar one. Once they finished clarifying matters, Lloyd reminded Kai about the task of bringing him lunch. In return, Kai handed over the noodles that were tangled in his hair.

Dragons Rising, Season 2

Dragons Rising, Season 2[]

The Blood Moon[]

Kai and Zane played Lava Zombies in the Monastery, though the latter had a difficult time understanding Kai's expression of "Eat that, Nindroid!" When Lloyd sleep-walked into the room, Kai snapped him awake by pointing out that Lloyd was pouring tea into a potted plant, sarcastically asking if he discovered a new way to drink tea. Kai then recommended for Lloyd to get some rest, wincing when Lloyd collapsed seconds later from exhaustion.

Shattered Dreams[]

Kai and the other ninja gathered together in the Monastery's courtyard and listened as Lloyd spoke about his visions and their encounter the night before with the Wolf Clan. Kai dismissed the threat posed by Cinder, recounting his victory over Ash years prior, and haughtily remarked that if there was a Master of Smoke, there would a Master of Fire to defeat them.

Kai would later join the others in an assault on Cloud Kingdom after they were informed by Euphrasia that Ras and the Wolf Clan had conquered the Kingdom. Shortly after infiltrating the empty grounds, Kai wandered off a bit on his own and knocked out a Wolf Mask Warrior before freeing Suetonius from one of the Scroll-Worm cocoons. When the ninja's presence were detected, an all out battle broke out between them and the Wolf Clan. Kai challenged Cinder to combat and boasted about his victory against Cinder's predecessor before thrashing the new Master of Smoke in a single stroke. Unfortunately, Kai's victory would be short-lived, for Cinder soon unlocked the power of Shatterspin through the Gong of Shattering, allowing him to defeat all the ninja with little effort. In spite of a belief that Cinder could not possibly defeat all of them at once, Kai relented when Wyldfyre was severely injured by the new Master of Smoke and retreated alongside the other ninja.

Beyond the Phantasm Cave[]

Following their defeat at Cloud Kingdom, Kai and Nya retreated to the Monastery's hanger bay. Still frustrated by their defeat, Kai suited up in his Elemental Fire Mech and began smashing the many crates in the hanger, earning him a scolding from Nya. Kai ignored her words and continued to destroy the crates while expressing his doubts that their mechs could stand a chance against Cinder and his Shatterspin. Later that night, after being briefed about an upcoming mission, Kai made his way down to the Dragon Stables to see Wyldfyre. Taking note of his student's injury, Kai urged her to stay behind to recuperate, insisting that they were about to embark on the "boringest" mission ever.

The next day, following Lloyd's visions, Kai and the rest of the ninja began to prepare the Bounty to search for the Training plateau of the Dragon Masters, believing that there they could find a teacher from whom the ninja could learn to defeat Shatterspin. After collapsing his mech, Kai asked Mr. Frohicky to keep a close eye on Wyldfyre for him. Hours later, the ninja had set sail to parts unknown. As they waited, Kai watched Arin's attempts at practicing Object Spinjitzu and walked over with the others with rumbling was heard from the engine compartment. When it was discovered that Wyldfyre had stowed away by hiding in the engine compartment, Kai let out an exasperated groan. He then demanded for the ship to be turned back so they could bring Wyldfyre back to the Monastery, but Nya pointed out it was too late, for they had already arrived at the Phantasm Cave. The ninja then flew deeper into the cave, pausing when Lloyd pointed towards a tunnel of light radiating out from above. In spite of Nya correctly pointing out they could not advance any further in the Bounty, as the upwards gap was too narrow for the ship to fly through, Kai at first suggested flying through anyway. At least, he did, until Arin pointed to all the wrecked ships at the bottom of the cave, warning that the captains of those ships had probably thought the same way prior to their demise. Sora then bestowed each of the ninja with their own Dragon Hook for climbing. Although Kai was impressed by the design of the tool, he noted they still had two problems: a dragon who couldn't fly and a stowaway who had come along despite being explicitly told that her leg needed to heal. Sora responded by combining Kai's hook with several other components to create a new Climber Mech for him.

The ninja now began to ascend the walls, with Kai using his mech to carry both Riyu and Wyldfyre. Moments later, they faced their first challenge, for the tunnels lining the cave were inhabited by some tentacled creature. After climbing out of the tentacle cave, the ninja proceed down another cave where their vision suddenly faded away to black, separating each of them from each other. Unbeknownst to any of them, they had fallen victim to the nightmare inducing powers of a Dream-Guyver. Fortunately, Nya had managed to escape from her trance and blasted the creature away, releasing the others in the process. As some of the ninja discussed what they had seen, Kai remained silent and unusually despondent, thinking deeply on what he had seen even as they left the cave and faced what appeared to be the edge of a cliff.

With deep mist obscuring the landscape beyond, Lloyd hesitated as to their next steps. Nya though suggested a leap of faith, prompting Kai to do just that. He then landed safely at the Training plateau of the Dragon Masters and called for the others to join him.

Force From the East[]

Facing a large dragon, Kai and the other ninja were knocked off their feet by his mighty roar. Realizing that the dragon sure wasn't friendly, Kai immediately attacked with fireballs, though they dissipated harmlessly against the dragon's wings. Kai was then knocked to the ground but was helped up by Nya and both siblings resumed their attack, using their powers in tandem. As they fought, Kai tripped over a large stone ball and grumbled that the landscaping choices here were not "battle friendly." Lloyd then realized that the stones' purpose were to pull down a bucket-pulley system for the gates and called on the ninja to divide their focuses on distracting the dragon while others attempted to launch stones into the bucket.

Kai focused on distracting the dragon with Spinjitzu and fireballs, keeping its focus away on the other ninja. He did however toss the fourth ball into the bucket, followed by Nya who scored the fifth and final one to open the gates. Victorious, the ninja approached the open gates only to be confronted by a second, purple dragon who roared in their faces. Hesitantly, Kai expressed belief that even though they were now facing two dragons instead of one, surely they could take them both! To everyone's surprise, the dragons began bowing before the ninja instead of attacking, prompting Kai to ask Wyldfyre if this behavior was normal. The dragons then revealed themselves as Egalt and Rontu, the Dragon Masters, and the legendary teachers that Lloyd had sought.

In the ensuing conversation, the ninja explained to the dragons the return of Shatterspin and learned from them about the threat posed by the Forbidden Five. Kai contributed a few remarks in the conversation and briefly asked Wyldfyre what Rontu and Egalt were saying when the two dragons argued amongst themselves. In the end, the Dragon Masters agreed to teach the ninja the art of Rising Dragon - a fighting technique they had created to counter the Shatterspin of the Forbidden Five over a millennia ago.

The Spell at the Waterfall[]

Kai and Sora engaged in a sparring session with their elemental mechs to serve as a demonstration of the ninja's fighting capabilities. During the session, Sora sliced off one of the Fire Mech's arms and knocked Kai to the ground. Surprised, Kai complimented Sora on her prowess, though Sora believed her abilities were limited only to the mechs due to her status as their designer. Upon the completion of the session, Lloyd, Arin, Nya, and Kai were granted the rank of "Second Fang" ninja and were consigned to Egalt to learn Rising Dragon. For their first session, the four practiced a series of exercises in unison while Egalt explained the underlying philosophy of Rising Dragon to them. As part of the lesson, the ninja were instructed to be as motionless as possible and Egalt then asked Kai if they were completely motionless. Kai answered that they were but Egalt revealed that they were wrong, for the entire universe was constantly and motion and thus their bodies too were in motion with it. At the lesson's end, Kai asked why knowing about motion was so important, eliciting a more plain answer from Egalt.

The four Second Fang ninjas were then instructed to perform Spinjitzu across a series of ramps to heighten their awareness of both their own motion and the motion of those in the environment around them. During this session, Kai and Nya high-fived in mid air after leaping from a ramp. On their next rotation, however, the siblings bumped into one another leading to a brief verbal dispute that drew Egalt's ire. Later in the session, Arin lost control over his wonky Spinjitzu and crashed into the other three ninja, running into Nya first who then fell onto Kai, and ripping them all out of focus. He and Nya then stood quietly as Egalt harshly scolded Arin for the accident, exchanging concerned glances when Arin glumly walked away from the others.

To Mysterium[]

In the early morning, Kai and other second fang ninja swung through the trees surrounding the plateau as part of another exercise in building awareness of the motion outside of one's self. Later, he and Nya were called on by Egalt for the next exercise. The siblings were instructed to throw stones into the opposing hoop and to score more points than the other. Both siblings took the challenge too seriously and as their determination to win wore down their patience, they began fighting each other more than trying to complete the challenge. Frustrated, Egalt called for a break.

Sometime afterwards, both siblings observed Lloyd and Arin's turn on the same exercise. During this session, they were forced to duck for cover when Arin's smashed into the pile of stones with his wonky Spinjitzu, accidentally hurling the stones in all directions with great force. When Egalt was struck to the ground by one such stone, Kai and Nya rushed to his side.

Fugitives From Madness[]

Kai and the other ninja rushed to Lloyd's side after hearing him crying out from another bout of visions. The ninja were all soon rushed to continue their training, for the Blood Moon was drawing ever closer. By sunset, Kai attempted his final drill but grew increasingly impatient and frustrated with his lack of success. Egalt's sharp comments only further fueled Kai's anger but Nya managed to calm him down by proposing to run the drill alongside him. She then urged Kai to remember the game of Counter Shot they used to play as kids and to apply it to the drill.

Drawing on his childhood memories and with his sister's presence, Kai was able to speed through the challenge and successfully performed Rising Dragon technique, becoming the first human in a long time to perform the art. Egalt then congratulated the ninja on their success just as the Blood Moon rose in the sky, petrifying him and Rontu and leaving the ninja on their own to stop Ras' ritual.

Secrets of the Wyldness[]

All the ninja reacted to the Dragon Masters' petrified states with shock, but Wyldfyre took it the hardest to the point she flat out refused to accept it as reality. Kai was concerned over his student but was just as equally lost for words. When Wyldfyre desperately asked him and Lloyd if the effects would wear off eventually, Kai could only mutter that he didn't know. Arin then turned to Kai and began suggesting that since Kai had already mastered Rising Dragon, though the latter cut him off before he could finish the sentence, stammering that he only performed the technique once and in fact had no idea how to replicate it. With the ninja unable to take any further action, they departed the plateau in search of Ras and the Wolf Clan.

As the ninja sailed through the skies atop the Bounty, they suddenly encountered a wild storm that Lloyd quickly realized was unnatural. While most of the ninja were thrown overboard in the ensuing turbulence, Wyldfyre, Sora, and Kai managed to stay onboard but found themselves facing a much worse fate: being precariously perched atop a deep chasm. The three's only hope for survival lay in the climber mech, but it was on the other side of the Bounty and even the slightest bit of movement would tip the ship over to its doom. Following Sora's plan, Sora and Wyldfyre jumped at the same time to tip the Bounty towards its stern to buy Kai enough time to reach the mech. Unfortunately, the mech tipped over in the process and its weight caused the Bounty to fall off its perch facing the bow. Although he was just as freaked out as the younger ninja at first, Kai regained his composure and dove into the mech's cockpit just in time to catch Sora and Wyldfyre. The three then began to make their ascent out from the ravine.

The Forest of Spirits[]

Kai continued to operate the climber mech in ascending the cliff face, briefly pausing to ask how the younger ninja were holdng up. Seconds later, the Climber Mech lost involuntarily shifted after a part of the rockface collapsed, sending Wyldfyre plunging back down the chasm. Thinking quickly, Kai managed to catch her with one of the mech's hooks, nervously commenting "whoops," much to Wyldfyre's unamusement. When they finally reached the top of the cliff, Wyldfyre dove to the ground and began hugging and kissing it, eliciting a groan from Kai who defended the climb as not being as bad as Wyldfyre made it out to be. Mere seconds later, the three were surrounded by Wolf Mask Warriors.

As the warriors approached, Sora suggested that they all could avoid fighting but Wyldfyre refused and initiated the battle with a huge fireball. As they fought, Kai used the climber mech's grappling hooks to strike several warriors though began struggling when three evaded his attacks and began climbing on the mech. Kai was able to defeat two of them, but the third required assistance from Wyldfyre to defeat. The three then stole the uniforms of some of the unconscious warriors and prepared to follow another group of warriors to wherever Ras was hiding. After suiting up, Sora and Kai took issue with Wyldfyre's crutch, fearing it would give them away. Wyldfyre reluctantly tossed away her crutch and discovered that her leg had fully healed, proclaiming happily that Rontu was right about needing rest. Kai took issue with this comment and protested that he was the one who suggested this first, an argument Wyldfyre did not deny but added that it only made sense to her when a dragon suggested it.

Upon arriving at the Shadow Dojo, the three stood beside each other in the back row yet could hear the ongoing conversation between Ras and Cinder. Realizing that they could stop the Ritual of the Blood Moon by freeing the intended sacrifices, the three began to approach the platform with another group of warriors.

Rising Ninja[]

Kai approached Suetonius from behind, identified himself, and urged the Master Writer to remain calm while he melted the prisoners' shackles. Unfortunately, the ringing of the Gong of Shattering activated all Wolf Masks in the area, including the ones worn by Kai, Sora, and Wyldfyre. Affected by the magic of the masks, the three began stumbling away as they struggled to remove them. Wyldfyre finally removed her's by melting it off with her fire power and urged the other two to hold still while she removed theirs' as well. Kai was hesitant but didn't have much time to argue, for Wyldfyre already hurled a fireball at his face before he could say anything. Although he was relieved at first, Kai quickly became alarmed when he realized he smelled burnt hair - Wyldfyre had accidentally ignited Kai's hair in the process! Cinder then spotted the three and called out to his allies, starting an all-out battle at the Shadow Dojo.

Wyldfyre first urged Kai to begin using Rising Dragon though Kai pointed out he had only used the technique once, and by complete accident at that. With no time to waste, he and Sora activated their elemental mechs and began fighting the hordes of Wolf Mask Warriors. As the battle progressed, Kai expressed frustration with the Wolf Mask Warriors' onslaught, wondering aloud if they even were capable of feeling pain. In spite of his best efforts, Kai was overwhelmed by the warriors who managed to slash the chest of his elemental mech, destroying it and knocking Kai out momentarily. Wyldfyre rushed to his side and declared that if this was going to be their final moment, they would go down fighting. Fortunately, Nya, Lloyd, Riyu, and Arin arrived at the Dojo grounds just in time and joined the battle, allowing Kai enough time to recover with a groan.

After recovering, Kai watched as Cinder unleashed his Shatterspin. When the Master of Smoke prepared to make a move against Nya, Kai unleashed Rising Dragon to halt the evil warrior's attack, dragging him into the air and throwing him to the ground before dive bombing. Kai continued to thrash Cinder up until Ras struck him with his hammer and knocking Kai into the portal to the Nether-Space. Although Riyu attempted to save Kai, it was too late and Kai was transported away, allowing for Nokt to escape in his place.

Trapped within the confines of Nether-Space, Kai was awoken by Bonzle, who identified herself as the spell being used by Jordana to maintain the portal. She tasked Kai to find a way out before she closed the portal, but Kai instead urged her not to worry about him and to instead close the portal the first chance she had, whether or not he was able to escape. By the time the portal was closed, Kai failed to escape from the Nether-Space and was greeted by Bonzle who had now regained her physical form. Bonzle apologized for Kai's predicament and glumly informed him that unless there was another Blood Moon, it would be impossible for them to escape now. In response, Kai cheered Bonzle up, stating that she made the right decision in sealing away the other members of the Forbidden Five and that there would be always hope for them to eventually escape; after all, ninja never quit.

Enter the City of Temples[]

Kai found it frustrating to maintain his composure in the environment of the Nether-Space. Bonzle insisted that Kai keep his voice down, warning him that the Forbidden Five would track them down and eliminate both of them for the fun of it if they realized they were trapped in the same space. Just moments later, they spotted three members of the Forbidden Five nearby, sending them into a state of panic as they tried to avoid being seen. Thinking they had escaped detection, Kai proposed taking a different route. However, their plan was nearly derailed when they accidentally stumbled upon a pit, causing rocks to crash down and create a loud commotion. In a swift motion, Kai grabbed Bonzle to prevent her from falling into the pit. Bonzle believed their noise had gone unnoticed, but Kai quickly disabused her of that notion when they saw the Forbidden Five approaching. With a sense of urgency, Bonzle urged Kai to run as the three figures drew closer.

Inside the Maze[]

As they wandered through the Nether-Space, Kai and Bonzle noticed the Forbidden Five speaking with someone. It was at that moment they saw Rox among them. Kai pointed out to Bonzle that Rox was the only member of the Forbidden Five they had yet to encounter. Their curiosity piqued when they overheard the Forbidden Five discussing plans to secure their release, which captivated Kai's interest. Once the Forbidden Five left, Kai and Bonzle approached Rox, who lay in a state resembling a coma. Kai confirmed that Rox was alive, though unresponsive. In Kai's attempt to rouse Rox, Bonzle noticed something glowing on Kai's arm. Upon inspection, Kai discovered it was scales from Riyu, remnants that had fallen onto him during the Ritual of the Blood Moon. This discovery prompted Bonzle to realize that these scales established a psychic link between Kai and Riyu, hinting at the possibility of communication between them. Encouraged by this insight, Kai decided to reach out to Riyu. Riyu heard Kai in his head.

United We Fall[]

Kai told Riyu he had to tell the latter something. Later, he begged Riyu for his help. Once Riyu broke into Wolf Clan’s quarters with Arin's help, Kai asked Riyu if he could hear him. When Riyu found the Dragon Ivory stone, Kai remarked that it was as if Riyu was right next to him. Riyu handed Arin the stone and Kai told Riyu he could only hear him. While Ras talked to Arin, Kai asked Riyu what was going on, but the latter put the stone in his mouth.

Truth and Lies[]

While Arin talked to Riyu about what Ras had told him earlier, Kai asked Riyu for help, prompting the latter to run off.

The Sword Shatters[]

Kai and Bonzle persisted in their observation of the Forbidden Five, who were arguing. Bonzle pressed Kai for further information, a line of questioning that frustrated Kai, as he was equally in the dark until they finally witnessed the Forbidden Five leaving. Once the group had left, Kai resumed his conversation with Riyu. At this juncture, Nya, who had received a measure of dragon power from Riyu, successfully initiated communication with Kai by tapping into the Dragon Ivory stone, a connection facilitated by their sibling bond. Kai cautioned Nya about the Forbidden Five's intentions to escape from the Nether-Space, to which Nya responded that Jay had lost his memories and was now behaving like an entirely different person. Kai humorously remarked that this might actually be a positive development for Jay. Suddenly, the call was unexpectedly severed, leaving both Kai and Bonzle in a state of confusion.

The Final Game[]

Kai and Bonzle tried to sneak around the remaining Forbidden Five. Kai accidentally kicked a rock but the two managed to stay out of sight.

Elements of Betrayal[]

Riyu sparked Nya with dragon power and she blasted the Crowns of Horns, releasing Kai and Bonzle from Nether-Space. Kai took on Nokt while both used Rising Dragon and Shatterspin respectively. Nokt almost finished Kai off when Roby used the Elemental Cup to take the Elemental Powers from Nokt. After the fight, Cole, Zane, Wyldfyre and Riyu ran to give Kai a hug. Later. Roby honored the ninja, including Kai, at the Games Plaza. At the Monastery, Nya told Kai about Jay and he said they should go and find him.

Dragons Rising, Season 3

Dragons Rising, Season 3[]

The Missing[]

Kai, Nya, and Wyldfyre began their search for Jay. The trio acted on a report from the Explorer's Club regarding a potential sighting of someone using lightning powers and made their way to the Forest of Spirits to investigate. As they walked, Kai began to absentmindedly make noises with his mouth, greatly annoying his sister who asked him to stop. Kai denied having knowledge of what Nya was asking him to stop doing, then resumed his absentminded popping noises. When Nya pointed out what exactly was annoying her, Kai realized what he was doing and chuckled, remarking that it probably was quite annoying indeed. He then reassured his sister that Jay was certainly here before continuing with the noises, angering Nya into nearly coming to blows. Wyldfyre though managed to break up the tension by pointing out a flash of lightning in the sky. While Nya was eager to rush on ahead, Kai stopped her and reminded her that Jay had shattered his goodness and was more likely to fight them than talk to them. He then ordered Wyldfyre to flank from behind and provide backup while he and Nya investigated closer first. To their surprise, the siblings did not find Jay but instead interrupted the Lightning-Tide Community Ceremony and were imprisoned for their mistake.

As Klirba, the Leader of the Lightning-Tides held the siblings at trial, Nya attempted to explain their situation but Kai mistook it as a distraction. He then burst out of their cage with fire and immediately attacked Klirba, damaging the judge's bench. The other Lightning Tides however subdued Kai by pelting him with vengestone and relocked him in the cage. Kai then demanded to know where the Tide-Folk obtained the vengestone, though it turned out they did not know what exactly the stone was nor its properties; they just liked the fact it glowed and they enjoyed pelting Kai with them. At that moment, Wyldfyre appeared, badly disguised as Lava-Tide, eliciting groans from Kai and Nya; her disguise failed to fool Klirba and soon she too was imprisoned alongside the siblings.

As Klirba, the prosecutor, and the defense argued over the ninja's punishment, Nya once again spoke up to present her case, explaining how they had been looking for Jay and mistook the Lightning-Tides for him, that they meant no harm and things had just been an accident. Klirba then ordered for Nya to be released but refused to release Kai or Wyldfyre. Chuckling nervously, Kai stated in defiance that there was no way Nya would abandon them, growing slightly worried when she began walking away. Nya then released Kai and Wyldfyre from the cage and the three escaped from the Lightning-Tide village.

The Ultimate Object of Admiration[]

Kai, Nya, and Wyldfyre set up camp in the Lava Wastes for the night. Wyldfyre then began to complain that she was bored and Kai suggested blowing up some rocks with fireballs - a suggestion the former gladly accepted. As they began playing, a Messenger Dragon arrived to hand a message to Wyldfyre from Roby. She then drew a picture of herself, which Kai scribbled in his own self portrait into before they gave it back to the dragon to deliver. Nya at this point snapped at the two for seemingly not caring enough about finding Jay, to which Kai apologized and admitted that he had no idea what to do, and in situations like these, he just blew up rocks with fireballs. Nya accepted her brother's apology and while she acknowledged that their task was difficult, unless the three focused on it, Jay might be lost forever.

The Spectral Lands[]

At the Crossroads, Kai approached a Merlopian to inquire about Jay, highlighting his lightning abilities and sense of humor. The Merlopian dismissed the inquiry, claiming that he only had merely been zapped by an electric eel, which left Kai feeling confused and speechless as he walked away. His attention was soon captured by a sign announcing the grand opening of Lobbo's Totally Rad Arcade, Lobbo-Lobbo. Excitedly, Kai suggested that they should draw Jay to them, pointing out that the arcade featured Galamorph X-Post, a game Jay cherished and excelled at. Kai had been honing his skills on an emulator, convinced that he was finally ready to surpass Jay's high score. Nya, however, expressed doubt, reminding Kai that Jay had lost his memories and might not even recognize the game. Despite this, Kai held onto the belief that even if Jay's memories were lost or his goodness shattered, achieving a new high score would instinctively lure him back to reclaim his title. Meanwhile, Wyldfyre, who was not particularly impressed by video games, questioned their allure, noting that her experiences with games had been more about learning than fun. Kai, however, reassured her that today would hold special significance for her.

Entering Lobbo's Totally Rad Arcade, Kai and the others were immediately greeted by its namesake proprietor who briefly showed them around the venue's many offerings. Kai then explained that they had come for a Galamorph X-Post cabinet, which Lobbo directed him to. Kai then began caressing the machine, much to Nya's disgust. In response, Kai whispered back to the machine to ignore his sister. Kai then began to play the game for hours, growing increasingly frustrated and more determined with each failure. Finally, by the time the arcade closed for the day, Kai beat the game and became the newest highest scoring player! Laughing, Kai exclaimed it was time for Jay to show himself to retake his place. Nya however, remained skeptical of Kai's plan and dismissively suggested that there was no way Jay was going to immediately be teleported to the arcade, halting mid sentence as the arcade doors swung open. To everyone's disappoint however, it was just Fugi-Dove, not Jay.

After waiting a bit longer, Nya decided it was time to give up, and Kai agreed with a resigned sigh. As they prepared to go, however, the Galamorph cabinet suddenly reactivated and began playing itself! Kai realized that someone must have activated and was playing remotely, but with a game this old, it shouldn't be possible. A quick examination of the player's gaming style also clued into Kai who their identity was. Wyldfyre however had no idea who Kai was referring to and asked him to finish his thought, ruining his smile. As the three continued to watch, Kai realized with horror that the high score he had literally spent the entire day working to achieve was soon about to be broken. To his dismay, the remote player broke Kai's score and inputted their name: "Jay." Nya gasped that it really was Jay and gave her brother a hug.

I Alone Can Save Them[]

At the arcade, Nya pried open a panel on the Galamorph cabinet to inspect it. As she looked, Kai asked her to check for cheat-ware, still fuming about Jay beating the highscore he had taken all day to achieve. Nya ignored him and instead mused that if they could figure out how Jay was able to remotely access the cabinet, they could find his exact location. Kai then chimed in to add that once they found him, they would force him to admit that he cheated!

Wyldfyre soon received another scroll from Roby, which Kai referred to as a "love scroll." When Wyldfyre reacted with shock to its contents however, Kai immediately believed that Roby was breaking up with her and vowed to kick his butt in retaliation. Wyldfyre then showed him and Nya the scroll, exclaiming that it actually stated that Roby was in the hospital.

Returning to the Monastery of Spinjitzu, the three entered the dragon stables to utilize the portal gate. Mr. Frohicky explained to them that to activate it, they would have to state their intended destination. After Wyldfyre failed twice to activate the gate, Kai and Nya simultaneously called for the City of Temples, activating the portal gate. They soon made their way to its hospital where they discovered Roby sitting weakly in a bed. Kai helped him lift a large book that was sitting in his lap, though Roby admitted he was too weak to read it. With another cough, Roby pleaded for the ninja to stop the Forbidden Five.

Fallen Wishes[]

Kai and Nya examined The Sagas of the Eternal Sources inside the City of Temples, though Kai primarily complained that they should be focusing their efforts more on finding the Forbidden Five. When he was unable to provide an answer to his sister's questions about where they Five could be or what they were up to, Nya pointed out that this was exactly why they needed to do research first. She then imitated Kai's voice and stated, "You're so right, Nya! As usual!" though Kai denied he would ever say those words.

Nya then began to flip through the pages of the book, immediately discovering the pages about Prismatic Steel and Thunderfang. As she read them aloud, Kai offered some unhelpful commentary to what he was hearing, walking away even when Nya began to talk about the Prismatic Blades. When she began to suggest an idea on finding the remaining blades but cut off mid-sentence, Kai swiveled around only to discover his sister was no longer there.

Sometime later, Nya reappeared and landed atop of Kai, knocking him to the ground. After asking where his sister had gone, Kai asked if she had disappeared just to prank-attack him, and if so, she had done a great job and he wished he thought of it first. Nya then explained to him her encounter with Rox in Djinjago and that she now knew that the Forbidden Five were searching for the blades to release Thunderfang. After digesting this information, Kai informed his sister that their search for Jay would have to be put on hold; stopping the Five from releasing the evil dragon was a far more pressing matter.

Their Draconic Majesty's Request[]

Kai and Nya waited by the portal gate in the Monastery of Spinjitzu for their allies to return. When they arrived, Kai was surprised by Zane's new, larger body and stammered out a comment about it. Zane replied that he "got swole for buffness," eliciting a confused laugh out of Kai. As the ninja discussed how the Forbidden Five required all five prismatic blades to release Thunderfang, Kai proposed destroying the one in their possession, granting himself the title of "the solver," in the process. When Lloyd failed to destroy the blade, Kai took it from him and attempted to melt it with his fire, but also to no avail. The others then suggested using the blade to locate the fifth one, but Kai wondered aloud how they could do so without Dragonians, prompting Nya to sarcastically comment that the solver could not solve this problem; Kai sheepishly admitted that he deserved this remark.

Later, Zane and P.I.X.A.L. constructed and affixed a tracker to the blue prismatic blade and located the fifth blade in the World Forest. Kai then accompanied his allies to the forest, landing before Arin and Ras.

Crashing Together[]

As the ninja faced Arin and Ras, Kai remained fairly opposed towards both of them, clearly not over Ras' attempt at sacrificing him during the Ritual of the Blood Moon. While Sora and Lloyd tried to urge Arin into rejoining, Kai only spoke up to attack Ras' character. Nevertheless, he was ready to help his allies in going after Arin when he took off to rescue Ras from Rogue, only halting when the clouds above darkened to herald the arrival of Drix and his forces. Preparing for battle, Kai sarcastically grumbled about the World Forest being the newest hotspot in the Merged Lands before boasting to Drix that he would regret sending his entire army away.

When Drix landed, Kai attacked first and engaged him in hand-to-hand combat. Drix slowly gained the upper hand, however, and hurled Kai away like a rag doll. After recovering, Kai hurled a fireball at Drix's chest, burning straight through him. To Kai's horror however, Drix was able to regenerate the damage inflicted upon his body, for he was comprised entirely out of millions of insects! Unfazed by Kai's attack, Drix retaliated by unleashing a swarm of insects to harass Kai and Nya, only recalling them once he had recovered the Blue Prismatic Blade. Drix then released a wave of Shatterspin that knocked down Kai and the others with him, but they all managed to cling onto some lower branches to avoid falling off the tree entirely.

Chaos Unchained[]

Kai and the other ninja listened solemnly as Arin explained to them about the fate of his parents. Although Arin expressed that he still blamed Master Wu for causing the Merge, he nevertheless wanted to ally with the ninja in stopping the Forbidden Five from releasing Thunderfang. Kai was quick to welcome Arin back with them, placing a comforting hand on the teen's back as he affirmed that Arin was one of them. As the discussion shifted to Drix, Kai moaned that he hated Drix and how his fight against him was the second worst time he's fought with insects, the first being a picnic with Jay. This comment agitated Nya who immediately pointed out that it was her picnic with Jay and that she had told Kai not to follow them. The siblings briefly squabbled over this until Lloyd interrupted by remarking that their bickering had given him an idea.

Upon returning to the Monastery of Spinjitzu, Kai and Frak immediately slipped on the freshly polished floors of the hangar bay. Mr. Frohicky helped Kai to his feet and cracked a lame pun about the polished floors, much to Kai's annoyance. He and most of the other ninja then prepared themselves for the battle to come and regrouped in the dragon stables, where they used the portal gate to enter the First Land. Emerging from the Monastery of the First Land, Kai let out a delighted shout and thanked Sora for his new glider, describing it as being "awesome." Upon arriving at Storm Mountain. the ninja observed the raging Winds of Chaos and Kai got some sand in his mouth, causing him to spit in disgust. Having arrived before Drix and his forces, the ninja formulated a plan of action to ambush the Master of Swarm.

Drix arrived shortly thereafter and reacted with surprise to the presence of the ninja. Undeterred however, he ordered his Dragonians to attack. Kai joined in the battle against Drix's Dragonians, blasting one off Arin's Dragon-headed drone with a fireball before striking several more with Dragon Spinjitzu. Surprised by the energy dragons swirling around his Spinjitzu, Kai asked if anyone else saw them as well, noting that his Spinjitzu was more awesome than usual; Lloyd answered him by stating it was just a First Realm thing. Shortly thereafter, the rest of the Forbidden Five and their forces arrived to back up Drix. In the ensuing fight, Kai held back the Dragonians and grappled with Zarkt, eventually being thrown across the valley by him when the Five recovered both of the remaining prismatic blades. Lloyd called the ninja to pursue the Five, but they quickly lost control within the powerful storm of chaos. As they were jostled around the winds like ragdolls, Kai crashed into Nya and destroyed her glider, with his own being destroyed shortly thereafter when Frak crashed into him. With their remaining method of maneuvering in the storm lost, it was up to Zane to save them now.

The Shatter Dragon[]

After some continued flailing within the Winds of Chaos, Kai was ultimately rescued by Zane and the ninja were able to escape with some additional assistance from Wyldfyre. Kai then approached her and asked if he could try out her super cool new vehicle, but Wyldfyre playfully replied that it would not look as cool with Kai piloting it. At that moment, Thunderfang emerged from the ground, having been freed from his chains by the Forbidden Five.

As the Shatter Dragon of Chaos pronounced his defiance towards the Source Dragons, Kai noted that the Forbidden Five were nowhere to be seen and jokingly suggested that Thunderfang must've eaten them and that it would explain his foul mood. Nya reacted to her brother's joke with a groan, much to Kai's disappoint. He then followed Lloyd's lead and performed Spinjitzu alongside Nya, Lloyd, and Arin to strike Thunderfang's leg, but this attack left little, if any impact. Unimpressed with their attack, Thunderfang raised his foot to crush the ninja, but they managed to escape, albeit not unscathed. In the scramble to dodge Thunderfang's foot, Kai's legs were trapped by a large boulder. Nya tried to help Kai free himself, but Thunderfang caught sight of the two and raised his foot again to crush them, only being warded off by an attack from Wyldfyre.

Later, Kai, Nya, and Lloyd each performed Rising Dragon and combined their attacks into a simultaneous triple-strike against Thunderfang's chest, inflicting enough damage to momentarily stagger him but leaving no further effects. Thunderfang then sensed Lloyd's status as a Source Dragon conduit and kneeled down to single him out. Kai and Lloyd attempted to attack with Spinjitzu, but were both hurled off course by the dragon's attacks. Unable to leave much of an impact against the Shatter Dragon, Kai briefly switched his focus towards the remaining Dragonians, at one point clashing blades with one as Wyldfyre was shot down by Thunderfang.

Turning towards Wyldfyre, Kai scrambled to her aid and asked if she had been hurt in the crash. The girl denied being injured while wincing in pain and suggested for Kai to use her Mech Storm Rider against Thunderfang. Unfortunately, Kai's usage of the vehicle was no more impressive than Wyldfyre's, almost immediately getting chewed up and thrown about by Thunderfang on the first fly-by. Kai then regrouped with the other ninja and watched in shock as Thunderfang suddenly began to calcify, unaware that Arin had struck him with the Healing elixir from the Well of the Lost. Following Thunderfang's death, Kai took issue over Arin and Sora's departure with Ras, even asking Lloyd with incredulity if the latter was really going to allow them to go with Ras. Lloyd affirmed he was, because allowing the teens to make their own decisions was a key difference between the ninja and Ras' methods of teaching.

Kai and the other ninja then returned to the Monastery, where Kai watched with a smile as Wyldfyre reunited with Roby and he received a warm greeting from Cole, who then started to tell him about Mr. Frohicky's delicious pizza.

Kai's Monstrous Journey

Kai's Monstrous Journey[]

Kai's Monstrous Journey[]

Kai helped Wyldfyre practice her accuracy in the monastery courtyard. Having blindfolded his student and ordering her to balance on one leg atop a pole, Kai urged her now to find her inner calm, emphasizing that once her mind was clear, she would truly see. Unfortunately, Wyldfyre's aim was still off and she ended up losing her patience and hurling another fireball absentmindedly. This fireball incinerated Kichona Ki, Kai's favorite bonsai. As Kai gasped in horror at the incinerated tree, Wyldfyre ran off, proclaiming herself to be a monster.

Kai soon went looking for his student, only to discover that she had found the journal in which Kai had recorded his journey through the Land of Monsters. Horrified, Kai at first tried to snatch the papers from her, by the girl resisted and demanded for Kai to explain everything to her. Without a choice, Kai let out a sigh and agreed to tell her about his monstrous journey.

The Forest of Teeth![]

Kai began to tell Wyldfyre about his experiences in the Forest of Teeth and his first meeting with Fuzz. Wyldfyre briefly interrupted the story, much to Kai's annoyance. When Wyldfyre asked him to continue, Kai agreed, but only because he knew Wyldfyre would not leave him alone about it if he did not. When he finished the story, Wyldfyre was awestruck and asked Kai why he wanted to keep things a secret from everyone else, to which Kai replied grimly that this was only the beginning.

The Ruins![]

Continuing his story, Kai prefaced first that the experience wasn't something easy for him to talk about, but Wyldfyre wished to know more about the Monster Pig. Slightly annoyed, Kai told her that he will tell her how events played out chronologically and that they would get to the part about the pig when they got there. When he finished his story, Wyldfyre stated that Kai must've then walked into a trap, to which he replied that things were actually much worse than that.

Queen of Monsters![]

By nightfall, Kai and Wyldfyre prepared some bowls of noodles to enjoy while listening to the final part of Kai's story. When he finished, he told Wyldfyre that he had plenty more adventures afterwards in the Land of Monsters, but this was all she was getting out of him today. Suddenly, he collapsed onto the ground and began writhing, much to Wyldfyre's horror. Kai warned her that he was changing back and urged her to flee. After she ran off, abandoning her bowl of noodles, Kai got up, laughed, and helped himself to the now abandoned bowl.

Peak of 1000 Suns

Peak of 1000 Suns[]

As part of a challenge between himself and Wyldfyre to see who can tolerate the hottest peppers in the Merged Lands better than the other, Kai and Wyldfyre climbed across the Mountains of Impossible Height in search of the Thousand Sun Peppers. After reminiscing on the challenge so far, Kai discovered the peppers and he and Wyldfyre both started chewing on them. Unfortunately, neither could handle their heat yet attempted to goad the other into conceding first. By the time the pain reached its height, Kai decided that they should agree that the peppers had no effect on either of them, and that they should ask Zane to freeze their esophagi for thirty minutes.

Dragons Rising, Season 3

Dragons Rising, Season 3[]

The Hollow Ones[]

Kai joined his fellow ninja onboard Wyldfyre's new Temple Bounty to pay their final respects to Egalt. Along the way, Zane balked at Wyldfyre's reckless piloting and suggested that a better pilot may increase their odds of survival. Kai, who was just as mortified as everyone else, shot back that Zane should try telling that to Wyldfyre, as she was unlikely to listen. When Cole asked who was the one that gave Wyldfyre an airship in the first place, Kai replied with a groan that Roby was responsible. Luckily, the ninja managed to arrive at the training plateau in one piece and they paid their last respects to Egalt before he passed.

Upon returning to the monastery, the ninja got together to send off Zane and P.I.X.A.L. who were preparing to embark on a journey together through the Merged Lands. Kai urged them to let him and the others know if the pair saw anything cool, noting that things around the monastery would get pretty boring without them around. Kai was also the only ninja not to wave goodbye, instead watching with a warm smile.
